```diff
+/// 带后台计算设置的可写挂载（[`mount_writable_with_background_compute_settings`]）没做成：设置被拒，或挂载自己没做成。
+/// 与 [`MountError`] 分开报：设置那一拒在读任何一块盘之前，调用方要改的是挂载参数，不是池。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub enum WritableMountWithBackgroundComputeRefused {
+    /// D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 4 条：配错或 GPU 用不上，拒绝挂载，不降级到 `cpu`。在读任何一块盘之前拒，盘上逐字节不变。
+    BackgroundComputeSettings(BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused),
+    /// 设置校验过了，挂载自己没做成：同 [`mount_writable`] 的错。
+    Mount(MountError),
+}
+
+/// 同 [`mount_writable`]，这次挂载的后台计算设置由调用方给（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1–4 条：三个挂载参数只有一组、
+/// 管全部后台任务）。先照第 4 条校验（`background_compute::admit_background_compute_settings`；`gpu_inventory` 是本机的卡清单，
+/// `None` 是 GPU 不在），不过就在读任何一块盘之前拒绝挂载，不退回 `cpu`；过了就照 [`mount_writable`] 挂，设置装进交回的那份参数与盘表
+/// （[`ParametersAndDeviceTableOfTheMount::background_compute_of_this_mount`]），挂载续做与之后的会话照它。
+/// [`mount_writable`] 与别的可写挂载入口都等价于在这里给 `BackgroundComputeSettings::PRODUCT`（`cpu`）。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 设置被拒 ⇒ [`WritableMountWithBackgroundComputeRefused::BackgroundComputeSettings`]；
+/// 挂载自己的错 ⇒ [`WritableMountWithBackgroundComputeRefused::Mount`]，同 [`mount_writable`]。
+pub fn mount_writable_with_background_compute_settings<Device: BlockDevice>(
+    parameters: &MakeFilesystemParameters,
+    devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+    background_compute_settings: BackgroundComputeSettings,
+    gpu_inventory: Option<&dyn GpuInventory>,
+) -> Result<Mounted, WritableMountWithBackgroundComputeRefused> {
+    let background_compute =
+        match admit_background_compute_settings(background_compute_settings, gpu_inventory) {
+            Ok(admitted) => admitted,
+            Err(refused) => {
+                return Err(
+                    WritableMountWithBackgroundComputeRefused::BackgroundComputeSettings(refused),
+                )
+            }
+        };
+    mount_writable_with_every_test_only_switch(
+        parameters,
+        devices,
+        SpaceAdmission::JudgedByTheFormula,
+        ShadowLedger::On,
+        DeletionSwitches::PRODUCT,
+        CompactionSwitches::PRODUCT,
+        BeforeTheOneReread::RereadImmediately,
+        InstanceTableSweepConfiguration::PRODUCT,
+        background_compute,
     )
+    .map_err(WritableMountWithBackgroundComputeRefused::Mount)
 }

+/// 整理的一批（推一次发布，后台任务种类 [`BackgroundTask::CompactionRelocation`]）：进门读一次这次挂载的后台计算设置
+/// （D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1 条：挂着请求的切换在这里换上，从这一批起生效；一趟里每一批各读一次，不在一趟开头读一次），
+/// 按它定这一批走哪条路，一批之内不再读（`.claude/rules/fs-design.md` 五条硬要求第 5 条，`background_compute::BackgroundComputeOfThisMount::end_the_batch`
+/// 断言没换）。整理搬迁还没有 GPU 路径：请求 `gpu` 时照第 1 条「没有 GPU 路径的照旧在 CPU 上算」走 CPU，原因记进这一批的记账。
+/// 读完设置之后、开算之前照 `in_the_middle_of_each_batch` 做（只供测试的钩子在这一刻请求切换）。
+#[allow(
+    clippy::too_many_arguments,
+    reason = "参数各是一样东西：参数、盘表、分配器、会话这一侧的整理状态、现行那一版、实例代号、批大小、推到哪为止、上一条完成的意图、一批腾空了 R 之后删意图那一支的核怎么判、这次挂载的后台计算状态、一批读完设置之后做什么"
+)]
+fn advance_compaction_by_one_publish<Device: BlockDevice>(
+    parameters: &MakeFilesystemParameters,
+    devices: &mut [(DeviceIdentity, Device)],
+    allocator: &mut PoolAllocator,
+    compaction: &mut CompactionOfThisMount,
+    current: &mut PoolVersion,
+    instance: InstanceGeneration,
+    batch_units: CompactionBatchUnits,
+    reach: CompactionRunReach,
+    last_completed_intent: &mut Option<CompactionIntent>,
+    region_check_of_the_intent_deletion_after_a_batch_emptying_the_region: RegionCheckOfTheIntentDeletion,
+    background_compute: &mut BackgroundComputeOfThisMount,
+    in_the_middle_of_each_batch: &mut InTheMiddleOfEachBackgroundBatch<'_>,
+) -> CompactionPublishAdvanced {
+    let batch_under_way = background_compute.begin_a_batch(BackgroundTask::CompactionRelocation);
+    in_the_middle_of_each_batch.in_the_middle_of_the_batch(background_compute);
+    let step = match batch_under_way.path_taken() {

+            devices,
+            allocator,
+            compaction,
+            current,
+            instance,
+            batch_units,
+            reach,
+            last_completed_intent,
+            region_check_of_the_intent_deletion_after_a_batch_emptying_the_region,
+        ),
+    };
+    CompactionPublishAdvanced {
+        step,
+        background_compute_of_the_batch: background_compute.end_the_batch(batch_under_way),
+    }
+}

+//! 后台任务的计算放在哪（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1–4 条）：一组挂载参数（`background_compute`、`background_gpu_devices`、
+//! `background_gpu_memory_limit`）管全部后台任务，不按任务分设；挂载与挂着切换那一刻用同一套校验，配错、GPU 用不上就拒，不降级。
+//! 它只活在内存里：不写进系统配置、不占 feature bit，核心层不带 GPU 也能编（D24（后台重活能不能卸给 GPU） 已定项 2 第 1 条）。
+//!
+//! 今天没有一种后台任务有 GPU 路径：选了 `gpu` 时每一批照第 1 条「没有 GPU 路径的照旧在 CPU 上算」在 CPU 上算，
+//! 每批记下请求的后端与实际走的路（[`BackgroundComputeOfOneBatch`]；`.claude/rules/fs-design.md` 五条硬要求第 4 条：运行时看得出走了哪一条）。
+//! 设置在每一批开头读一次，挂着切换从下一批开始生效、一批之内不换（五条硬要求第 5 条）。
+
+/// 后台任务在哪算（挂载参数 `background_compute`，第 1 条）。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum BackgroundComputeBackend {
+    Cpu,
+    Gpu,
+}
+
+/// 计算可以放在别处的后台任务种类（第 1 条「凡有 GPU 路径的后台任务」）。封闭集合：里程碑七的 GPU 打包搬迁
+/// （`.claude/kb/milestone/07-seventh-txn.md`「三　GPU 打包搬迁」）加一个成员，挂载参数、校验与切换都不改。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum BackgroundTask {
+    /// 整理（GC）的搬迁：`mounted_session` 里整理每推一次发布算这一种任务的一批。
+    CompactionRelocation,
+}
+
+/// 一张显卡的标识（`background_gpu_devices` 列表里的一项）：不透明的字节，只比相等。卡用什么认、怎么排是里程碑四设计轮（七·2）
+/// 还挂着的岔路，这里不定格式：卡清单（[`GpuInventory`]）交出什么，调用方就点什么。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct GpuDeviceIdentifier(Vec<u8>);
+
+impl GpuDeviceIdentifier {
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_opaque_bytes(opaque_bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Self {
+        Self(opaque_bytes)
+    }
+}
+
+/// 显存的字节数：一张卡的显存总量，或 `background_gpu_memory_limit` 里给一张卡的上限（第 3 条）。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
+pub struct GpuMemoryInBytes(pub u64);
+
+/// 本机有哪些显卡、每张多少显存：只读。GPU 那一侧（住哪是七·2 的岔路）实现它，测试里一份假清单实现它。
+/// 挂载与切换的校验只读它；没有这一份清单（`None`）就是 GPU 不在。
+pub trait GpuInventory {
+    /// 本机全部显卡与各自的显存总量，按「本机全部显卡的列表」的次序：没给 `background_gpu_devices` 时，`background_gpu_memory_limit`
+    /// 按这个次序一张卡一个（第 3 条）。怎么排由实现这份清单的一方定（七·2 的岔路）。同一张卡只出现一次。
+    fn devices_with_total_memory(&self) -> Vec<(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)>;
+}
+
+/// 一组后台计算的挂载参数（第 1–3 条）。每次挂载各给各的；挂着的时候整组换（[`BackgroundComputeOfThisMount::request_switch_from_the_next_batch`]）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct BackgroundComputeSettings {
+    pub background_compute: BackgroundComputeBackend,
+    /// `None` 是不给：用本机全部显卡（第 2 条）。
+    pub background_gpu_devices: Option<Vec<GpuDeviceIdentifier>>,
+    /// `None` 是不给：不设上限（第 3 条）。给了就按次序与参与的卡一张一个，不补齐。
+    pub background_gpu_memory_limit: Option<Vec<GpuMemoryInBytes>>,
+}
+
+impl BackgroundComputeSettings {
+    /// 产品默认：`cpu`，卡与上限都不给（第 1 条「默认 `cpu`」）。现有的可写挂载入口都等价于挂载时给这一组。
+    pub const PRODUCT: BackgroundComputeSettings = BackgroundComputeSettings {
+        background_compute: BackgroundComputeBackend::Cpu,
+        background_gpu_devices: None,
+        background_gpu_memory_limit: None,
+    };
+}
+
+/// 一组设置在挂载或切换那一刻被拒（第 4 条：拒，不降级到 cpu）。成员按调用方要改哪一样分：
+/// 前四个是第 4 条点名的配错，后两个是条款没写的形态，第一版不支持。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused {
+    /// 选了 `gpu` 而 GPU 不在：没有卡清单，或没点名卡而清单里一张卡都没有。改选 `cpu`，或装上 GPU。
+    GpuNotPresent,
+    /// `background_gpu_devices` 点名的这张卡不在卡清单里（点名的卡不存在）。
+    NamedGpuDeviceNotInTheInventory { device: GpuDeviceIdentifier },
+    /// `background_gpu_memory_limit` 给了而个数与参与的卡数不等（给了卡列表对它的列表、没给对本机全部显卡）。
+    MemoryLimitCountDifferentFromTheParticipatingDevices {
+        memory_limits_given: usize,
+        participating_devices: usize,
+    },
+    /// 给这张卡的上限超过它的显存总量。
+    MemoryLimitAboveTheTotalMemoryOfTheDevice {
+        device: GpuDeviceIdentifier,
+        memory_limit: GpuMemoryInBytes,
+        total_memory: GpuMemoryInBytes,
+    },
+    /// `background_gpu_devices` 给了而一张卡都没点：第 2 条只写了「不给就用本机全部显卡」，给了空列表算什么条款没写，第一版不支持。
+    EmptyGpuDeviceListWhoseMeaningIsUndecided,
+    /// 同一张卡在 `background_gpu_devices` 里点了不止一次：第 3 条按次序一张卡一个上限，同一张卡两个上限怎么算条款没写，第一版不支持。
+    GpuDeviceNamedMoreThanOnceWhoseMeaningIsUndecided { device: GpuDeviceIdentifier },
+}
+
+/// 校验过的一组设置：只由 [`admit_background_compute_settings`] 造出，产品默认另有 [`Self::PRODUCT`]。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings {
+    settings: BackgroundComputeSettings,
+}
+
+impl AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings {
+    /// [`BackgroundComputeSettings::PRODUCT`]：选 `cpu` 照收、不校验。
+    pub const PRODUCT: AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings = AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings {
+        settings: BackgroundComputeSettings::PRODUCT,
+    };
+
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn settings(&self) -> &BackgroundComputeSettings {
+        &self.settings
+    }
+}
+
+/// 第 4 条的校验：选 `cpu` 时卡与上限照收、不校验（切到 `gpu` 那一刻再校验）；选 `gpu` 时，依次判 GPU 在不在、点名的卡在不在清单里、
+/// 上限个数与参与的卡数等不等、每个上限超没超那张卡的显存总量，有一样不对就拒。只读卡清单，不碰盘。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// [`BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused`] 的六种。
+pub fn admit_background_compute_settings(
+    settings: BackgroundComputeSettings,
+    gpu_inventory: Option<&dyn GpuInventory>,
+) -> Result<AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings, BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused> {
+    match settings.background_compute {
+        BackgroundComputeBackend::Cpu => {
+            return Ok(AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings { settings });
+        }
+        BackgroundComputeBackend::Gpu => {}
+    }
+    let Some(gpu_inventory) = gpu_inventory else {
+        return Err(BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::GpuNotPresent);
+    };
+    let devices_on_this_host = gpu_inventory.devices_with_total_memory();
+    let participating_devices = participating_gpu_devices(
+        settings.background_gpu_devices.as_deref(),
+        &devices_on_this_host,
+    )?;
+    if participating_devices.is_empty() {
+        return Err(BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::GpuNotPresent);
+    }
+    if let Some(memory_limits) = &settings.background_gpu_memory_limit {
+        if memory_limits.len() != participating_devices.len() {
+            return Err(
+                BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::MemoryLimitCountDifferentFromTheParticipatingDevices {
+                    memory_limits_given: memory_limits.len(),
+                    participating_devices: participating_devices.len(),
+                },
+            );
+        }
+        for ((device, total_memory), memory_limit) in
+            participating_devices.iter().zip(memory_limits)
+        {
+            if memory_limit > total_memory {
+                return Err(
+                    BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::MemoryLimitAboveTheTotalMemoryOfTheDevice {
+                        device: device.clone(),
+                        memory_limit: *memory_limit,
+                        total_memory: *total_memory,
+                    },
+                );
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings { settings })
+}
+
+/// 参与的卡与各自的显存总量，按上限对应的次序：没点名就是清单里的全部，点了名就是点名的那几张、按点名的次序。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 点名的空列表、同一张卡点了两次、点名的卡不在清单里。
+fn participating_gpu_devices(
+    named_devices: Option<&[GpuDeviceIdentifier]>,
+    devices_on_this_host: &[(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)],
+) -> Result<Vec<(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)>, BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused> {
+    let Some(named_devices) = named_devices else {
+        return Ok(devices_on_this_host.to_vec());
+    };
+    if named_devices.is_empty() {
+        return Err(BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::EmptyGpuDeviceListWhoseMeaningIsUndecided);
+    }
+    let mut participating_devices = Vec::with_capacity(named_devices.len());
+    for (position_in_the_list, named_device) in named_devices.iter().enumerate() {
+        if named_devices[..position_in_the_list].contains(named_device) {
+            return Err(
+                BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::GpuDeviceNamedMoreThanOnceWhoseMeaningIsUndecided {
+                    device: named_device.clone(),
+                },
+            );
+        }
+        let Some(device_on_this_host) = devices_on_this_host
+            .iter()
+            .find(|(device, _)| device == named_device)
+        else {
+            return Err(
+                BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::NamedGpuDeviceNotInTheInventory {
+                    device: named_device.clone(),
+                },
+            );
+        };
+        participating_devices.push(device_on_this_host.clone());
+    }
+    Ok(participating_devices)
+}
+
+/// 一批实际在哪算。封闭集合：哪一种后台任务接上 GPU 路径时加 GPU 那一个成员。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum BackgroundComputePathTaken {
+    Cpu(ReasonTheBatchRanOnTheCpu),
+}
+
+/// 一批为什么在 CPU 上算。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum ReasonTheBatchRanOnTheCpu {
+    /// 设置选的就是 `cpu`。
+    CpuRequestedByTheSettings,
+    /// 设置选了 `gpu`，而这一种后台任务还没有 GPU 路径：照第 1 条「没有 GPU 路径的照旧在 CPU 上算」。
+    ThisTaskHasNoGpuPathYet,
+}
+
+/// 一种后台任务在请求的后端下实际走哪条路（第 1 条）：判据只有这两样，都在一批开头定下、一批之内不变。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn path_taken_by_the_task(

+    requested_backend: BackgroundComputeBackend,

+    match (task, requested_backend) {

+        (BackgroundTask::CompactionRelocation, BackgroundComputeBackend::Gpu) => {

+    }

+/// 一批后台任务的计算记账：哪种任务、请求的后端（这一批开头读到的设置）、实际走的路。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct BackgroundComputeOfOneBatch {

+    pub requested_backend: BackgroundComputeBackend,
+    pub path_taken: BackgroundComputePathTaken,

+/// 一批开头读到的设置与它的记账：一批结束时拿它核设置一批之内没换（[`BackgroundComputeOfThisMount::end_the_batch`]）。
+pub(crate) struct BackgroundBatchUnderWay {
+    settings_read_at_the_start_of_the_batch: AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings,
+    batch: BackgroundComputeOfOneBatch,
+}

+    pub(crate) fn path_taken(&self) -> BackgroundComputePathTaken {
+        self.batch.path_taken
+    }
+}

+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct BackgroundComputeOfThisMount {

+    requested_from_the_next_batch: Option<AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings>,

+impl BackgroundComputeOfThisMount {

+    #[must_use]

+            in_effect: admitted_at_the_mount,
+            requested_from_the_next_batch: None,

+    }

+    /// 此刻生效的那一组：正在算的这一批（有的话）用的就是它。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn in_effect(&self) -> &AdmittedBackgroundComputeSettings {

+    }
+
+    /// 挂着时请求过、还没到下一批开头的那一组。

+    /// 挂着切换（第 1 条，一次切全部后台任务）：与挂载同一套校验（[`admit_background_compute_settings`]）；过了就记成待生效，

+    ///

+    pub fn request_switch_from_the_next_batch(

+    pub(crate) fn begin_a_batch(&mut self, task: BackgroundTask) -> BackgroundBatchUnderWay {

+                requested_backend,
+                path_taken: path_taken_by_the_task(task, requested_backend),

+    }

+    /// 一批结束：交回这一批的记账。
+    ///

+    /// 挂着的切换只记成待生效，换上只在 [`Self::begin_a_batch`]。
+    pub(crate) fn end_the_batch(
+        &self,
+        under_way: BackgroundBatchUnderWay,
+    ) -> BackgroundComputeOfOneBatch {
+        assert_eq!(
+            self.in_effect, under_way.settings_read_at_the_start_of_the_batch,
+            "后台计算的设置一批之内不换：挂着的切换只记成待生效，下一批开头才换上"

+/// 一批读完设置、开算之前做什么（`.claude/rules/fs-design.md` 五条硬要求第 2 条）。产品路径什么都不做；只供测试的那一臂调用例给的钩子，
+/// 钩子拿到这次挂载的后台计算状态，在这一刻请求切换，强制进入「一批跑到一半时请求切换」那一格。
+pub enum InTheMiddleOfEachBackgroundBatch<'hook> {
+    NothingHappens,
+    CallTheTestOnlyHook(&'hook mut dyn FnMut(&mut BackgroundComputeOfThisMount)),
+}
+
+impl InTheMiddleOfEachBackgroundBatch<'_> {
+    pub(crate) fn in_the_middle_of_the_batch(
+        &mut self,
+        background_compute: &mut BackgroundComputeOfThisMount,
+    ) {
+        match self {
+            InTheMiddleOfEachBackgroundBatch::NothingHappens => {}
+            InTheMiddleOfEachBackgroundBatch::CallTheTestOnlyHook(hook) => hook(background_compute),
+        }
+    }
+}
```

```diff
+/// 按槽数乘 16384、每块盘各一份（第一版每个单元落池里每一块盘）；journal 记录与根槽那几次写不计。搬走的单元的跨度取这一版里它目的落点那条
+/// 分配记录的（目的地那条记录就是这次发布记下的，找不到不计）。
+fn bytes_written_by_a_compaction_publish(version: &TransactionOutput, devices: usize) -> u64 {
+    let slots_of_the_rewritten_roles: u64 =
+        version.rewritten.iter().map(|role| role.span_slots()).sum();
+    let slots_of_the_relocated_units: u64 = version
+        .units_relocated_by_this_publish
+        .iter()
+        .filter_map(|relocated| {
+            let destination = relocated.destination[0];
+            version
+                .allocation_records
+                .iter()
+                .find(|record| {
+                    record.device == destination.device && record.slot == destination.slot
+                })
+                .map(|record| u64::from(record.span_slots))
+        })
+        .sum();
+    (slots_of_the_rewritten_roles + slots_of_the_relocated_units)
+        .saturating_mul(SLOT_BYTES)
+        .saturating_mul(u64::try_from(devices).expect("盘数装得进 u64"))
+}
```

## 补丁 `~/.local/share/singlefs/work/m4-gpugc-gpu-crate-writer/patch/crates.patch`（sha256 `89e4c950…`，产品代码的块 2588 行；文件：`crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/adapter_inventory.rs`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/background_gpu.rs`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernel_bitwise.wgsl`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernel_table_driven.wgsl`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernels.rs`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/lib.rs`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/memory_limit_and_chunks.rs`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/two_kernel_reconciliation.rs`, `crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/work_split_by_measured_cost.rs`）

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/adapter_inventory.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,562 @@
+//! 卡清单与挂载那一刻的校验（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 2–4 条），全是纯函数：输入是枚举到的适配器的描述，不碰 GPU。
+//!
+//! 哪些算显卡：只有独立显卡；集成显卡、虚拟显卡、软件 Vulkan（CPU 类型的适配器，例如 Mesa 的 lavapipe）与认不出类型的都不算、不进「全部」（第 2 条）。
+//! 一张卡的稳定标识是 Vulkan 报的 PCI 总线地址（wgpu 适配器信息的 `device_pci_bus_id`，形如 `0000:01:00.0`）：同型号的两张卡名字相同、
+//! 总线地址不同，重启与驱动升级都不改它。`background_gpu_devices` 点的就是这个串（[`gpu_device_identifier_of_the_pci_bus_address`]）。
+//! 全部显卡按总线地址的字典序排：没给 `background_gpu_devices` 时 `background_gpu_memory_limit` 按这个次序一张卡一个（第 3 条），
+//! Vulkan 的枚举次序不保证每次相同，不拿它当次序。
+//!
+//! 第 4 条的校验只有一份，在核心层（`singlefs_core::background_compute::admit_background_compute_settings`，挂载与挂着切换共用）：
+//! 这里把同一次枚举交成核心层的卡清单（[`DiscreteGpuInventorySnapshot`]）交给它判，判过之后按同一份清单取参与的卡，判与用读的是同一份输入。
+
+use singlefs_core::background_compute::{
+    admit_background_compute_settings, BackgroundComputeBackend, BackgroundComputeSettings,
+    BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused, GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuInventory, GpuMemoryInBytes,
+};
+
+/// 适配器是哪一类设备：wgpu 的 `DeviceType` 一一对过来（[`Self::of_the_wgpu_device_type`]）。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum AdapterDeviceKind {
+    DiscreteGpu,
+    IntegratedGpu,
+    VirtualGpu,
+    /// 在 CPU 上跑的软件实现（Vulkan 的 `VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_CPU`，lavapipe 就是这一类）。
+    SoftwareRenderingOnTheCpu,
+    OtherOrUnknown,
+}
+
+impl AdapterDeviceKind {
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_the_wgpu_device_type(device_type: wgpu::DeviceType) -> Self {
+        match device_type {
+            wgpu::DeviceType::DiscreteGpu => AdapterDeviceKind::DiscreteGpu,
+            wgpu::DeviceType::IntegratedGpu => AdapterDeviceKind::IntegratedGpu,
+            wgpu::DeviceType::VirtualGpu => AdapterDeviceKind::VirtualGpu,
+            wgpu::DeviceType::Cpu => AdapterDeviceKind::SoftwareRenderingOnTheCpu,
+            wgpu::DeviceType::Other => AdapterDeviceKind::OtherOrUnknown,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 算不算第 2 条的「显卡」：只有独立显卡算。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn counts_as_a_background_gpu(self) -> bool {
+        match self {
+            AdapterDeviceKind::DiscreteGpu => true,
+            AdapterDeviceKind::IntegratedGpu
+            | AdapterDeviceKind::VirtualGpu
+            | AdapterDeviceKind::SoftwareRenderingOnTheCpu
+            | AdapterDeviceKind::OtherOrUnknown => false,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// 枚举到的一个适配器，判「哪些算显卡」只读这几样。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct EnumeratedAdapterDescription {
+    pub name: String,
+    pub device_kind: AdapterDeviceKind,
+    /// wgpu 适配器信息的 `device_pci_bus_id`；驱动不报时是空串。
+    pub pci_bus_address: String,
+    /// 最大的一块设备本地内存堆（显存总量）；没读到是 `None`（不算显卡的适配器不去读）。
+    pub device_local_memory: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+}
+
+/// 本机的一张独立显卡。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct DiscreteGpuOnThisHost {
+    /// 它在这一次枚举的适配器列表里排第几（从 0 起），外壳拿它找回那个适配器。
+    pub position_in_the_enumeration: usize,
+    pub identifier: GpuDeviceIdentifier,
+    /// 造 [`Self::identifier`] 的那个总线地址；全部显卡按它的字典序排。
+    pub pci_bus_address: String,
+    pub name: String,
+    pub total_memory: GpuMemoryInBytes,
+}
+
+/// 枚举结果交不成一份卡清单：都是条款没写的形态，第一版不支持，挂载报错（不降级、不跳过那张卡）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum DiscreteGpuListRefused {
+    /// 一张独立显卡驱动没报 PCI 总线地址：卡的标识取总线地址（本模块文件头），没有地址的卡怎么点名条款没写，第一版不支持。
+    DiscreteGpuWithoutAPciBusAddressIsNotSupported { name: String },
+    /// 一张独立显卡读不到设备本地内存堆：第 3 条要拿上限比显存总量，读不到总量怎么判条款没写，第一版不支持。
+    DiscreteGpuWithoutADeviceLocalMemoryHeapIsNotSupported { name: String },
+    /// 两个独立显卡适配器报了同一个总线地址（同一张卡经两份驱动各枚举一次）：一张卡只该出现一次，用哪一份条款没写，第一版不支持。
+    PciBusAddressReportedByTwoDiscreteGpusIsNotSupported { pci_bus_address: String },
+}
+
+/// `background_gpu_devices` 里点一张卡要写的标识：那张卡的 PCI 总线地址，按 wgpu 报的原样（本模块文件头）。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn gpu_device_identifier_of_the_pci_bus_address(pci_bus_address: &str) -> GpuDeviceIdentifier {
+    GpuDeviceIdentifier::of_opaque_bytes(pci_bus_address.as_bytes().to_vec())
+}
+
+/// 第 2 条「本机全部独立显卡」：只留独立显卡，按 PCI 总线地址的字典序排。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// [`DiscreteGpuListRefused`] 的三种，都只看独立显卡；不算显卡的适配器缺什么都不管。
+pub fn discrete_gpus_of_the_enumeration(
+    adapters: &[EnumeratedAdapterDescription],
+) -> Result<Vec<DiscreteGpuOnThisHost>, DiscreteGpuListRefused> {
+    let mut discrete_gpus: Vec<DiscreteGpuOnThisHost> = Vec::new();
+    for (position_in_the_enumeration, adapter) in adapters.iter().enumerate() {
+        if !adapter.device_kind.counts_as_a_background_gpu() {
+            continue;
+        }
+        if adapter.pci_bus_address.is_empty() {
+            return Err(
+                DiscreteGpuListRefused::DiscreteGpuWithoutAPciBusAddressIsNotSupported {
+                    name: adapter.name.clone(),
+                },
+            );
+        }
+        let Some(total_memory) = adapter.device_local_memory else {
+            return Err(
+                DiscreteGpuListRefused::DiscreteGpuWithoutADeviceLocalMemoryHeapIsNotSupported {
+                    name: adapter.name.clone(),
+                },
+            );
+        };
+        let identifier = gpu_device_identifier_of_the_pci_bus_address(&adapter.pci_bus_address);
+        if discrete_gpus
+            .iter()
+            .any(|already_listed| already_listed.identifier == identifier)
+        {
+            return Err(
+                DiscreteGpuListRefused::PciBusAddressReportedByTwoDiscreteGpusIsNotSupported {
+                    pci_bus_address: adapter.pci_bus_address.clone(),
+                },
+            );
+        }
+        discrete_gpus.push(DiscreteGpuOnThisHost {
+            position_in_the_enumeration,
+            identifier,
+            pci_bus_address: adapter.pci_bus_address.clone(),
+            name: adapter.name.clone(),
+            total_memory,
+        });
+    }
+    discrete_gpus.sort_by(|left, right| left.pci_bus_address.cmp(&right.pci_bus_address));
+    Ok(discrete_gpus)
+}
+
+/// 同一次枚举交成核心层的卡清单（`GpuInventory`）：挂载那一刻的校验读它，之后取参与的卡读的也是它。
+pub struct DiscreteGpuInventorySnapshot<'enumeration> {
+    pub discrete_gpus: &'enumeration [DiscreteGpuOnThisHost],
+}
+
+impl GpuInventory for DiscreteGpuInventorySnapshot<'_> {
+    fn devices_with_total_memory(&self) -> Vec<(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)> {
+        self.discrete_gpus
+            .iter()
+            .map(|discrete_gpu| (discrete_gpu.identifier.clone(), discrete_gpu.total_memory))
+            .collect()
+    }
+}
+
+/// 挂载给的卡与上限（挂载参数 `background_gpu_devices`、`background_gpu_memory_limit`，第 2、3 条）。`None` 是不给。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct BackgroundGpuSelection {
+    pub background_gpu_devices: Option<Vec<GpuDeviceIdentifier>>,
+    pub background_gpu_memory_limit: Option<Vec<GpuMemoryInBytes>>,
+}
+
+/// 一张参与的卡与给它的显存上限（`None` 是不设上限）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ParticipatingGpu {
+    pub discrete_gpu: DiscreteGpuOnThisHost,
+    pub memory_limit: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+}
+
+/// 挂载那一刻的校验（第 4 条）与参与的卡：先交核心层那一套校验判，过了再按同一份清单取参与的卡，
+/// 没点名就是全部独立显卡（按总线地址排），点了名就是点名的那几张、按点名的次序，上限按次序一张一个。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 核心层的 `BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused`：GPU 不在（一张独立显卡都没有）、点名的卡不存在、上限个数与参与的卡数不等、
+/// 上限超过那张卡的显存总量，以及核心层另拒的两种条款没写的点法（空列表、同一张卡点两次）。
+pub fn participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks(
+    selection: &BackgroundGpuSelection,
+    discrete_gpus: &[DiscreteGpuOnThisHost],
+) -> Result<Vec<ParticipatingGpu>, BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused> {
+    let inventory = DiscreteGpuInventorySnapshot { discrete_gpus };
+    admit_background_compute_settings(
+        BackgroundComputeSettings {
+            background_compute: BackgroundComputeBackend::Gpu,
+            background_gpu_devices: selection.background_gpu_devices.clone(),
+            background_gpu_memory_limit: selection.background_gpu_memory_limit.clone(),
+        },
+        Some(&inventory),
+    )?;
+    let participating_without_limits: Vec<DiscreteGpuOnThisHost> =
+        match &selection.background_gpu_devices {
+            None => discrete_gpus.to_vec(),
+            Some(named_devices) => named_devices
+                .iter()
+                .map(|named_device| {
+                    discrete_gpus
+                        .iter()
+                        .find(|discrete_gpu| &discrete_gpu.identifier == named_device)
+                        .cloned()
+                        .expect("核心层的校验判过点名的卡都在这一份清单里；这里找不到说明判与取读的不是同一份清单")
+                })
+                .collect(),
+        };
+    let participating = match &selection.background_gpu_memory_limit {
+        None => participating_without_limits
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|discrete_gpu| ParticipatingGpu {
+                discrete_gpu,
+                memory_limit: None,
+            })
+            .collect(),
+        Some(memory_limits) => {
+            assert_eq!(
+                memory_limits.len(),
+                participating_without_limits.len(),
+                "核心层的校验判过上限个数与参与的卡数相等"
+            );
+            participating_without_limits
+                .into_iter()
+                .zip(memory_limits.iter().copied())
+                .map(|(discrete_gpu, memory_limit)| ParticipatingGpu {
+                    discrete_gpu,
+                    memory_limit: Some(memory_limit),
+                })
+                .collect()
+        }
+    };
+    Ok(participating)
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {

+

+    /// 一张独显、一张集显、一个软件 Vulkan（CPU 类型）：本机常见的那一种摆法。

+

+            discrete_gpus_of_the_enumeration(&adapters),

+                DiscreteGpuListRefused::DiscreteGpuWithoutAPciBusAddressIsNotSupported {
+                    name: "no address".to_string()
+                }
+            )
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_discrete_gpu_without_a_device_local_memory_heap_is_refused() {
+        let mut no_heap = adapter("no heap", AdapterDeviceKind::DiscreteGpu, "0000:01:00.0", 8);
+        no_heap.device_local_memory = None;
+        assert_eq!(

+                    name: "no heap".to_string()
+                }
+            )

+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn two_discrete_gpus_reporting_the_same_pci_bus_address_are_refused() {
+        let adapters = vec![
+            adapter(
+                "one driver",
+                AdapterDeviceKind::DiscreteGpu,
+                "0000:01:00.0",

+                }

+
+    fn two_discrete_gpus() -> Vec<DiscreteGpuOnThisHost> {

+            adapter(
+                "big card",
+                AdapterDeviceKind::DiscreteGpu,
+                "0000:01:00.0",
+                32,
+            ),
+            adapter(
+                "small card",
+                AdapterDeviceKind::DiscreteGpu,
+                "0000:41:00.0",
+                16,
+            ),
+        ])
+        .expect("两张独显都齐")
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn no_discrete_gpu_refuses_the_mount_as_gpu_not_present() {
+        let discrete_gpus = discrete_gpus_of_the_enumeration(&[
+            adapter(

+            Err(BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::GpuNotPresent),
+            "只有集显与软件 Vulkan 时 GPU 不在，拒绝挂载、不降级"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn naming_a_gpu_that_is_not_a_discrete_gpu_of_this_host_refuses_the_mount() {
+        let integrated_address = gpu_device_identifier_of_the_pci_bus_address("0000:00:02.0");
+        assert_eq!(
+            participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks(
+                &BackgroundGpuSelection {
+                    background_gpu_devices: Some(vec![integrated_address.clone()]),
+                    background_gpu_memory_limit: None,

+            ),
+            Err(
+                BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::NamedGpuDeviceNotInTheInventory {
+                    device: integrated_address
+                }
+            ),
+            "点名的是集显（不在显卡清单里）：点名的卡不存在"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_memory_limit_count_different_from_the_participating_gpus_refuses_the_mount() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks(
+                &BackgroundGpuSelection {
+                    background_gpu_devices: None,
+                    background_gpu_memory_limit: Some(vec![GpuMemoryInBytes(GIBIBYTE)]),
+                },
+                &two_discrete_gpus(),
+            ),
+            Err(
+                BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::MemoryLimitCountDifferentFromTheParticipatingDevices {
+                    memory_limits_given: 1,
+                    participating_devices: 2,
+                }
+            ),
+            "两张卡只给一个上限：不补齐，报错"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_memory_limit_above_the_total_memory_of_its_gpu_refuses_the_mount() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks(
+                &BackgroundGpuSelection {
+                    background_gpu_devices: None,
+                    background_gpu_memory_limit: Some(vec![
+                        GpuMemoryInBytes(GIBIBYTE),
+                        GpuMemoryInBytes(17 * GIBIBYTE),
+                    ]),
+                },
+                &two_discrete_gpus(),

+                BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused::MemoryLimitAboveTheTotalMemoryOfTheDevice {
+                    device: gpu_device_identifier_of_the_pci_bus_address("0000:41:00.0"),
+                    memory_limit: GpuMemoryInBytes(17 * GIBIBYTE),
+                    total_memory: GpuMemoryInBytes(16 * GIBIBYTE),
+                }
+            ),
+            "16 GiB 的卡给了 17 GiB 的上限"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn named_gpus_participate_in_the_named_order_with_their_memory_limits() {
+        let participating = participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks(
+            &BackgroundGpuSelection {
+                background_gpu_devices: Some(vec![
+                    gpu_device_identifier_of_the_pci_bus_address("0000:41:00.0"),
+                    gpu_device_identifier_of_the_pci_bus_address("0000:01:00.0"),
+                ]),
+                background_gpu_memory_limit: Some(vec![
+                    GpuMemoryInBytes(2 * GIBIBYTE),
+                    GpuMemoryInBytes(3 * GIBIBYTE),
+                ]),
+            },
+            &two_discrete_gpus(),
+        )
+        .expect("两张卡都在、上限都不超");
+        let named_order: Vec<(&str, Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>)> = participating
+            .iter()
+            .map(|gpu| (gpu.discrete_gpu.name.as_str(), gpu.memory_limit))
+            .collect();
+        assert_eq!(
+            named_order,

+                ("small card", Some(GpuMemoryInBytes(2 * GIBIBYTE))),
+                ("big card", Some(GpuMemoryInBytes(3 * GIBIBYTE))),

+            "点名的次序就是上限对应的次序"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn without_named_gpus_every_discrete_gpu_participates_without_a_memory_limit() {
+        let participating = participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks(
+            &BackgroundGpuSelection {
+                background_gpu_devices: None,
+                background_gpu_memory_limit: None,
+            },
+            &two_discrete_gpus(),

+        .expect("不给卡也不给上限：全部独显、不设限");
+        assert_eq!(participating.len(), 2, "全部独显都用");
+        assert!(
+            participating.iter().all(|gpu| gpu.memory_limit.is_none()),
+            "不给上限就不设限"
+        );
+    }
+}

+//! 起 GPU 的外壳（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 2–4、8 条）：挂载那一刻枚举 wgpu 适配器、判过校验、在每张参与的卡上起设备与两份核的管线、
+//! 量一次提交的主机 CPU 时间（[`BackgroundGpu::participating_gpus`] 报出来）；挂着的时候每一批按量出的代价分给各卡、按显存上限切段、
+//! 两份核各算一次、逐条比对（[`BackgroundGpu::verify_unit_checksums`]）。
+//!
+//! GPU 出错（设备丢了、wgpu 报了没接住的错、等不成、回读映射不成、核没写到某一条）时这一批交回出错：不重试、不换 CPU（第 4 条）；
+//! 这时不动连续不确定的计数（这一批放弃了，不算一轮）。只有一张卡时两份核都在这张卡上跑；几张卡时每张卡在自己分到的那几条上跑两份核。
+//! 阻塞等 GPU 用 wgpu 自己的 `poll` 与 std 写的最小等法（[`wait_for_the_wgpu_future`]），不依赖 `pollster`（门禁 checker-implementation-disjoint 格第 ⑧ 条）。
+
+use std::future::Future;
+use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
+use std::task::{Context, Poll, Wake, Waker};
+
+use singlefs_core::background_compute::{
+    BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused, GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes,
+};
+use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;
+
+use crate::adapter_inventory::{
+    discrete_gpus_of_the_enumeration, participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks,
+    AdapterDeviceKind, BackgroundGpuSelection, DiscreteGpuListRefused,
+    EnumeratedAdapterDescription, ParticipatingGpu,
+};
+use crate::checksum_kernels::{
+    cpu_reference_outcome, decoded_kernel_outcomes, outcome_buffer_before_the_kernel_writes,
+    packed_checksum_chunk, ChecksumKernelOutcome, UnitChecksumToVerify, UnrecognizedVerdictWord,
+    BITWISE_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT, BITWISE_KERNEL_SOURCE, CHECKSUM_CHUNK_FOOTPRINT,
+    INVOCATIONS_PER_WORKGROUP, OUTCOME_BYTES_PER_ENTRY, PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES,
+    TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT, TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_SOURCE,
+};
+use crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::{
+    chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu, input_buffer_bytes, ChunkBoundsOfAGpu,
+    EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu, GpuMemoryAccount,
+};
+use crate::two_kernel_reconciliation::{
+    ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts, ReconciledBatch, TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry,
+};
+use crate::work_split_by_measured_cost::{
+    entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost, entry_ranges_per_gpu, HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission,
+};
+
+/// 两份核的着色器按字节偏移用 `u32` 寻址、整字那一段按「剩下的字节 ≥ 4」走：一个绑定不超过 2^31 字节，偏移加 4 也不回绕。
+const LARGEST_STORAGE_BINDING_THE_KERNELS_ADDRESS_IN_BYTES: u64 = 1 << 31;
+/// 量代价用的那一条：4096 字节全 0（大小取一个常见的单元块；它只用来量一次提交的主机 CPU，结果不用）。
+const COST_PROBE_UNIT_BYTES: usize = 4096;
+/// 量几次取中位数：先空跑一次（管线刚编好时驱动的懒初始化不算进去），再量这么多次。
+const COST_MEASUREMENT_SUBMISSIONS: usize = 5;
+
+/// 一次 GPU 出错是什么（第 4 条）：调用方的决定只有一个——这一批放弃、后台任务停下并报错，成员只为报得清。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum GpuFailureCause {
+    /// 起不了设备或编不了管线（驱动不对、显存不够）。
+    DeviceOrPipelineDidNotStart { reason: String },
+    /// wgpu 报了没接住的错（校验错、显存不够）或设备丢了。
+    UncapturedErrorOrDeviceLost { reason: String },
+    /// 等这一次提交没等成。
+    WaitForTheSubmissionFailed { reason: String },
+    /// 回读缓冲映射不成。
+    ReadbackMappingFailed { reason: String },
+    /// 读回的判定字认不得：核没写到那一条或写坏了。
+    KernelLeftAnUnrecognizedVerdictWord(UnrecognizedVerdictWord),
+}
+
+/// 挂载那一刻开不了后台 GPU（第 4 条：拒绝挂载并报错，不降级、不退回 CPU）。成员按调用方要改哪一样分。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum BackgroundGpuOpenRefused {
+    /// 挂载参数配错或 GPU 不在：核心层那一套校验拒的（改参数，或装上卡）。
+    SettingsRefused(BackgroundComputeSettingsRefused),
+    /// 枚举到的独立显卡交不成一份卡清单（条款没写的形态，第一版不支持）。
+    DiscreteGpuListNotSupported(DiscreteGpuListRefused),
+    /// 一张参与的卡用不上（起不了设备、编不了管线、量代价那几次提交出错）。
+    GpuUnusable {
+        device: GpuDeviceIdentifier,
+        cause: GpuFailureCause,
+    },
+}
+
+/// 一批校验和核对交不成。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum ChecksumBatchFailed {
+    /// GPU 出错：这一批放弃，不重试、不换 CPU（第 4 条）。
+    GpuFailed {
+        device: GpuDeviceIdentifier,
+        cause: GpuFailureCause,
+    },
+    /// 一个单元单独占的缓冲就超过分到它的那张卡的显存上限或绑定上限：条款只写了一批放不下就切成几次交，
+    /// 单个条目放不下怎么办没写，第一版不支持。这时一张卡都还没交活。`entry_position` 是它在这一批里的位置。
+    UnitLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+        device: GpuDeviceIdentifier,
+        entry_position: usize,
+        unit_bytes: u64,
+    },
+}
+
+/// 一张参与的卡对外报的样子（第 2 条：参与的卡都用，并报出来）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ParticipatingGpuReport {
+    pub identifier: GpuDeviceIdentifier,
+    pub name: String,
+    pub memory_limit: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+    pub measured_cost: HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission,
+}
+
+/// 这一次挂载的后台 GPU：参与的卡，按卡的次序（没点名是总线地址的次序，点了名是点名的次序）。生命周期一次挂载，只住内存。
+pub struct BackgroundGpu {
+    gpus_in_use: Vec<GpuInUse>,
+    /// 设备由这个实例枚举出来，随后台 GPU 一起活着。
+    #[allow(dead_code, reason = "只为让实例与设备同寿，不读它")]
+    instance_the_devices_came_from: wgpu::Instance,
+}
+
+struct GpuInUse {
+    participating: ParticipatingGpu,
+    device: wgpu::Device,
+    queue: wgpu::Queue,
+    table_driven_pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
+    bitwise_pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
+    chunk_bounds: ChunkBoundsOfAGpu,
+    memory_account: GpuMemoryAccount,
+    /// wgpu 的回调（没接住的错、设备丢了）记在这里；每次等完提交先看它。
+    fault_reported_by_wgpu: Arc<Mutex<Option<String>>>,
+    measured_cost: HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission,
+}
+
+/// 挂载那一刻：枚举适配器、判卡清单与校验、在每张参与的卡上起设备与两份核、量一次提交的主机 CPU 时间。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// [`BackgroundGpuOpenRefused`] 的三种。
+pub fn open_background_gpu(
+    selection: &BackgroundGpuSelection,
+) -> Result<BackgroundGpu, BackgroundGpuOpenRefused> {
+    let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(wgpu::InstanceDescriptor {
+        backends: wgpu::Backends::VULKAN,
+        ..wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_without_display_handle()
+    });
+    let adapters = wait_for_the_wgpu_future(instance.enumerate_adapters(wgpu::Backends::VULKAN));
+    let descriptions: Vec<EnumeratedAdapterDescription> =
+        adapters.iter().map(description_of_the_adapter).collect();
+    let discrete_gpus = discrete_gpus_of_the_enumeration(&descriptions)
+        .map_err(BackgroundGpuOpenRefused::DiscreteGpuListNotSupported)?;
+    let participating = participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks(selection, &discrete_gpus)
+        .map_err(BackgroundGpuOpenRefused::SettingsRefused)?;
+    let mut gpus_in_use = Vec::with_capacity(participating.len());
+    for participating_gpu in participating {
+        let device_identifier = participating_gpu.discrete_gpu.identifier.clone();
+        let adapter = &adapters[participating_gpu.discrete_gpu.position_in_the_enumeration];
+        let gpu_in_use =
+            started_gpu_with_its_cost_measured(adapter, participating_gpu).map_err(|cause| {
+                BackgroundGpuOpenRefused::GpuUnusable {
+                    device: device_identifier,
+                    cause,
+                }
+            })?;
+        gpus_in_use.push(gpu_in_use);
+    }
+    Ok(BackgroundGpu {
+        gpus_in_use,
+        instance_the_devices_came_from: instance,
+    })
+}
+
+fn description_of_the_adapter(adapter: &wgpu::Adapter) -> EnumeratedAdapterDescription {
+    let adapter_information = adapter.get_info();
+    let device_kind = AdapterDeviceKind::of_the_wgpu_device_type(adapter_information.device_type);
+    let device_local_memory = if device_kind.counts_as_a_background_gpu() {
+        largest_device_local_memory_heap(adapter)
+    } else {
+        None
+    };
+    EnumeratedAdapterDescription {
+        name: adapter_information.name,
+        device_kind,
+        pci_bus_address: adapter_information.device_pci_bus_id,
+        device_local_memory,
+    }
+}
+
+/// 显存总量：这张卡 Vulkan 物理设备最大的那一块设备本地内存堆。独显上显存是一整块设备本地堆；另一块小的设备本地堆
+/// （主机可见的那一窗，例如 256 MiB）是同一片显存的一部分，加起来会重算，所以取最大的一块、不求和。不是 Vulkan 后端的适配器交回 `None`。
+#[allow(
+    unsafe_code,
+    reason = "wgpu 不报显存，只能经 hal 层拿 Vulkan 实例与物理设备句柄去读内存堆；wgpu 与 ash 都没有安全的封装"
+)]
+fn largest_device_local_memory_heap(adapter: &wgpu::Adapter) -> Option<GpuMemoryInBytes> {
+    // SAFETY: `as_hal` 只借出 hal 层的适配器，这里不销毁也不改它指向的任何 Vulkan 对象；守卫在这个函数里丢掉。
+    let hal_adapter = unsafe { adapter.as_hal::<wgpu::hal::api::Vulkan>() }?;
+    let raw_instance = hal_adapter.shared_instance().raw_instance();
+    // SAFETY: 物理设备句柄取自同一个 hal 适配器，那个适配器就是这个实例枚举出来的；`vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties` 只读。
+    let memory_properties = unsafe {
+        raw_instance.get_physical_device_memory_properties(hal_adapter.raw_physical_device())
+    };
+    memory_properties
+        .memory_heaps_as_slice()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|memory_heap| {
+            memory_heap
+                .flags
+                .contains(ash::vk::MemoryHeapFlags::DEVICE_LOCAL)
+        })
+        .map(|memory_heap| memory_heap.size)
+        .max()
+        .map(GpuMemoryInBytes)
+}
+
+fn started_gpu_with_its_cost_measured(
+    adapter: &wgpu::Adapter,
+    participating: ParticipatingGpu,
+) -> Result<GpuInUse, GpuFailureCause> {
+    let adapter_limits = adapter.limits();
+    let (device, queue) =
+        wait_for_the_wgpu_future(adapter.request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
+            label: Some("singlefs-background-gpu"),
+            required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
+            // 一段的输入与描述各绑成一张存储缓冲：按这张卡实际支持的上限要，默认的 128 MiB 绑定上限会让一批切得太碎。
+            required_limits: adapter_limits.clone(),
+            experimental_features: wgpu::ExperimentalFeatures::disabled(),
+            memory_hints: wgpu::MemoryHints::Performance,
+            trace: wgpu::Trace::Off,
+        }))
+        .map_err(|error| GpuFailureCause::DeviceOrPipelineDidNotStart {
+            reason: format!("起不了设备：{error}"),
+        })?;
+    let fault_reported_by_wgpu: Arc<Mutex<Option<String>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
+    let fault_record_for_uncaptured_errors = Arc::clone(&fault_reported_by_wgpu);
+    device.on_uncaptured_error(Arc::new(move |error: wgpu::Error| {
+        record_the_fault_reported_by_wgpu(
+            &fault_record_for_uncaptured_errors,
+            format!("wgpu 报了没接住的错：{error}"),
+        );
+    }));
+    let fault_record_for_the_loss = Arc::clone(&fault_reported_by_wgpu);
+    device.set_device_lost_callback(move |reason, message| {
+        record_the_fault_reported_by_wgpu(
+            &fault_record_for_the_loss,
+            format!("设备丢了（{reason:?}）：{message}"),
+        );
+    });
+    let table_driven_pipeline = compute_pipeline_of_the_kernel(
+        &device,
+        TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_SOURCE,
+        TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT,
+    );
+    let bitwise_pipeline =
+        compute_pipeline_of_the_kernel(&device, BITWISE_KERNEL_SOURCE, BITWISE_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT);
+    if let Some(reason) = fault_taken_from_the_record(&fault_reported_by_wgpu) {
+        return Err(GpuFailureCause::DeviceOrPipelineDidNotStart { reason });
+    }
+    let chunk_bounds = ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+        memory_limit: participating.memory_limit,
+        largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: adapter_limits
+            .max_storage_buffer_binding_size
+            .min(adapter_limits.max_buffer_size)
+            .min(LARGEST_STORAGE_BINDING_THE_KERNELS_ADDRESS_IN_BYTES),
+        largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: u64::from(
+            adapter_limits.max_compute_workgroups_per_dimension,
+        ) * u64::from(INVOCATIONS_PER_WORKGROUP),
+    };
+    let mut gpu_in_use = GpuInUse {
+        memory_account: GpuMemoryAccount::with_nothing_held(participating.memory_limit),
+        participating,
+        device,
+        queue,
+        table_driven_pipeline,
+        bitwise_pipeline,
+        chunk_bounds,
+        fault_reported_by_wgpu,
+        measured_cost: HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(0),
+    };
+    gpu_in_use.measured_cost = gpu_in_use.measured_cost_of_one_submission()?;
+    Ok(gpu_in_use)
+}
+
+fn compute_pipeline_of_the_kernel(
+    device: &wgpu::Device,
+    kernel_source: &str,
+    entry_point: &str,
+) -> wgpu::ComputePipeline {
+    let module = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
+        label: Some(entry_point),
+        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(kernel_source.into()),
+    });
+    device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
+        label: Some(entry_point),
+        layout: None,
+        module: &module,
+        entry_point: Some(entry_point),
+        compilation_options: wgpu::PipelineCompilationOptions::default(),
+        cache: None,
+    })
+}
+
+fn record_the_fault_reported_by_wgpu(record: &Mutex<Option<String>>, reason: String) {
+    let mut recorded = record
+        .lock()
+        .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
+    // 先记下的那一个原因留着：后面的多半是它的连锁反应
+    if recorded.is_none() {
+        *recorded = Some(reason);
+    }
+}
+
+fn fault_taken_from_the_record(record: &Mutex<Option<String>>) -> Option<String> {
+    record
+        .lock()
+        .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner)
+        .take()
+}
+
+impl GpuInUse {
+    /// 挂载时量一次提交的主机 CPU 时间（第 2 条）：这条线程的 CPU 钟（不是挂钟），先空跑一次，再量 [`COST_MEASUREMENT_SUBMISSIONS`] 次取中位数。
+    /// 每一次是一整段的提交：建缓冲、编码两份核、交、等、回读、解码，与挂着时交一段走同一条路（[`Self::both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk`]）。
+    fn measured_cost_of_one_submission(
+        &mut self,
+    ) -> Result<HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission, GpuFailureCause> {
+        let probe_unit_bytes = vec![0_u8; COST_PROBE_UNIT_BYTES];
+        let probe = [UnitChecksumToVerify {
+            entry_key: (),
+            unit_bytes: probe_unit_bytes.as_slice(),
+            expected_crc32c: 0,
+        }];
+        self.both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk(&probe)?;
+        let mut costs_in_nanoseconds = Vec::with_capacity(COST_MEASUREMENT_SUBMISSIONS);
+        for _measurement in 0..COST_MEASUREMENT_SUBMISSIONS {
+            let cpu_time_before = host_cpu_time_of_this_thread();
+            self.both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk(&probe)?;
+            let cpu_time_spent = host_cpu_time_of_this_thread().saturating_sub(cpu_time_before);
+            costs_in_nanoseconds.push(
+                u64::try_from(cpu_time_spent.as_nanos())
+                    .expect("一次提交的 CPU 时间装得进 u64 纳秒"),
+            );
+        }
+        costs_in_nanoseconds.sort_unstable();
+        Ok(HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(
+            costs_in_nanoseconds[COST_MEASUREMENT_SUBMISSIONS / 2],
+        ))
+    }
+
+    /// 一段（切批切出来的、装得下这张卡的那几条）交给这张卡：两份核在同一次提交里各算一遍，交回每条两份的结果，按段里的次序。
+    /// 本包这一段占的缓冲先记进这张卡的账（超上限断言），交完放掉。
+    fn both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk<EntryKey>(
+        &mut self,
+        units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, EntryKey>],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(ChecksumKernelOutcome, ChecksumKernelOutcome)>, GpuFailureCause> {
+        assert!(!units.is_empty(), "切批不交空段");
+        let packed = packed_checksum_chunk(units);
+        let entry_count = packed.entry_count();
+        let entry_count_in_words =
+            u32::try_from(entry_count).expect("一段的条数不超过一次派发的上限，装得进 u32");
+        let outcome_bytes = u64::from(entry_count_in_words) * OUTCOME_BYTES_PER_ENTRY;
+        let mut parameter_bytes =
+            vec![0_u8; usize::try_from(PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES).expect("16 字节")];
+        parameter_bytes[..4].copy_from_slice(&entry_count_in_words.to_le_bytes());
+        let descriptor_bytes = packed.descriptor_bytes();
+        let outcome_fill = outcome_buffer_before_the_kernel_writes(entry_count);
+
+        let bytes_held_by_this_chunk = PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES
+            + input_buffer_bytes(u64::try_from(packed.input_bytes.len()).expect("装得进 u64"))
+            + u64::try_from(descriptor_bytes.len()).expect("装得进 u64")
+            + 4 * outcome_bytes;
+        assert_eq!(
+            bytes_held_by_this_chunk,
+            CHECKSUM_CHUNK_FOOTPRINT.bytes_held_by_a_chunk(
+                u64::try_from(
+                    units
+                        .iter()
+                        .map(|unit| unit.unit_bytes.len())
+                        .sum::<usize>()
+                )
+                .expect("装得进 u64"),
+                u64::from(entry_count_in_words),
+            ),
+            "这一段真建的缓冲与切批按的占用一致"
+        );
+        self.memory_account.hold(bytes_held_by_this_chunk);
+        let outcomes = self.submit_both_kernels_and_read_back(
+            &parameter_bytes,
+            &packed.input_bytes,
+            &descriptor_bytes,
+            &outcome_fill,
+            entry_count_in_words,
+            outcome_bytes,
+        );
+        self.memory_account.release(bytes_held_by_this_chunk);
+        outcomes
+    }
+
+    fn submit_both_kernels_and_read_back(
+        &self,
+        parameter_bytes: &[u8],
+        input_bytes: &[u8],
+        descriptor_bytes: &[u8],
+        outcome_fill: &[u8],
+        entry_count: u32,
+        outcome_bytes: u64,
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(ChecksumKernelOutcome, ChecksumKernelOutcome)>, GpuFailureCause> {
+        let device = &self.device;
+        let buffer_with_contents = |contents: &[u8], usage: wgpu::BufferUsages| {
+            device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
+                label: None,
+                contents,
+                usage,
+            })
+        };
+        let parameter_buffer = buffer_with_contents(parameter_bytes, wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM);
+        let input_buffer = buffer_with_contents(input_bytes, wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE);
+        let descriptor_buffer = buffer_with_contents(descriptor_bytes, wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE);
+        let outcome_usage = wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_SRC;
+        let table_driven_outcomes = buffer_with_contents(outcome_fill, outcome_usage);
+        let bitwise_outcomes = buffer_with_contents(outcome_fill, outcome_usage);
+        let readback_buffer = || {
+            device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
+                label: None,
+                size: outcome_bytes,
+                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::MAP_READ | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
+                mapped_at_creation: false,
+            })
+        };
+        let table_driven_readback = readback_buffer();
+        let bitwise_readback = readback_buffer();
+        let bind_group_of = |pipeline: &wgpu::ComputePipeline, outcome_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer| {
+            device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
+                label: None,
+                layout: &pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0),
+                entries: &[
+                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
+                        binding: 0,
+                        resource: parameter_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
+                    },
+                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
+                        binding: 1,
+                        resource: input_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
+                    },
+                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
+                        binding: 2,
+                        resource: descriptor_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
+                    },
+                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
+                        binding: 3,
+                        resource: outcome_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
+                    },
+                ],
+            })
+        };
+        let table_driven_bind_group =
+            bind_group_of(&self.table_driven_pipeline, &table_driven_outcomes);
+        let bitwise_bind_group = bind_group_of(&self.bitwise_pipeline, &bitwise_outcomes);
+        let workgroups = entry_count.div_ceil(INVOCATIONS_PER_WORKGROUP);
+        let mut encoder =
+            device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor { label: None });
+        {
+            let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
+                label: None,
+                timestamp_writes: None,
+            });
+            pass.set_pipeline(&self.table_driven_pipeline);
+            pass.set_bind_group(0, &table_driven_bind_group, &[]);
+            pass.dispatch_workgroups(workgroups, 1, 1);
+            pass.set_pipeline(&self.bitwise_pipeline);
+            pass.set_bind_group(0, &bitwise_bind_group, &[]);
+            pass.dispatch_workgroups(workgroups, 1, 1);
+        }
+        encoder.copy_buffer_to_buffer(
+            &table_driven_outcomes,
+            0,
+            &table_driven_readback,
+            0,
+            outcome_bytes,
+        );
+        encoder.copy_buffer_to_buffer(&bitwise_outcomes, 0, &bitwise_readback, 0, outcome_bytes);
+        let submission = self.queue.submit(std::iter::once(encoder.finish()));
+        let (mapping_sender, mapping_receiver) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
+        for readback in [&table_driven_readback, &bitwise_readback] {
+            let sender_for_this_readback = mapping_sender.clone();
+            readback
+                .slice(..)
+                .map_async(wgpu::MapMode::Read, move |mapping_outcome| {
+                    // 送不出去只有一种：收的那一头已经丢了（这一批已经按出错交回），这次映射的结局没人要
+                    let _nobody_waits_for_this_mapping_any_more =
+                        sender_for_this_readback.send(mapping_outcome);
+                });
+        }
+        drop(mapping_sender);
+        let polled = device.poll(wgpu::PollType::Wait {
+            submission_index: Some(submission),
+            timeout: None,
+        });
+        if let Some(reason) = fault_taken_from_the_record(&self.fault_reported_by_wgpu) {
+            return Err(GpuFailureCause::UncapturedErrorOrDeviceLost { reason });
+        }
+        if let Err(error) = polled {
+            return Err(GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheSubmissionFailed {
+                reason: format!("{error}"),
+            });
+        }
+        for _readback in [&table_driven_readback, &bitwise_readback] {
+            match mapping_receiver.recv() {
+                Ok(Ok(())) => {}
+                Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                    return Err(GpuFailureCause::ReadbackMappingFailed {
+                        reason: format!("{error}"),
+                    })
+                }
+                Err(_all_senders_dropped) => {
+                    return Err(GpuFailureCause::ReadbackMappingFailed {
+                        reason: "等完了提交，映射的回调还没送到".to_string(),
+                    })
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        let table_driven = outcomes_read_back_from(&table_driven_readback)?;
+        let bitwise = outcomes_read_back_from(&bitwise_readback)?;
+        Ok(table_driven.into_iter().zip(bitwise).collect())
+    }
+}
+
+fn outcomes_read_back_from(
+    readback: &wgpu::Buffer,
+) -> Result<Vec<ChecksumKernelOutcome>, GpuFailureCause> {
+    let decoded = {
+        let mapped = readback.slice(..).get_mapped_range().map_err(|error| {
+            GpuFailureCause::ReadbackMappingFailed {
+                reason: format!("{error}"),
+            }
+        })?;
+        decoded_kernel_outcomes(&mapped)
+    };
+    readback.unmap();
+    decoded.map_err(GpuFailureCause::KernelLeftAnUnrecognizedVerdictWord)
+}
+
+impl BackgroundGpu {
+    /// 参与的卡，按卡的次序，带挂载时量出的一次提交的主机 CPU 时间。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn participating_gpus(&self) -> Vec<ParticipatingGpuReport> {
+        self.gpus_in_use
+            .iter()
+            .map(|gpu_in_use| ParticipatingGpuReport {
+                identifier: gpu_in_use.participating.discrete_gpu.identifier.clone(),
+                name: gpu_in_use.participating.discrete_gpu.name.clone(),
+                memory_limit: gpu_in_use.participating.memory_limit,
+                measured_cost: gpu_in_use.measured_cost,
+            })
+            .collect()
+    }
+
+    /// 一批单元交两份核各算一遍，交回每条两份的结果（按交进来的次序），不比对、不动计数：对拍与 [`Self::verify_unit_checksums`] 都用它。
+    /// 按量出的代价分给各卡（每张卡一段相连的条目），每张卡上再按显存上限切段；先把各卡的切法都算完，有单元放不下就一张卡都不交。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`ChecksumBatchFailed`] 的两种。
+    pub fn both_kernel_outcomes_of_the_batch<EntryKey>(
+        &mut self,
+        units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, EntryKey>],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(ChecksumKernelOutcome, ChecksumKernelOutcome)>, ChecksumBatchFailed> {
+        let measured_costs: Vec<HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission> = self
+            .gpus_in_use
+            .iter()
+            .map(|gpu_in_use| gpu_in_use.measured_cost)
+            .collect();
+        let ranges_per_gpu = entry_ranges_per_gpu(&entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(
+            &measured_costs,
+            units.len(),
+        ));
+        let mut chunks_per_gpu = Vec::with_capacity(ranges_per_gpu.len());
+        for (gpu_in_use, range_of_the_gpu) in self.gpus_in_use.iter().zip(&ranges_per_gpu) {
+            let unit_lengths: Vec<u64> = units[range_of_the_gpu.clone()]
+                .iter()
+                .map(|unit| u64::try_from(unit.unit_bytes.len()).expect("装得进 u64"))
+                .collect();
+            let chunks = chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(
+                &unit_lengths,
+                CHECKSUM_CHUNK_FOOTPRINT,
+                gpu_in_use.chunk_bounds,
+            )
+            .map_err(
+                |EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                     entry_position,
+                     input_bytes,
+                 }| ChecksumBatchFailed::UnitLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                    device: gpu_in_use.participating.discrete_gpu.identifier.clone(),
+                    entry_position: range_of_the_gpu.start + entry_position,
+                    unit_bytes: input_bytes,
+                },
+            )?;
+            chunks_per_gpu.push(chunks);
+        }
+        let mut outcomes = Vec::with_capacity(units.len());
+        for ((gpu_in_use, range_of_the_gpu), chunks) in self
+            .gpus_in_use
+            .iter_mut()
+            .zip(&ranges_per_gpu)
+            .zip(chunks_per_gpu)
+        {
+            let units_of_the_gpu = &units[range_of_the_gpu.clone()];
+            for chunk in chunks {
+                let chunk_outcomes = gpu_in_use
+                    .both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk(&units_of_the_gpu[chunk])
+                    .map_err(|cause| ChecksumBatchFailed::GpuFailed {
+                        device: gpu_in_use.participating.discrete_gpu.identifier.clone(),
+                        cause,
+                    })?;
+                outcomes.extend(chunk_outcomes);
+            }
+        }
+        assert_eq!(
+            outcomes.len(),
+            units.len(),
+            "每条都有两份结果，按卡的次序接回"
+        );
+        Ok(outcomes)
+    }
+
+    /// 扫描里的校验和核对一批（第 8 条）：两份核各算一遍、逐条比对；连续不确定到 N 轮的条目交核心层的 CRC-32C 现判。
+    /// 交回逐条的判定与确认、不确定、交 CPU 判三个计数。GPU 出错时交回出错，`uncertainty` 不动。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`ChecksumBatchFailed`] 的两种。
+    pub fn verify_unit_checksums<EntryKey: Eq + std::hash::Hash + Clone>(
+        &mut self,
+        units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, EntryKey>],
+        uncertainty: &mut ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<EntryKey>,
+    ) -> Result<ReconciledBatch<ChecksumKernelOutcome>, ChecksumBatchFailed> {
+        let outcomes = self.both_kernel_outcomes_of_the_batch(units)?;
+        let entries = units
+            .iter()
+            .zip(outcomes)
+            .map(
+                |(unit, (table_driven, bitwise))| TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry {
+                    entry_key: unit.entry_key.clone(),
+                    outcome_by_one_kernel: table_driven,
+                    outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: bitwise,
+                },
+            )
+            .collect();
+        Ok(
+            uncertainty.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(entries, |entry_position| {
+                cpu_reference_outcome(
+                    units[entry_position].unit_bytes,
+                    units[entry_position].expected_crc32c,
+                )
+            }),
+        )
+    }
+}
+
+/// 这条线程到此刻用掉的 CPU 时间（`CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID`）：线程睡着、等 GPU 时不走。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// `clock_gettime` 报错：Linux 上这个钟总在。
+#[must_use]
+#[allow(unsafe_code, reason = "std 没有线程 CPU 钟，只能调 clock_gettime(2)")]
+pub fn host_cpu_time_of_this_thread() -> std::time::Duration {
+    let mut thread_cpu_time = libc::timespec {
+        tv_sec: 0,
+        tv_nsec: 0,
+    };
+    // SAFETY: `thread_cpu_time` 是这个栈帧里一个初始化过的 `timespec`，`clock_gettime` 只往它里面写，调用期间没有别的引用。
+    let status =
+        unsafe { libc::clock_gettime(libc::CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, &raw mut thread_cpu_time) };
+    assert_eq!(
+        status, 0,
+        "clock_gettime(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID) 在 Linux 上总读得到"
+    );
+    std::time::Duration::new(
+        u64::try_from(thread_cpu_time.tv_sec).expect("CPU 时间的秒数不为负"),
+        u32::try_from(thread_cpu_time.tv_nsec).expect("纳秒部分在 0 到 10^9 之间"),
+    )
+}
+
+/// 阻塞等一个 wgpu 的 future 交出结果（枚举适配器、起设备）：轮询它，没好就把这条线程挂起，等它的唤醒把线程叫回来。
+/// 本机的 wgpu 后端这几个 future 一轮询就好；不依赖 `pollster`。
+pub fn wait_for_the_wgpu_future<Output>(future: impl Future<Output = Output>) -> Output {
+    let waker = Waker::from(Arc::new(UnparkTheWaitingThread(std::thread::current())));
+    let mut context = Context::from_waker(&waker);
+    let mut pinned_future = std::pin::pin!(future);
+    loop {
+        match pinned_future.as_mut().poll(&mut context) {
+            Poll::Ready(output) => return output,
+            Poll::Pending => std::thread::park(),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+struct UnparkTheWaitingThread(std::thread::Thread);
+
+impl Wake for UnparkTheWaitingThread {
+    fn wake(self: Arc<Self>) {
+        self.0.unpark();
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    /// 没被叫醒过时交 Pending 并当场叫醒自己，再被轮询时交出结果。
+    struct ReadyAfterWakingItselfOnce {
+        polled_before: bool,
+    }
+
+    impl Future for ReadyAfterWakingItselfOnce {
+        type Output = u32;
+
+        fn poll(mut self: std::pin::Pin<&mut Self>, context: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<u32> {
+            if self.polled_before {
+                return Poll::Ready(42);
+            }
+            self.polled_before = true;
+            context.waker().wake_by_ref();
+            Poll::Pending
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn waiting_for_a_future_that_is_pending_once_returns_its_output() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            wait_for_the_wgpu_future(ReadyAfterWakingItselfOnce {
+                polled_before: false
+            }),
+            42
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn the_thread_cpu_clock_does_not_advance_while_the_thread_sleeps() {
+        let sleep = std::time::Duration::from_millis(300);
+        let cpu_time_before = host_cpu_time_of_this_thread();
+        std::thread::sleep(sleep);
+        let cpu_time_spent = host_cpu_time_of_this_thread().saturating_sub(cpu_time_before);
+        assert!(
+            cpu_time_spent < sleep / 3,
+            "睡 {sleep:?} 只用掉 {cpu_time_spent:?} 的 CPU：量的是线程 CPU 时间，不是挂钟"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn the_thread_cpu_clock_advances_while_the_thread_computes() {
+        let cpu_time_before = host_cpu_time_of_this_thread();
+        let mut accumulator: u64 = 0;
+        let mut rounds: u64 = 0;
+        while host_cpu_time_of_this_thread().saturating_sub(cpu_time_before)
+            < std::time::Duration::from_millis(20)
+        {
+            for step in 0..10_000_u64 {
+                accumulator = accumulator
+                    .wrapping_mul(6_364_136_223_846_793_005)
+                    .wrapping_add(step);
+            }
+            rounds += 1;
+            assert!(
+                rounds < 1_000_000,
+                "算了这么多轮线程 CPU 钟还没走 20 ms：钟没在走"
+            );
+        }
+        std::hint::black_box(accumulator);
+    }
+}
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernel_bitwise.wgsl
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+// 扫描里的校验和核对，两份独立核里按 32 位字逐位移算的那一份（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 8 条：两份核不共用核函数）。
+// 每条一个调用：这一条开头不在字边界上的几个字节逐字节吸进寄存器，中间整字一次异或进寄存器再移 32 位，尾巴几个字节再逐字节吸，
+// 每一位都按「最低位为 1 就异或多项式」用掩码算，不查表、不用工作组内存。
+// 另一份（checksum_kernel_table_driven.wgsl）按字节查表；两份只共用缓冲的布局，布局由 src/checksum_kernels.rs 定。
+
+struct DescriptorOfAnEntry {
+    starting_byte: u32,
+    length_in_bytes: u32,
+    crc32c_stored_for_the_entry: u32,
+}
+
+struct OutcomeOfAnEntry {
+    crc32c_of_the_bytes: u32,
+    word_saying_whether_it_matches: u32,
+}
+
+@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> number_of_entries_in_the_chunk: u32;
+@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> packed_unit_bytes: array<u32>;
+@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> descriptors_of_the_entries: array<DescriptorOfAnEntry>;
+@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read_write> outcomes_of_the_entries: array<OutcomeOfAnEntry>;
+
+// CRC-32C（Castagnoli）反射多项式。
+const REFLECTED_CASTAGNOLI_POLYNOMIAL: u32 = 0x82F63B78u;
+
+// 移一位：最低位是 1 时掩码全 1、异或多项式，是 0 时掩码全 0。
+fn shift_the_register_by_one_bit(register_before: u32) -> u32 {
+    let mask_when_the_lowest_bit_is_set = 0u - (register_before & 1u);
+    return (register_before >> 1u) ^ (REFLECTED_CASTAGNOLI_POLYNOMIAL & mask_when_the_lowest_bit_is_set);
+}
+
+fn absorb_one_byte(register_before: u32, byte_value: u32) -> u32 {
+    var register_after = register_before ^ byte_value;
+    for (var shifted_bits = 0u; shifted_bits < 8u; shifted_bits = shifted_bits + 1u) {
+        register_after = shift_the_register_by_one_bit(register_after);
+    }
+    return register_after;
+}
+
+fn byte_at(byte_address: u32) -> u32 {
+    let word_holding_it = packed_unit_bytes[byte_address / 4u];
+    return extractBits(word_holding_it, (byte_address % 4u) * 8u, 8u);
+}
+
+@compute @workgroup_size(64)
+fn crc32c_by_shifting_whole_words(@builtin(global_invocation_id) invocation: vec3<u32>) {
+    let entry_number = invocation.x;
+    if (entry_number >= number_of_entries_in_the_chunk) {
+        return;
+    }
+    let descriptor = descriptors_of_the_entries[entry_number];
+    let byte_address_past_the_entry = descriptor.starting_byte + descriptor.length_in_bytes;
+    var crc_register = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    var byte_address = descriptor.starting_byte;
+    // 开头不在字边界上的那几个字节
+    while (byte_address < byte_address_past_the_entry && (byte_address % 4u) != 0u) {
+        crc_register = absorb_one_byte(crc_register, byte_at(byte_address));
+        byte_address = byte_address + 1u;
+    }
+    // 中间的整字：小端的一个字等于依次吸进它的四个字节
+    while (byte_address_past_the_entry - byte_address >= 4u) {
+        crc_register = crc_register ^ packed_unit_bytes[byte_address / 4u];
+        for (var shifted_bits = 0u; shifted_bits < 32u; shifted_bits = shifted_bits + 1u) {
+            crc_register = shift_the_register_by_one_bit(crc_register);
+        }
+        byte_address = byte_address + 4u;
+    }
+    // 尾巴
+    while (byte_address < byte_address_past_the_entry) {
+        crc_register = absorb_one_byte(crc_register, byte_at(byte_address));
+        byte_address = byte_address + 1u;
+    }
+    let crc32c_of_the_bytes = ~crc_register;
+    outcomes_of_the_entries[entry_number] = OutcomeOfAnEntry(
+        crc32c_of_the_bytes,
+        select(0u, 1u, crc32c_of_the_bytes == descriptor.crc32c_stored_for_the_entry),
+    );
+}

+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernels.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,308 @@
+//! 扫描里的校验和核对（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1 条点名的三段里的「甲」）：两份独立写的 WGSL 核（第 8 条，不共用核函数），
+//! 各自对同一批单元字节算 CRC-32C 并与期望值比。这里是两份核共用的缓冲布局、打包与回读解码，都是纯函数；起 GPU 的在 `background_gpu`。
+//!
+//! 缓冲布局（两份核按同一个绑定号读写，各有各的输出缓冲）：
+//! - 绑定 0，uniform：这一段的条数（一个 `u32`，缓冲占 [`PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES`]）。
+//! - 绑定 1，只读存储：这一段每条的单元字节首尾相接，不对齐、不留空，末尾补 0 到 4 字节的整数倍；着色器按小端 `u32` 读。
+//! - 绑定 2，只读存储：每条一项描述，三个 `u32`：在输入里的起点字节、字节数、期望的 CRC-32C。
+//! - 绑定 3，读写存储：每条一项结果，两个 `u32`：算出的 CRC-32C、判定字（1 是与期望相同，0 是不同）。
+//!   开算之前整块填 [`OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD`]：核没写到的那一条读回来判定字不是 0 也不是 1，按 GPU 出错交回。
+
+use crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::ChunkFootprint;
+
+/// 按字节查表的那一份核（`crc32c_by_byte_remainder_table`）。
+pub const TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_SOURCE: &str = include_str!("checksum_kernel_table_driven.wgsl");
+pub const TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT: &str = "crc32c_by_byte_remainder_table";
+/// 按 32 位字逐位移算的那一份核（`crc32c_by_shifting_whole_words`）。
+pub const BITWISE_KERNEL_SOURCE: &str = include_str!("checksum_kernel_bitwise.wgsl");
+pub const BITWISE_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT: &str = "crc32c_by_shifting_whole_words";
+
+/// 两份核的工作组都是 64 个调用（两份 WGSL 里的 `@workgroup_size(64)`），每条一个调用。
+pub const INVOCATIONS_PER_WORKGROUP: u32 = 64;
+/// 参数缓冲占的字节数：着色器只读开头一个 `u32`，缓冲按 16 字节建（uniform 缓冲的常见最小对齐）。
+pub const PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES: u64 = 16;
+/// 每条描述三个 `u32`。
+pub const DESCRIPTOR_WORDS_PER_ENTRY: usize = 3;
+pub const DESCRIPTOR_BYTES_PER_ENTRY: u64 = 12;
+/// 每条结果两个 `u32`。
+pub const OUTCOME_WORDS_PER_ENTRY: usize = 2;
+pub const OUTCOME_BYTES_PER_ENTRY: u64 = 8;
+/// 结果缓冲开算之前的填充字：判定字只会被核写成 0 或 1。
+pub const OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;
+const VERDICT_WORD_MATCHES: u32 = 1;
+const VERDICT_WORD_DOES_NOT_MATCH: u32 = 0;
+/// 两份核各一个结果缓冲与一个回读暂存缓冲。
+const OUTCOME_AND_READBACK_BUFFERS: u64 = 4;
+
+/// 校验和核对一段在卡上占的：参数缓冲；每条一项描述、两份核各一项结果与一项回读暂存。按条排的最大缓冲是描述那一个。
+pub const CHECKSUM_CHUNK_FOOTPRINT: ChunkFootprint = ChunkFootprint {
+    bytes_per_chunk_besides_the_entries: PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES,
+    bytes_per_entry_besides_its_input: DESCRIPTOR_BYTES_PER_ENTRY
+        + OUTCOME_AND_READBACK_BUFFERS * OUTCOME_BYTES_PER_ENTRY,
+    bytes_per_entry_in_the_largest_entry_buffer: DESCRIPTOR_BYTES_PER_ENTRY,
+};
+
+/// 要核的一个单元：调用方给的条目键（同一单元在下一轮还用同一个键，连续不确定按它数）、单元字节、期望的 CRC-32C。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct UnitChecksumToVerify<'unit, EntryKey> {
+    pub entry_key: EntryKey,
+    pub unit_bytes: &'unit [u8],
+    pub expected_crc32c: u32,
+}
+
+/// 一份核对一条交回的结果。两份核逐条比的就是它（两样都比：算出的值不同、判定相同也算不确定）。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+    pub computed_crc32c: u32,
+    pub matches_the_expected_crc32c: bool,
+}
+
+/// 打包好的一段：输入字节（已补到 4 字节的整数倍）与描述的字。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct PackedChecksumChunk {
+    pub input_bytes: Vec<u8>,
+    pub descriptor_words: Vec<u32>,
+}
+
+impl PackedChecksumChunk {
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn entry_count(&self) -> usize {
+        self.descriptor_words.len() / DESCRIPTOR_WORDS_PER_ENTRY
+    }
+
+    /// 描述按小端字节交给缓冲。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn descriptor_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
+        self.descriptor_words
+            .iter()
+            .flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes())
+            .collect()
+    }
+}
+
+/// 把一段单元按次序首尾相接打包：每个单元的起点就是前面那些单元字节数之和，不按字对齐（着色器按字节取）。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 一段的输入超过 `u32` 能表示的字节数：切批按绑定上限切过（外壳把绑定上限压在 `u32` 之内）。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn packed_checksum_chunk<EntryKey>(
+    units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, EntryKey>],
+) -> PackedChecksumChunk {
+    let total_unit_bytes: usize = units.iter().map(|unit| unit.unit_bytes.len()).sum();
+    let padded_bytes = crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::input_buffer_bytes(
+        u64::try_from(total_unit_bytes).expect("usize 装得进 u64"),
+    );
+    let mut input_bytes =
+        Vec::with_capacity(usize::try_from(padded_bytes).expect("一段的输入装得进内存"));
+    let mut descriptor_words = Vec::with_capacity(units.len() * DESCRIPTOR_WORDS_PER_ENTRY);
+    for unit in units {
+        let byte_offset = u32::try_from(input_bytes.len())
+            .expect("一段的输入不超过 u32 字节：切批按绑定上限切过");
+        let byte_length = u32::try_from(unit.unit_bytes.len())
+            .expect("一个单元不超过 u32 字节：切批按绑定上限切过");
+        input_bytes.extend_from_slice(unit.unit_bytes);
+        descriptor_words.extend_from_slice(&[byte_offset, byte_length, unit.expected_crc32c]);
+    }
+    input_bytes.resize(
+        usize::try_from(padded_bytes).expect("一段的输入装得进内存"),
+        0,
+    );
+    PackedChecksumChunk {
+        input_bytes,
+        descriptor_words,
+    }
+}
+
+/// 结果缓冲开算之前的内容：每个字都是填充字。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn outcome_buffer_before_the_kernel_writes(entry_count: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
+    std::iter::repeat_n(
+        OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD.to_le_bytes(),
+        entry_count * OUTCOME_WORDS_PER_ENTRY,
+    )
+    .flatten()
+    .collect()
+}
+
+/// 读回的一条结果判定字不是 0 也不是 1：核没写到这一条（还是填充字）或写坏了，这一批按 GPU 出错交回。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct UnrecognizedVerdictWord {
+    pub entry_position: usize,
+    pub verdict_word: u32,
+}
+
+/// 把读回的结果字节解成每条一个结果。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 某一条的判定字认不得（[`UnrecognizedVerdictWord`]）。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 字节数不是每条 8 字节的整数倍：回读缓冲按条数建，长度对不上是外壳的 bug。
+pub fn decoded_kernel_outcomes(
+    readback_bytes: &[u8],
+) -> Result<Vec<ChecksumKernelOutcome>, UnrecognizedVerdictWord> {
+    let (outcome_records, leftover_bytes) = readback_bytes.as_chunks::<8>();
+    assert!(
+        leftover_bytes.is_empty(),
+        "回读的字节数是每条 8 字节的整数倍"
+    );
+    outcome_records
+        .iter()
+        .enumerate()
+        .map(|(entry_position, outcome_record)| {
+            let computed_crc32c = u32::from_le_bytes([
+                outcome_record[0],
+                outcome_record[1],
+                outcome_record[2],
+                outcome_record[3],
+            ]);
+            let verdict_word = u32::from_le_bytes([
+                outcome_record[4],
+                outcome_record[5],
+                outcome_record[6],
+                outcome_record[7],
+            ]);
+            let matches_the_expected_crc32c = match verdict_word {
+                VERDICT_WORD_MATCHES => true,
+                VERDICT_WORD_DOES_NOT_MATCH => false,
+                unrecognized_verdict_word => {
+                    return Err(UnrecognizedVerdictWord {
+                        entry_position,
+                        verdict_word: unrecognized_verdict_word,
+                    })
+                }
+            };
+            Ok(ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+                computed_crc32c,
+                matches_the_expected_crc32c,
+            })
+        })
+        .collect()
+}
+
+/// CPU 那一份实现对一条的判定（连续不确定的条目交它判；对拍也拿它当参照）：核心层的 CRC-32C。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn cpu_reference_outcome(unit_bytes: &[u8], expected_crc32c: u32) -> ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+    let computed_crc32c = singlefs_core::checksum::crc32_castagnoli(unit_bytes);
+    ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+        computed_crc32c,
+        matches_the_expected_crc32c: computed_crc32c == expected_crc32c,
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    fn unit(unit_bytes: &[u8], expected_crc32c: u32) -> UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, u32> {
+        UnitChecksumToVerify {
+            entry_key: expected_crc32c,
+            unit_bytes,
+            expected_crc32c,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn units_are_packed_end_to_end_at_unaligned_offsets_and_padded_to_a_whole_word() {
+        let packed = packed_checksum_chunk(&[
+            unit(&[0xA1], 11),
+            unit(&[0xB1, 0xB2, 0xB3, 0xB4, 0xB5, 0xB6, 0xB7], 22),
+            unit(&[], 33),
+            unit(&[0xC1, 0xC2, 0xC3], 44),
+        ]);
+        assert_eq!(
+            packed.input_bytes,
+            vec![0xA1, 0xB1, 0xB2, 0xB3, 0xB4, 0xB5, 0xB6, 0xB7, 0xC1, 0xC2, 0xC3, 0x00],
+            "首尾相接，末尾补到 12 字节"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            packed.descriptor_words,
+            vec![0, 1, 11, 1, 7, 22, 8, 0, 33, 8, 3, 44],
+            "起点按前面的字节数累加：1、8 都不在字边界上"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(packed.entry_count(), 4);
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_chunk_of_empty_units_still_has_a_four_byte_input() {
+        let packed = packed_checksum_chunk(&[unit(&[], 0)]);
+        assert_eq!(
+            packed.input_bytes,
+            vec![0, 0, 0, 0],
+            "wgpu 不许长度为 0 的绑定"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn descriptor_bytes_are_little_endian_words() {
+        let packed = packed_checksum_chunk(&[unit(&[0xEE], 0x0102_0304)]);
+        assert_eq!(
+            packed.descriptor_bytes(),
+            vec![0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0x04, 0x03, 0x02, 0x01]
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn readback_records_decode_into_computed_checksums_and_verdicts() {
+        let mut readback = Vec::new();
+        readback.extend_from_slice(&0xE306_9283_u32.to_le_bytes());
+        readback.extend_from_slice(&1_u32.to_le_bytes());
+        readback.extend_from_slice(&7_u32.to_le_bytes());
+        readback.extend_from_slice(&0_u32.to_le_bytes());
+        assert_eq!(
+            decoded_kernel_outcomes(&readback),
+            Ok(vec![
+                ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+                    computed_crc32c: 0xE306_9283,
+                    matches_the_expected_crc32c: true
+                },
+                ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+                    computed_crc32c: 7,
+                    matches_the_expected_crc32c: false
+                },
+            ])
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn an_outcome_the_kernel_never_wrote_is_an_unrecognized_verdict_word() {
+        let mut readback = Vec::new();
+        readback.extend_from_slice(&5_u32.to_le_bytes());
+        readback.extend_from_slice(&1_u32.to_le_bytes());
+        readback.extend_from_slice(&outcome_buffer_before_the_kernel_writes(1));
+        assert_eq!(
+            decoded_kernel_outcomes(&readback),
+            Err(UnrecognizedVerdictWord {
+                entry_position: 1,
+                verdict_word: OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD
+            }),
+            "位置 1 的那一条还是填充字：核没写到它"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn the_cpu_reference_outcome_uses_the_core_crc32c() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            cpu_reference_outcome(b"123456789", 0xE306_9283),
+            ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+                computed_crc32c: 0xE306_9283,
+                matches_the_expected_crc32c: true
+            },
+            "CRC-32C 的检验值"
+        );
+        assert!(!cpu_reference_outcome(b"123456789", 0).matches_the_expected_crc32c);
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn the_two_kernels_are_separate_sources_with_their_own_entry_points() {
+        assert!(
+            TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_SOURCE.contains(&format!("fn {TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT}("))
+        );
+        assert!(BITWISE_KERNEL_SOURCE.contains(&format!("fn {BITWISE_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT}(")));
+        assert!(
+            !BITWISE_KERNEL_SOURCE.contains(TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT)
+                && !TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_SOURCE.contains(BITWISE_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT),
+            "两份核不互相引用"
+        );
+    }
+}
```
