@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+// 扫描里的校验和核对，两份独立核里按字节查表的那一份（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 8 条：两份核不共用核函数）。
+// 每条一个调用：从输入里取这一条的字节，逐字节查 256 项余式表算 CRC-32C，与期望值比，写回算出的值与判定。
+// 余式表不抄常数：每个工作组开头按多项式现算进工作组内存（每个调用算 4 项），屏障之后再用。
+// 另一份（checksum_kernel_bitwise.wgsl）按 32 位字逐位移算，不查表；两份只共用缓冲的布局，布局由 src/checksum_kernels.rs 定。
+
+struct EntryDescriptor {
+    byte_offset: u32,
+    byte_length: u32,
+    expected_crc32c: u32,
+}
+
+struct KernelOutcome {
+    computed_crc32c: u32,
+    verdict_word: u32,
+}
+
+@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> entry_count_of_the_chunk: u32;
+@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> input_words: array<u32>;
+@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> entry_descriptors: array<EntryDescriptor>;
+@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read_write> kernel_outcomes: array<KernelOutcome>;
+
+// CRC-32C（Castagnoli）反射多项式。
+const CASTAGNOLI_REFLECTED_POLYNOMIAL: u32 = 0x82F63B78u;
+const INVOCATIONS_PER_WORKGROUP: u32 = 64u;
+const REMAINDER_TABLE_ENTRIES: u32 = 256u;
+const VERDICT_WORD_MATCHES: u32 = 1u;
+const VERDICT_WORD_DOES_NOT_MATCH: u32 = 0u;
+
+var<workgroup> byte_remainder_table: array<u32, 256>;
+
+@compute @workgroup_size(64)
+fn crc32c_by_byte_remainder_table(
+    @builtin(global_invocation_id) global_invocation: vec3<u32>,
+    @builtin(local_invocation_index) invocation_in_the_workgroup: u32,
+) {
+    for (var table_slot = invocation_in_the_workgroup; table_slot < REMAINDER_TABLE_ENTRIES; table_slot = table_slot + INVOCATIONS_PER_WORKGROUP) {
+        var remainder = table_slot;
+        for (var bit_round = 0u; bit_round < 8u; bit_round = bit_round + 1u) {
+            if ((remainder & 1u) == 1u) {
+                remainder = (remainder >> 1u) ^ CASTAGNOLI_REFLECTED_POLYNOMIAL;
+            } else {
+                remainder = remainder >> 1u;
+            }
+        }
+        byte_remainder_table[table_slot] = remainder;
+    }
+    workgroupBarrier();
+
+    let entry_position = global_invocation.x;
+    if (entry_position >= entry_count_of_the_chunk) {
+        return;
+    }
+    let descriptor = entry_descriptors[entry_position];
+    let end_of_the_entry = descriptor.byte_offset + descriptor.byte_length;
+    var crc_register = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    for (var byte_position = descriptor.byte_offset; byte_position < end_of_the_entry; byte_position = byte_position + 1u) {
+        let containing_word = input_words[byte_position >> 2u];
+        let byte_of_the_entry = (containing_word >> ((byte_position & 3u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
+        crc_register = (crc_register >> 8u) ^ byte_remainder_table[(crc_register ^ byte_of_the_entry) & 0xFFu];
+    }
+    let computed_crc32c = crc_register ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu;
+    var verdict_word = VERDICT_WORD_DOES_NOT_MATCH;
+    if (computed_crc32c == descriptor.expected_crc32c) {
+        verdict_word = VERDICT_WORD_MATCHES;
+    }
+    kernel_outcomes[entry_position] = KernelOutcome(computed_crc32c, verdict_word);
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+//! 产品的后台 GPU 路径（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1–4、8 条）。核心层不依赖本包：挂载时由调用方把本包的实现递进去。
+//!
+//! 分两层：
+//! - 纯逻辑，不要 GPU：哪些适配器算显卡与挂载那一刻的校验（[`adapter_inventory`]）、按每张卡量出的代价分活（[`work_split_by_measured_cost`]）、
+//!   显存上限与切批（[`memory_limit_and_chunks`]）、两份核的比对与连续不确定计数（[`two_kernel_reconciliation`]，与哪一段无关）、

+//! - 起 GPU 的外壳（[`background_gpu`]）：枚举 wgpu 适配器、在参与的卡上起设备、量一次提交的主机 CPU 时间、交一批校验和核对。
+//!
+//! 与 checker 档的 GPU 判器不共用任何代码（`#[path]`、`include!` 也不用；门禁 checker-independence-and-sync 的 checker-implementation-disjoint 格第 ⑧ 条）：
+//! 两边共用一段写错的代码时，判器与被判的产品路径会一起错，GPU 对拍照样全绿。
+//!

+#![deny(unsafe_code)]
+
+pub mod adapter_inventory;
+pub mod background_gpu;
+pub mod checksum_kernels;
+pub mod memory_limit_and_chunks;
+pub mod two_kernel_reconciliation;
+pub mod work_split_by_measured_cost;

+//! 显存上限与切批（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 3 条）：每张卡上本包占的缓冲（输入、输出、暂存一起）任何时刻不超过那张卡的上限，
+//! 一批放不下就切成几次交，不给上限就不设限（只受这张卡的绑定上限与派发上限管）。
+//!
+//! 切法是纯函数（[`chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu`]）；外壳每建一个缓冲先在这张卡的账上记下（[`GpuMemoryAccount::hold`]），
+//! 记下之后超过上限就断言：切批算对了就走不到那一步，走到了是切批的 bug，不带着超限往下跑。
+
+use singlefs_core::background_compute::GpuMemoryInBytes;
+
+/// GPU 缓冲的字节数要按 4 字节对齐（wgpu 的 `COPY_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT`；着色器里输入按 `array<u32>` 读）。
+pub const GPU_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT_IN_BYTES: u64 = 4;
+
+/// 输入缓冲的字节数：输入字节按 4 字节向上取整；一个字节都没有时也占 4 字节（wgpu 不许绑定长度为 0 的缓冲）。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn input_buffer_bytes(input_bytes: u64) -> u64 {
+    input_bytes
+        .max(GPU_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT_IN_BYTES)
+        .div_ceil(GPU_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT_IN_BYTES)
+        * GPU_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT_IN_BYTES
+}
+
+/// 一段（这一次交给一张卡的那几条）在卡上占多少：输入缓冲之外，每一条占的固定字节（描述、两份核的输出与回读暂存），
+/// 加上与条数无关的那几样（参数）。由每一段的核自己给（校验和核对那一段在 `checksum_kernels` 里）。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ChunkFootprint {
+    pub bytes_per_chunk_besides_the_entries: u64,
+    pub bytes_per_entry_besides_its_input: u64,
+    /// 每一条在它最大的那一个按条排的缓冲里占几字节：那个缓冲也要装得进这张卡的绑定上限。
+    pub bytes_per_entry_in_the_largest_entry_buffer: u64,
+}
+
+impl ChunkFootprint {
+    /// 这一段在卡上合占的字节数。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn bytes_held_by_a_chunk(&self, input_bytes: u64, entry_count: u64) -> u64 {
+        input_buffer_bytes(input_bytes)
+            + entry_count * self.bytes_per_entry_besides_its_input
+            + self.bytes_per_chunk_besides_the_entries
+    }
+}
+
+/// 一张卡上一段装得下多少：显存上限（不给是不设限）、单个缓冲能绑定的最大字节数、一次派发最多几条。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+    pub memory_limit: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+    pub largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: u64,
+    pub largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: u64,
+}
+
+/// 一条单独就装不进一段：条款只写了「一批放不下就切成几次交」，单个条目放不下怎么办没写，第一版不支持。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+    pub entry_position: usize,
+    pub input_bytes: u64,
+}
+
+/// 把一批（每条的输入字节数按批里的次序给）切成相连的几段，每段在卡上合占的字节不超过上限、输入与按条排的缓冲都装得进绑定上限、
+/// 条数不超过一次派发的上限。从前往后贪心：能装就装进当前这一段，装不下就另起一段。空批交回空。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 某一条单独成一段也装不下（[`EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu`]），一段都不交。
+pub fn chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(
+    entry_input_lengths_in_bytes: &[u64],
+    footprint: ChunkFootprint,
+    bounds: ChunkBoundsOfAGpu,
+) -> Result<Vec<std::ops::Range<usize>>, EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu> {
+    let fits = |input_bytes: u64, entry_count: u64| -> bool {
+        let within_the_memory_limit = bounds.memory_limit.is_none_or(|memory_limit| {
+            footprint.bytes_held_by_a_chunk(input_bytes, entry_count) <= memory_limit.0
+        });
+        within_the_memory_limit
+            && input_buffer_bytes(input_bytes) <= bounds.largest_storage_binding_in_bytes
+            && entry_count * footprint.bytes_per_entry_in_the_largest_entry_buffer
+                <= bounds.largest_storage_binding_in_bytes
+            && entry_count <= bounds.largest_entry_count_per_dispatch
+    };
+    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
+    let mut chunk_start = 0;
+    let mut chunk_input_bytes: u64 = 0;
+    for (entry_position, input_bytes) in entry_input_lengths_in_bytes.iter().copied().enumerate() {
+        let entry_count_with_this_entry =
+            u64::try_from(entry_position - chunk_start + 1).expect("条数装得进 u64");
+        if fits(chunk_input_bytes + input_bytes, entry_count_with_this_entry) {
+            chunk_input_bytes += input_bytes;
+            continue;
+        }
+        if !fits(input_bytes, 1) {
+            return Err(EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                entry_position,
+                input_bytes,
+            });
+        }
+        chunks.push(chunk_start..entry_position);
+        chunk_start = entry_position;
+        chunk_input_bytes = input_bytes;
+    }
+    if chunk_start < entry_input_lengths_in_bytes.len() {
+        chunks.push(chunk_start..entry_input_lengths_in_bytes.len());
+    }
+    Ok(chunks)
+}
+
+/// 一张卡上本包此刻占着的缓冲字节数与上限。外壳建缓冲之前记、丢缓冲之后放。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct GpuMemoryAccount {
+    memory_limit: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+    bytes_held: u64,
+}
+
+impl GpuMemoryAccount {
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn with_nothing_held(memory_limit: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            memory_limit,
+            bytes_held: 0,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn bytes_held(&self) -> u64 {
+        self.bytes_held
+    }
+
+    /// 记下要建的那个缓冲。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 记下之后超过上限：切批（[`chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu`]）按同一个上限切过，超了是切批与建缓冲对不上的 bug。
+    pub fn hold(&mut self, bytes: u64) {
+        let bytes_held_afterwards = self.bytes_held + bytes;
+        if let Some(memory_limit) = self.memory_limit {
+            assert!(
+                bytes_held_afterwards <= memory_limit.0,
+                "本包在这张卡上占的缓冲 {bytes_held_afterwards} 字节超过了上限 {} 字节：切批按同一个上限切过，这里超了是 bug",
+                memory_limit.0
+            );
+        }
+        self.bytes_held = bytes_held_afterwards;
+    }
+
+    /// 放掉丢掉的那几个缓冲。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 放的比记的多。
+    pub fn release(&mut self, bytes: u64) {
+        assert!(bytes <= self.bytes_held, "放掉的缓冲比记下的多");
+        self.bytes_held -= bytes;
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    /// 每条另占 40 字节、每段另占 16 字节、按条排的最大缓冲每条 16 字节：校验和核对那一段的量级，数是测试自己定的。
+    const FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST: ChunkFootprint = ChunkFootprint {
+        bytes_per_chunk_besides_the_entries: 16,
+        bytes_per_entry_besides_its_input: 40,
+        bytes_per_entry_in_the_largest_entry_buffer: 16,
+    };
+
+    fn bounds(memory_limit_in_bytes: Option<u64>) -> ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+        ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+            memory_limit: memory_limit_in_bytes.map(GpuMemoryInBytes),
+            largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: 1 << 30,
+            largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: 1 << 20,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn input_buffers_round_up_to_whole_words_and_never_have_zero_bytes() {
+        assert_eq!(input_buffer_bytes(0), 4);
+        assert_eq!(input_buffer_bytes(1), 4);
+        assert_eq!(input_buffer_bytes(4), 4);
+        assert_eq!(input_buffer_bytes(5), 8);
+        assert_eq!(input_buffer_bytes(4097), 4100);
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn without_a_memory_limit_a_batch_is_one_chunk() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(&[4096, 4096, 7, 0], FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST, bounds(None)),
+            Ok(std::iter::once(0..4).collect::<Vec<_>>()),
+            "不给上限就不设限：整批一段"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_batch_that_does_not_fit_the_memory_limit_is_cut_into_chunks_that_each_fit() {
+        let lengths = [100_u64, 100, 100, 100, 100];
+        // 两条一段：输入 200 字节、条目 80、参数 16，合 296；三条要 444
+        let memory_limit_in_bytes = 300;
+        let chunks = chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(
+            &lengths,
+            FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST,
+            bounds(Some(memory_limit_in_bytes)),
+        )
+        .expect("单条 156 字节装得下");
+        assert_eq!(chunks, vec![0..2, 2..4, 4..5], "两条一段，最后剩一条");
+        for chunk in &chunks {
+            let input_bytes: u64 = lengths[chunk.clone()].iter().sum();
+            let held = FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST.bytes_held_by_a_chunk(
+                input_bytes,
+                u64::try_from(chunk.len()).expect("装得进 u64"),
+            );
+            assert!(
+                held <= memory_limit_in_bytes,
+                "每一段合占 {held} 字节不超过上限 {memory_limit_in_bytes}"
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_chunk_exactly_at_the_memory_limit_is_kept_whole() {
+        // 两条 100 字节：200 + 80 + 16 = 296，正好等于上限也算装得下
+        assert_eq!(
+            chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(&[100, 100], FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST, bounds(Some(296))),
+            Ok(std::iter::once(0..2).collect::<Vec<_>>())
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(&[100, 100], FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST, bounds(Some(295))),
+            Ok(vec![0..1, 1..2]),
+            "少一个字节就切开"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn the_dispatch_and_binding_limits_also_cut_chunks() {
+        let dispatch_bound = ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+            memory_limit: None,
+            largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: 1 << 30,
+            largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: 3,
+        };
+        assert_eq!(
+            chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(&[1; 7], FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST, dispatch_bound),
+            Ok(vec![0..3, 3..6, 6..7]),
+            "一次派发最多 3 条"
+        );
+        let binding_bound = ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+            memory_limit: None,
+            largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: 8,
+            largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: 1 << 20,
+        };
+        assert_eq!(
+            chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(&[4, 4, 4], FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST, binding_bound),
+            Err(EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                entry_position: 0,
+                input_bytes: 4
+            }),
+            "一条在按条排的缓冲里就占 16 字节，超过 8 字节的绑定上限"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn an_entry_that_alone_exceeds_the_memory_limit_refuses_the_batch() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(&[10, 4096, 10], FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST, bounds(Some(1024))),
+            Err(EntryLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                entry_position: 1,
+                input_bytes: 4096
+            })
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn an_empty_batch_has_no_chunk() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(&[], FOOTPRINT_UNDER_TEST, bounds(Some(64))),
+            Ok(Vec::new())
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn holding_up_to_the_memory_limit_is_allowed_and_releasing_gives_it_back() {
+        let mut account = GpuMemoryAccount::with_nothing_held(Some(GpuMemoryInBytes(100)));
+        account.hold(60);
+        account.hold(40);
+        assert_eq!(account.bytes_held(), 100, "正好到上限");
+        account.release(100);
+        account.hold(100);
+        assert_eq!(account.bytes_held(), 100, "放掉之后又能占满");
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    #[should_panic(expected = "超过了上限")]
+    fn holding_past_the_memory_limit_panics() {
+        let mut account = GpuMemoryAccount::with_nothing_held(Some(GpuMemoryInBytes(100)));
+        account.hold(60);
+        account.hold(41);
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn without_a_memory_limit_holding_is_never_refused() {
+        let mut account = GpuMemoryAccount::with_nothing_held(None);
+        account.hold(u64::MAX / 2);
+        assert_eq!(account.bytes_held(), u64::MAX / 2);
+    }
+}

+//! 两份独立 GPU 核的比对与连续不确定计数（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 8 条；用户 2026-10-26 定「N=2，计数只放内存」）。
+//! 与哪一段无关：扫描里的校验和核对、区域扫描的单元头解析与映射反查、选段打分三段都交「每条两份核的结果」进来，结果是什么类型由那一段定。
+//!
+//! 逐条比两份的结果：相同算确认；不同算不确定，这一批不回收、不搬，留到下一轮重算；同一条目连续
+//! [`CONSECUTIVE_UNCERTAIN_ROUNDS_BEFORE_THE_CPU_REFERENCE_JUDGES`] 轮都不确定，交 CPU 那一份实现单独判一次，按 CPU 的判定处理。
+//! 计数只住在 [`ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts`] 这个对象里：丢掉它（重挂）就清零，不写盘。
+//! 一轮里确认或交 CPU 判过的条目，计数清零：「连续」从下一次不确定重新数起。没出现在这一批里的条目，计数原样留着。
+
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+use std::collections::HashSet;
+use std::hash::Hash;
+
+/// 第 8 条的 N：同一条目连续这么多轮不确定，交 CPU 判。
+pub const CONSECUTIVE_UNCERTAIN_ROUNDS_BEFORE_THE_CPU_REFERENCE_JUDGES: u32 = 2;
+
+/// 一条条目两份核各算出的结果。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry<EntryKey, KernelOutcome> {
+    pub entry_key: EntryKey,
+    pub outcome_by_one_kernel: KernelOutcome,
+    pub outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: KernelOutcome,
+}
+
+/// 一条条目这一轮的判定。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum EntryDecision<KernelOutcome> {
+    /// 两份核相同：照这个结果交 CPU 走发布路径。
+    ConfirmedByBothKernels(KernelOutcome),
+    /// 两份核不同：这一批不回收、不搬，下一轮重算。
+    UncertainThisRound,
+    /// 连续 N 轮不确定，CPU 那一份实现单独判出的结果：按它处理。
+    JudgedByTheCpuReference(KernelOutcome),
+}
+
+/// 一批的判定（按交进来的次序，一条一个）与三个计数；三个计数加起来等于条目数。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ReconciledBatch<KernelOutcome> {
+    pub decisions: Vec<EntryDecision<KernelOutcome>>,
+    pub confirmed_entries: usize,
+    pub uncertain_entries: usize,
+    pub entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference: usize,
+}
+
+/// 每个条目已经连续几轮不确定：只在内存里，随这个对象活。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<EntryKey> {
+    uncertain_rounds_by_entry: HashMap<EntryKey, u32>,
+}
+
+impl<EntryKey: Eq + Hash + Clone> ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<EntryKey> {
+    /// 挂载那一刻：没有一个条目不确定过。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn with_no_entry_uncertain() -> Self {
+        Self {
+            uncertain_rounds_by_entry: HashMap::new(),
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 这个条目此刻已经连续几轮不确定。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&self, entry_key: &EntryKey) -> u32 {
+        self.uncertain_rounds_by_entry
+            .get(entry_key)
+            .copied()
+            .unwrap_or(0)
+    }
+
+    /// 比一批两份核的结果、更新计数、交回判定。连续不确定到了 N 轮的那几条，调 `judge_with_the_cpu_reference`（参数是它在这一批里的位置）
+    /// 现判一次；别的条目不调它。GPU 出错、这一批放弃时不调这个函数：计数照旧。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 同一个条目在一批里出现两次：一批里每条一个条目，重复是调用方的 bug。
+    pub fn reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes<KernelOutcome: PartialEq>(
+        &mut self,
+        entries: Vec<TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry<EntryKey, KernelOutcome>>,
+        mut judge_with_the_cpu_reference: impl FnMut(usize) -> KernelOutcome,
+    ) -> ReconciledBatch<KernelOutcome> {
+        let mut entries_seen_in_this_batch: HashSet<EntryKey> =
+            HashSet::with_capacity(entries.len());
+        let mut decisions = Vec::with_capacity(entries.len());
+        let mut confirmed_entries = 0;
+        let mut uncertain_entries = 0;
+        let mut entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference = 0;
+        for (entry_position, entry) in entries.into_iter().enumerate() {
+            assert!(
+                entries_seen_in_this_batch.insert(entry.entry_key.clone()),
+                "同一个条目在一批里出现了两次"
+            );
+            if entry.outcome_by_one_kernel == entry.outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel {
+                self.uncertain_rounds_by_entry.remove(&entry.entry_key);
+                confirmed_entries += 1;
+                decisions.push(EntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(
+                    entry.outcome_by_one_kernel,
+                ));
+                continue;
+            }
+            let uncertain_rounds = self.consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&entry.entry_key) + 1;
+            if uncertain_rounds >= CONSECUTIVE_UNCERTAIN_ROUNDS_BEFORE_THE_CPU_REFERENCE_JUDGES {
+                self.uncertain_rounds_by_entry.remove(&entry.entry_key);
+                entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference += 1;
+                decisions.push(EntryDecision::JudgedByTheCpuReference(
+                    judge_with_the_cpu_reference(entry_position),
+                ));
+                continue;
+            }
+            self.uncertain_rounds_by_entry
+                .insert(entry.entry_key, uncertain_rounds);
+            uncertain_entries += 1;
+            decisions.push(EntryDecision::UncertainThisRound);
+        }
+        ReconciledBatch {
+            decisions,
+            confirmed_entries,
+            uncertain_entries,
+            entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    /// 假的条目：键是一个数，结果是一个数（两份核交回的数相同就算相同）。
+    fn entry(
+        entry_key: u32,
+        outcome_by_one_kernel: u32,
+        outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: u32,
+    ) -> TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry<u32, u32> {
+        TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry {
+            entry_key,
+            outcome_by_one_kernel,
+            outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// CPU 参照判出的结果固定是 900 加位置，测试认得出是不是它判的。
+    fn cpu_reference_outcome(entry_position: usize) -> u32 {
+        900 + u32::try_from(entry_position).expect("测试的批不大")
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn identical_outcomes_are_confirmed() {
+        let mut counts = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        let batch = counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(
+            vec![entry(1, 7, 7), entry(2, 0, 0)],
+            |_entry_position| panic!("两份核相同时不交 CPU 判"),
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            batch,
+            ReconciledBatch {
+                decisions: vec![
+                    EntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(7),
+                    EntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(0),
+                ],
+                confirmed_entries: 2,
+                uncertain_entries: 0,
+                entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference: 0,
+            }
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn different_outcomes_are_uncertain_for_one_round_without_asking_the_cpu() {
+        let mut counts = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        let batch = counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(
+            vec![entry(1, 7, 8), entry(2, 5, 5)],
+            |_entry_position| panic!("只不确定一轮时不交 CPU 判"),
+        );
+        assert_eq!(batch.decisions[0], EntryDecision::UncertainThisRound);
+        assert_eq!(
+            (
+                batch.confirmed_entries,
+                batch.uncertain_entries,
+                batch.entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference
+            ),
+            (1, 1, 0)
+        );
+        assert_eq!(counts.consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&1), 1, "记下一轮");
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn two_consecutive_uncertain_rounds_hand_the_entry_to_the_cpu_reference() {
+        let mut counts = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(1, 7, 8)], |_entry_position| {
+            panic!("只不确定一轮时不交 CPU 判")
+        });
+        let mut cpu_judged_positions = Vec::new();
+        let batch = counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(
+            vec![entry(3, 4, 4), entry(1, 9, 2)],
+            |entry_position| {
+                cpu_judged_positions.push(entry_position);
+                cpu_reference_outcome(entry_position)
+            },
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            cpu_judged_positions,
+            vec![1],
+            "只有连续两轮不确定的那一条交 CPU 判"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            batch.decisions,
+            vec![
+                EntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(4),
+                EntryDecision::JudgedByTheCpuReference(cpu_reference_outcome(1)),
+            ],
+            "按 CPU 的判定处理"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            (
+                batch.confirmed_entries,
+                batch.uncertain_entries,
+                batch.entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference
+            ),
+            (1, 0, 1)
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            counts.consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&1),
+            0,
+            "CPU 判过就清零"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn agreeing_again_after_a_disagreement_restarts_the_consecutive_count() {
+        let mut counts = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        let never_cpu = |_entry_position: usize| -> u32 {
+            panic!("没有连续两轮不确定，不交 CPU 判")
+        };
+        counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(1, 7, 8)], never_cpu);
+        let agreeing = counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(1, 7, 7)], never_cpu);
+        assert_eq!(
+            agreeing.decisions,
+            vec![EntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(7)]
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            counts.consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&1),
+            0,
+            "相同了就清零"
+        );
+        let disagreeing_again =
+            counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(1, 7, 8)], never_cpu);
+        assert_eq!(
+            disagreeing_again.decisions,
+            vec![EntryDecision::UncertainThisRound],
+            "不同、相同、再不同：只算连续一轮，不交 CPU"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn an_entry_absent_from_a_batch_keeps_its_count() {
+        let mut counts = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        let never_cpu = |_entry_position: usize| -> u32 { panic!("这一轮不交 CPU 判") };
+        counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(1, 7, 8)], never_cpu);
+        counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(2, 3, 3)], never_cpu);
+        assert_eq!(
+            counts.consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&1),
+            1,
+            "没出现的那一轮不清零也不加"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn dropping_the_counts_forgets_every_uncertain_round() {
+        let mut counts = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(1, 7, 8)], |_entry_position| {
+            panic!("只不确定一轮时不交 CPU 判")
+        });
+        drop(counts);
+        let mut counts_after_a_remount = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        let batch = counts_after_a_remount
+            .reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(vec![entry(1, 7, 8)], |_entry_position| {
+                panic!("重挂之后从零数起")
+            });
+        assert_eq!(batch.decisions, vec![EntryDecision::UncertainThisRound]);
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    #[should_panic(expected = "出现了两次")]
+    fn the_same_entry_twice_in_one_batch_panics() {
+        let mut counts = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        counts.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(
+            vec![entry(1, 7, 7), entry(1, 7, 7)],
+            |_entry_position| 0,
+        );
+    }

+//! 按每张卡挂载时量出的代价分活（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 2 条；用户 2026-10-26 定「全部独显都用，按每张卡挂载时量的代价分」）。
+//! 纯函数，输入每张卡一次提交的主机 CPU 时间与一批的条目数，交回每张卡分几条。
+//!
+//! 分法：每张卡分到的条数与它的代价成反比（份额 ∝ 1 / 代价），同一批里每张卡上「条数 × 一次提交的代价」大致拉平；
+//! 整数部分向下取，余下的几条按余数从大到小补，余数相同的给排在前面的卡。条目按卡的次序切成相连的几段（[`entry_ranges_per_gpu`]），
+//! 合并时按卡的次序接回，同一组输入每次交回同一种切法。
+
+/// 一次提交在主机上占的 CPU 时间（这条线程的 CPU 钟，不是挂钟），纳秒。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
+pub struct HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(pub u64);
+
+/// 量到 0 纳秒（钟的粒度之下）按 1 纳秒算：份额取代价的倒数，0 没有倒数。
+const SMALLEST_COST_IN_NANOSECONDS: u64 = 1;
+
+/// 份额的分子：代价的倒数写成 `2^64 / 代价` 的整数，代价不超过 `u64::MAX` 时它至少是 1，各卡的比照样分得开。
+const RECIPROCAL_COST_NUMERATOR: u128 = 1 << 64;
+
+/// 每张卡分几条，按卡的次序；加起来等于 `entry_count`。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// `measured_costs` 为空：参与的卡至少一张（挂载那一刻的校验拒了「GPU 不在」）。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(
+    measured_costs: &[HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission],
+    entry_count: usize,
+) -> Vec<usize> {
+    assert!(
+        !measured_costs.is_empty(),
+        "参与的卡至少一张：挂载那一刻一张独显都没有就拒了"
+    );
+    let reciprocal_weights: Vec<u128> = measured_costs
+        .iter()
+        .map(|cost| {
+            RECIPROCAL_COST_NUMERATOR / u128::from(cost.0.max(SMALLEST_COST_IN_NANOSECONDS))
+        })
+        .collect();
+    let total_weight: u128 = reciprocal_weights.iter().sum();
+    let entry_count_wide = u128::try_from(entry_count).expect("usize 装得进 u128");
+    let mut entries_per_gpu = Vec::with_capacity(reciprocal_weights.len());
+    let mut remainders = Vec::with_capacity(reciprocal_weights.len());
+    for weight in &reciprocal_weights {
+        let scaled = entry_count_wide
+            .checked_mul(*weight)
+            .expect("条目数不超过 2^64、每张卡的权不超过 2^64，乘积装得进 u128");
+        entries_per_gpu
+            .push(usize::try_from(scaled / total_weight).expect("一张卡分到的条数不超过总条数"));
+        remainders.push(scaled % total_weight);
+    }
+    let assigned: usize = entries_per_gpu.iter().sum();
+    let leftover = entry_count - assigned;
+    assert!(
+        leftover < measured_costs.len(),
+        "向下取整每张卡少给不到一条，补的条数少于卡数"
+    );
+    let mut gpus_by_remainder: Vec<usize> = (0..measured_costs.len()).collect();
+    gpus_by_remainder.sort_by(|left, right| {
+        remainders[*right]
+            .cmp(&remainders[*left])
+            .then(left.cmp(right))
+    });
+    for gpu_position in gpus_by_remainder.into_iter().take(leftover) {
+        entries_per_gpu[gpu_position] += 1;
+    }
+    assert_eq!(
+        entries_per_gpu.iter().sum::<usize>(),
+        entry_count,
+        "每张卡分到的条数加起来等于这一批的条目数"
+    );
+    entries_per_gpu
+}
+
+/// 把每张卡分到的条数按卡的次序切成相连的几段：排在最前的卡拿最前面那几条，依次往后。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn entry_ranges_per_gpu(entries_per_gpu: &[usize]) -> Vec<std::ops::Range<usize>> {
+    let mut start = 0;
+    entries_per_gpu
+        .iter()
+        .map(|entry_count| {
+            let range = start..start + entry_count;
+            start = range.end;
+            range
+        })
+        .collect()
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    fn costs(nanoseconds: &[u64]) -> Vec<HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission> {
+        nanoseconds
+            .iter()
+            .map(|cost| HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(*cost))
+            .collect()
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_single_gpu_takes_every_entry() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[12_000]), 37),
+            vec![37]
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn gpus_with_the_same_cost_split_evenly_and_the_earlier_gpu_takes_the_leftover() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[5_000, 5_000, 5_000]), 10),
+            vec![4, 3, 3],
+            "代价相同平分，除不尽的那一条给排在前面的卡"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_gpu_three_times_as_costly_takes_a_third_as_many_entries() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[1_000, 3_000]), 8),
+            vec![6, 2],
+            "份额与代价成反比"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_vastly_cheaper_gpu_takes_nearly_every_entry() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[1_000_000, 1_000]), 100),
+            vec![0, 100],
+            "代价差一千倍：贵的那张一条都分不到整数份"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn fewer_entries_than_gpus_go_to_the_cheapest_gpus_first() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[4_000, 1_000, 2_000]), 2),
+            vec![0, 1, 1],
+            "两条三张卡：给最便宜的两张"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[7_000, 7_000, 7_000]), 2),
+            vec![1, 1, 0],
+            "代价相同：给排在前面的两张"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn an_empty_batch_gives_every_gpu_nothing() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[1, 2]), 0),
+            vec![0, 0]
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_cost_measured_as_zero_counts_as_the_smallest_cost() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(&costs(&[0, 1]), 4),
+            vec![2, 2],
+            "0 纳秒按 1 纳秒算"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn the_shares_always_add_up_to_the_entry_count() {
+        let cost_sets = [
+            costs(&[1]),
+            costs(&[3, 7]),
+            costs(&[u64::MAX, 1, 999]),
+            costs(&[10, 10, 10, 10, 11]),
+        ];
+        for cost_set in &cost_sets {
+            for entry_count in [0_usize, 1, 2, 5, 97, 4096] {
+                let shares = entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(cost_set, entry_count);
+                assert_eq!(shares.len(), cost_set.len(), "每张卡一个份额");
+                assert_eq!(
+                    shares.iter().sum::<usize>(),
+                    entry_count,
+                    "代价 {cost_set:?}、{entry_count} 条：份额加起来等于条目数"
+                );
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn entry_ranges_follow_the_gpu_order_and_cover_the_batch_contiguously() {
+        assert_eq!(entry_ranges_per_gpu(&[2, 0, 3]), vec![0..2, 2..2, 2..5]);
+    }
+}

+fn little_endian_value_of_bytes(first_byte_number: u32, byte_count: u32) -> u32 {
