```diff
+    /// 一批交 GPU 的结局进来：两份核都算完了就照 [`Self::reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes`] 比、更新计数；
+    /// 这一批出错（GPU 出错、等 GPU 超过上限、这一批交不成）就原样交回出错，计数一条都不动、CPU 参照一次都不调（第 4 条：这一批放弃，不算一轮）。
+    /// 三段（校验和核对、区域扫描的单元头解析与映射反查、选段打分）交回判定都走这一处。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// `both_kernel_outcomes` 是 `Err` 时交回它。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 同 [`Self::reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes`]。
+    pub fn reconcile_unless_the_batch_failed<KernelOutcome: PartialEq, BatchFailure>(
+        &mut self,
+        both_kernel_outcomes: Result<
+            Vec<TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry<EntryKey, KernelOutcome>>,
+            BatchFailure,
+        >,
+        judge_with_the_cpu_reference: impl FnMut(usize) -> KernelOutcome,
+    ) -> Result<ReconciledBatch<KernelOutcome>, BatchFailure> {
+        match both_kernel_outcomes {
+            Ok(entries) => {
+                Ok(self.reconcile_the_two_kernel_outcomes(entries, judge_with_the_cpu_reference))
+            }
+            Err(batch_failure) => Err(batch_failure),
+        }
+    }
+
     /// 比一批两份核的结果、更新计数、交回判定。连续不确定到了 N 轮的那几条，调 `judge_with_the_cpu_reference`（参数是它在这一批里的位置）
     /// 现判一次；别的条目不调它。GPU 出错、这一批放弃时不调这个函数：计数照旧。
     ///
diff --git a/new/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/waiting_for_the_gpu.rs b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/waiting_for_the_gpu.rs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..72e3077
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/waiting_for_the_gpu.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,284 @@
+//! 阻塞等 GPU 时的上限（用户 2026-10-26 定等 GPU 结果「设超时，超时算出错」，记在 `records/2026-10-19-里程碑四GPU垃圾回收开工.md`
+//! 第 40 批交回那一行；D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 4 条）：每一处阻塞等 GPU 的地方（挂载那一刻等 wgpu 的 future、
+//! 等一次提交做完、等回读缓冲映射好）都在同一个上限之内等，上限由调用方开包时给（`BackgroundGpuSelection::background_gpu_wait_limit`）。
+//! 超过上限就交回 [`GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit`]：与别的 GPU 出错一样，这一批放弃、不重试、不换 CPU，
+//! 连续不确定的计数不动（`two_kernel_reconciliation::ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::reconcile_unless_the_batch_failed`）。
+//!
+//! 等法与钟、完成信号拆开：钟是 [`MonotonicClock`]（产品用这个进程的单调钟 [`SteadyClockOfThisProcess`]），完成信号是调用方给的
+//! 「看一次做没做完、最多等这么久」的闭包。不要 GPU 的用例换上假钟与假完成信号，钉住「上限内完成照常、超过上限交回超时出错」。
+
+use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
+
+use crate::background_gpu::GpuFailureCause;
+
+/// 单调钟：读数只增不减，读的是从某个固定起点起过了多久。产品用 [`SteadyClockOfThisProcess`]；用例换成假钟。
+pub trait MonotonicClock {
+    fn time_since_the_origin(&self) -> Duration;
+}
+
+/// 这个进程的单调钟（`std::time::Instant`），起点是造它的那一刻。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
+pub struct SteadyClockOfThisProcess {
+    origin: Instant,
+}
+
+impl SteadyClockOfThisProcess {
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn starting_now() -> Self {
+        Self {
+            origin: Instant::now(),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+impl MonotonicClock for SteadyClockOfThisProcess {
+    fn time_since_the_origin(&self) -> Duration {
+        self.origin.elapsed()
+    }
+}
+
+/// 一次等的期限：从哪一刻起等、最多等多久。一次提交的几处等（等提交做完、等两份回读映射好）共用一个期限，合起来不超过上限。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct GpuWaitDeadline {
+    started_at: Duration,
+    wait_limit: Duration,
+}
+
+impl GpuWaitDeadline {
+    /// 从钟此刻的读数起等，最多等 `wait_limit`。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn starting_now(wait_limit: Duration, clock: &impl MonotonicClock) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            started_at: clock.time_since_the_origin(),
+            wait_limit,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn wait_limit(&self) -> Duration {
+        self.wait_limit
+    }
+
+    /// 离期限还剩多久；已经等满上限（剩 0 或钟走过了期限）交回 `None`。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn time_left_before_the_deadline(&self, clock: &impl MonotonicClock) -> Option<Duration> {
+        let waited = clock
+            .time_since_the_origin()
+            .saturating_sub(self.started_at);
+        self.wait_limit
+            .checked_sub(waited)
+            .filter(|time_left| !time_left.is_zero())
+    }
+}
+
+/// 看一次做没做完的结局。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum CompletionCheck<Output> {
+    Completed(Output),
+    /// 这一次没等到（最多等了交给它的那么久，或提前醒了）：还在期限内就再看一次。
+    NotYetComplete,
+    /// 等的那一样自己报了错（不是超时）：照原样交回。
+    Failed(GpuFailureCause),
+}
+
+/// 在期限之内反复看 `check_once_waiting_at_most`（参数是这一次最多等多久，即离期限还剩的那么久），直到做完、报错或等满上限。
+/// 每一轮先看还剩多久：剩 0 就交回超时，不再看；所以一次都还没看就已经过了期限的（上限是 0）也交回超时。
+///
+/// 循环的出口只有三个：做完、报错、等满上限。迭代次数没有静态上界：每一轮要么等到了、要么至少等了交给它的那么久或提前醒了，
+/// 钟单调往前走，期限总会到。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 等满上限 ⇒ [`GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit`]（带上限本身）；`check_once_waiting_at_most` 交回的出错照原样交回。
+pub fn wait_for_completion_before_the_deadline<Output>(
+    deadline: &GpuWaitDeadline,
+    clock: &impl MonotonicClock,
+    mut check_once_waiting_at_most: impl FnMut(Duration) -> CompletionCheck<Output>,
+) -> Result<Output, GpuFailureCause> {
+    loop {
+        let Some(time_left) = deadline.time_left_before_the_deadline(clock) else {
+            return Err(GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit {
+                wait_limit: deadline.wait_limit,
+            });
+        };
+        match check_once_waiting_at_most(time_left) {
+            CompletionCheck::Completed(output) => return Ok(output),
+            CompletionCheck::NotYetComplete => {}
+            CompletionCheck::Failed(cause) => return Err(cause),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+    use std::cell::Cell;
+
+    use crate::two_kernel_reconciliation::{
+        ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts, TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry,
+    };
+
+    /// 假钟：只在完成信号让它走时才走。
+    struct ClockMovedByTheTest {
+        now: Cell<Duration>,
+    }
+
+    impl MonotonicClock for ClockMovedByTheTest {
+        fn time_since_the_origin(&self) -> Duration {
+            self.now.get()
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 假完成信号：每看一次假钟走一秒、最多走到期限（这一次等了一秒没等到），钟走到 `completes_at` 那一刻算做完、交回 42。
+    /// 交给它的最多等多久是 0 时（被测的等法不该这样交）也让钟走 1 纳秒：等法写错时用例照样走得完、在断言上红，不在原地转圈。
+    fn completion_at<'clock>(
+        clock: &'clock ClockMovedByTheTest,
+        completes_at: Duration,
+        checks_made: &'clock Cell<u32>,
+    ) -> impl FnMut(Duration) -> CompletionCheck<u32> + 'clock {
+        move |time_left| {
+            checks_made.set(checks_made.get() + 1);
+            let waited_this_check = Duration::from_secs(1)
+                .min(time_left)
+                .max(Duration::from_nanos(1));
+            clock.now.set(clock.now.get() + waited_this_check);
+            if clock.now.get() >= completes_at {
+                CompletionCheck::Completed(42)
+            } else {
+                CompletionCheck::NotYetComplete
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_completion_within_the_wait_limit_returns_its_output() {
+        let clock = ClockMovedByTheTest {
+            now: Cell::new(Duration::from_secs(100)),
+        };
+        let checks_made = Cell::new(0);
+        let deadline = GpuWaitDeadline::starting_now(Duration::from_secs(5), &clock);
+        assert_eq!(
+            wait_for_completion_before_the_deadline(
+                &deadline,
+                &clock,
+                completion_at(&clock, Duration::from_secs(103), &checks_made),
+            ),
+            Ok(42),
+            "等了 3 秒做完，上限 5 秒：照常交回"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(checks_made.get(), 3, "做完就不再看");
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_completion_later_than_the_wait_limit_is_a_timeout_failure() {
+        let clock = ClockMovedByTheTest {
+            now: Cell::new(Duration::from_secs(100)),
+        };
+        let checks_made = Cell::new(0);
+        let deadline = GpuWaitDeadline::starting_now(Duration::from_secs(5), &clock);
+        assert_eq!(
+            wait_for_completion_before_the_deadline(
+                &deadline,
+                &clock,
+                completion_at(&clock, Duration::from_secs(107), &checks_made),
+            ),
+            Err(GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit {
+                wait_limit: Duration::from_secs(5)
+            }),
+            "要 7 秒才做完，上限 5 秒：交回超时出错"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(checks_made.get(), 5, "等满 5 秒就不再看");
+        assert_eq!(
+            clock.now.get(),
+            Duration::from_secs(105),
+            "每次最多等到期限为止"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_zero_wait_limit_times_out_before_checking() {
+        let clock = ClockMovedByTheTest {
+            now: Cell::new(Duration::ZERO),
+        };
+        let checks_made = Cell::new(0);
+        let deadline = GpuWaitDeadline::starting_now(Duration::ZERO, &clock);
+        assert_eq!(
+            wait_for_completion_before_the_deadline(
+                &deadline,
+                &clock,
+                completion_at(&clock, Duration::ZERO, &checks_made),
+            ),
+            Err(GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit {
+                wait_limit: Duration::ZERO
+            })
+        );
+        assert_eq!(checks_made.get(), 0);
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn a_failure_reported_by_the_wait_is_returned_as_it_is() {
+        let clock = ClockMovedByTheTest {
+            now: Cell::new(Duration::ZERO),
+        };
+        let deadline = GpuWaitDeadline::starting_now(Duration::from_secs(5), &clock);
+        let failure = GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheSubmissionFailed {
+            reason: "测试给的".to_string(),
+        };
+        assert_eq!(
+            wait_for_completion_before_the_deadline(&deadline, &clock, |_time_left| {
+                CompletionCheck::<u32>::Failed(failure.clone())
+            }),
+            Err(failure)
+        );
+    }
+
+    /// 超时那一批走的是与 GPU 出错同一条路：交回出错，连续不确定计数一条都不动，CPU 参照一次都不调。
+    #[test]
+    fn a_batch_whose_wait_times_out_leaves_the_consecutive_uncertainty_counts_unchanged() {
+        let mut uncertainty: ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<u32> =
+            ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        let disagreeing_round = uncertainty.reconcile_unless_the_batch_failed(
+            Ok::<_, GpuFailureCause>(vec![TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry {
+                entry_key: 1,
+                outcome_by_one_kernel: 7_u32,
+                outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: 8,
+            }]),
+            |_entry_position| panic!("只不确定一轮时不交 CPU 判"),
+        );
+        assert!(disagreeing_round.is_ok());
+        assert_eq!(uncertainty.consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&1), 1);
+
+        let clock = ClockMovedByTheTest {
+            now: Cell::new(Duration::ZERO),
+        };
+        let checks_made = Cell::new(0);
+        let deadline = GpuWaitDeadline::starting_now(Duration::from_secs(2), &clock);
+        let timed_out_outcomes = wait_for_completion_before_the_deadline(
+            &deadline,
+            &clock,
+            completion_at(&clock, Duration::from_secs(9), &checks_made),
+        )
+        .map(|_completed| {
+            vec![TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry {
+                entry_key: 1,
+                outcome_by_one_kernel: 7_u32,
+                outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: 8,
+            }]
+        });
+        let timed_out_round = uncertainty
+            .reconcile_unless_the_batch_failed(timed_out_outcomes, |_entry_position| {
+                panic!("超时那一批不交 CPU 判")
+            });
+        assert_eq!(
+            timed_out_round,
+            Err(GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit {
+                wait_limit: Duration::from_secs(2)
+            }),
+            "超时算出错"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            uncertainty.consecutive_uncertain_rounds_of(&1),
+            1,
+            "超时那一批放弃了，不算一轮：计数不加也不清零"
+        );
+    }
+}
```

```diff
+            Err(_cause_of_the_failed_wait) => Self::MayStillBeRunningOnTheGpu(submission),

+    }

+    pub fn chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed(
+        &mut self,
+        deadline: &GpuWaitDeadline,
+        clock: &impl MonotonicClock,
+        check_once_waiting_at_most: impl FnMut(&Submission, Duration) -> CompletionCheck<()>,
+        entry_input_lengths_in_bytes: &[u64],
+        footprint: ChunkFootprint,
+        bounds: ChunkBoundsOfAGpu,
+    ) -> Result<Vec<std::ops::Range<usize>>, ChunksNotCutOnTheGpu> {
+        if entry_input_lengths_in_bytes.is_empty() {

+            deadline,
+            clock,

+        )

+            entry_input_lengths_in_bytes,

+fn failure_of_waiting_for_the_earlier_submission(cause: GpuFailureCause) -> GpuFailureCause {
+    match cause {
+        GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit { wait_limit } => {
+            GpuFailureCause::EarlierTimedOutSubmissionNotCompleteWithinTheWaitLimit { wait_limit }
+        }

+        | GpuFailureCause::UncapturedErrorOrDeviceLost { .. }
+        | GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheSubmissionFailed { .. }
+        | GpuFailureCause::EarlierTimedOutSubmissionNotCompleteWithinTheWaitLimit { .. }
+        | GpuFailureCause::ReadbackMappingFailed { .. }
+        | GpuFailureCause::KernelLeftAnUnrecognizedVerdictWord(..)) => reported_by_the_wait,
+    }

+    /// 假钟：只在假完成信号让它走时才走。

+        now: Cell<Duration>,

+

+        fn time_since_the_origin(&self) -> Duration {

+    /// 假完成信号：`submission` 在钟走到 `completes_at` 那一刻在 GPU 上做完。每看一次钟走一秒（最多走到期限，至少走 1 纳秒：
+    /// 被测的写错时用例照样走得完、在断言上红）；看的不是这一次提交就断言。
+    fn completion_signal_of(
+        clock: &ClockMovedByTheCompletionSignal,
+        submission: SubmissionNamedByTheTest,
+        completes_at: Duration,
+    ) -> impl FnMut(&SubmissionNamedByTheTest, Duration) -> CompletionCheck<()> + '_ {
+        move |submission_checked, time_left| {
+            assert_eq!(*submission_checked, submission, "等的是超时的那一次提交");
+            let waited_this_check = Duration::from_secs(1)
+                .min(time_left)
+                .max(Duration::from_nanos(1));
+            clock.now.set(clock.now.get() + waited_this_check);

+                CompletionCheck::Completed(())

+                CompletionCheck::NotYetComplete
+            }
+        }
+    }
```

```diff
+    /// 拆开之前的 `choose_region`，逐字留在这里当参照（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1 条「选段打分」放上 GPU 时把它拆成
+    /// [`super::live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records`] 与 [`super::choose_region_over_the_live_slots`] 两步）：每段的活槽数内联着数。

+    fn choose_region_with_the_live_slots_counted_inline_as_before_the_split(
+        allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+        unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+        segments_opened_in_this_mount: &BTreeSet<SlotNumber>,

+            .iter()
+            .filter(|record| record.device == unit_area.device && !record.is_released)

+                    continue;
+                };
+                let segment = usize::try_from(offset_in_unit_area / CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS)
+                    .expect("段号装得进 usize");
+                if let Some(live_slots) = live_slots_per_segment.get_mut(segment) {
+                    *live_slots += 1;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        let segments: Vec<CompactionKernelSegment> = live_slots_per_segment
+            .iter()
+            .enumerate()
+            .map(|(segment, live_slots)| {
+                let start_slot = SlotNumber(
+                    unit_area_start
+                        + u64::try_from(segment * segment_slots).expect("槽号装得进 u64"),
+                );
+                let end_slot = SlotNumber(start_slot.0 + CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS);
+                CompactionKernelSegment {
+                    live_slots: match criterion {
+                        RegionChoiceCriterion::Greedy => greedy_score(*live_slots),
+                    },
+                    is_opened_in_this_mount: segments_opened_in_this_mount.contains(&start_slot),
+                    is_the_live_intent_region: region_of_the_live_intent
+                        .is_some_and(|region| region.start_slot() == start_slot),
+                    holds_a_pinned_slot: slots_pinned_by_the_roots
+                        .range(start_slot..end_slot)
+                        .next()
+                        .is_some(),
+                    is_refused_by_the_region_scan: segments_the_region_scan_refused

+                        }
+                        Some(_) => CompactionKernelSegmentScan::ScannedWithoutAMovableUnit,
+                    },
+                }
+            })
+            .collect();
+        let region_at = |position: usize| {
+            CompactionRegion::of_one_cluster_segment(
+                unit_area.device,
+                SlotNumber(
+                    unit_area_start
+                        + u64::try_from(position * segment_slots).expect("槽号装得进 u64"),
+                ),
+            )
+            .expect("单元区的整段起点在聚簇段边界上且装得进六字节")
+        };
+        match choose_compaction_segment(&segments) {
+            CompactionKernelRegionChoice::Chosen(position) => {
+                RegionChoice::Chosen(region_at(position))
+            }
+            CompactionKernelRegionChoice::ScanBeforeChoosing(position) => {
+                RegionChoice::ScanBeforeChoosing(region_at(position))

+            CompactionKernelRegionChoice::NoEligibleSegment => RegionChoice::NoEligibleSegment,

+    /// 确定的伪随机源（xorshift64*，种子写死）：同一个种子每次造出同一串输入，红了能原样重放。
+    struct DeterministicRandomSource {
+        state: u64,
+    }
+
+    impl DeterministicRandomSource {
+        fn below(&mut self, bound: u64) -> u64 {
+            self.state ^= self.state >> 12;
+            self.state ^= self.state << 25;
+            self.state ^= self.state >> 27;
+            self.state.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D) % bound
+        }

+        fn one_in(&mut self, odds: u64) -> bool {
+            self.below(odds) == 0
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 随机造的一份选段输入：单元区（整段数加凑不满 64 槽的尾巴）、两块盘上的记录（有落在单元区之前与之后的、跨度 1 到 3、四分之一已释放）、
+    /// 开过的段、活 R、钉住的槽、扫过的段（有能搬的、没有能搬的、另一块盘上的）、被扫描拒过的段。
+    struct RandomChoiceInput {
+        unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+        allocation_records: Vec<AllocationRecord>,
+        cluster_segments: BTreeSet<SlotNumber>,
+        live_intent_region: Option<CompactionRegion>,
+        pinned_slots: BTreeSet<SlotNumber>,

+        segments_refused: SegmentsRefusedByTheRegionScan,

+    const FULL_SEGMENTS_OF_THE_RANDOM_UNIT_AREA: u64 = 6;
+    const RANDOM_CHOICE_INPUTS: u64 = 3000;
+    const RANDOM_CHOICE_SEED: u64 = 0x5EED_0D26_0013_0001;
+
+    fn random_choice_input(random: &mut DeterministicRandomSource) -> RandomChoiceInput {
+        let start = unit_area_start_slot();
+        let unit_area = UnitAreaOfOneDevice {
+            device: DEVICE_OF_THE_UNIT_AREA,
+            start: UnitAreaStart::of_the_default_journal_ring(),
+            slots: FULL_SEGMENTS_OF_THE_RANDOM_UNIT_AREA * CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS
+                + random.below(CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS),
+        };
+        let segment_start = |segment: u64| SlotNumber(start + segment * CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS);
+        let region_of = |segment: u64, device: DeviceIdentity| {
+            CompactionRegion::of_one_cluster_segment(device, segment_start(segment))
+                .expect("单元区起点在聚簇段边界上")
+        };
+        let records_count = random.below(48);
+        let allocation_records = (0..records_count)
+            .map(|_record| {
+                let device = if random.one_in(3) {
+                    ANOTHER_DEVICE
+                } else {
+                    DEVICE_OF_THE_UNIT_AREA
+                };
+                // 从单元区起点之前 8 槽到整段之后一段多：有落在单元区之前、尾巴里与单元区之外的。
+                let slot = start - 8
+                    + random.below(
+                        (FULL_SEGMENTS_OF_THE_RANDOM_UNIT_AREA + 1) * CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS + 16,
+                    );
+                let span_slots = u16::try_from(1 + random.below(3)).expect("1 到 3");
+                record(device, slot, span_slots, random.one_in(4))
+            })
+            .collect();
+        let segments_of_the_area = FULL_SEGMENTS_OF_THE_RANDOM_UNIT_AREA + 1;
+        let cluster_segments = (0..segments_of_the_area)
+            .filter(|_segment| random.one_in(5))
+            .map(segment_start)
+            .collect();
+        let live_intent_region = if random.one_in(3) {
+            Some(region_of(
+                random.below(FULL_SEGMENTS_OF_THE_RANDOM_UNIT_AREA),
+                DEVICE_OF_THE_UNIT_AREA,
+            ))
+        } else {
+            None
+        };
+        let pinned_slots = (0..random.below(3))
+            .map(|_pinned| {
+                SlotNumber(start + random.below(segments_of_the_area * CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS))
+            })
+            .collect();
+        let mut region_scans = Vec::new();
+        let mut segments_refused = SegmentsRefusedByTheRegionScan::default();
+        for segment in 0..FULL_SEGMENTS_OF_THE_RANDOM_UNIT_AREA {
+            match random.below(6) {
+                0 => region_scans.push(RegionScan {
+                    region: region_of(segment, DEVICE_OF_THE_UNIT_AREA),
+                    allocations: vec![ScannedAllocation {
+                        placement: Placement {
+                            slot: segment_start(segment),
+                            span: 1,
+                        },
+                        class: AllocationInRegion::Movable(movable_unit(vec![u8::try_from(
+                            segment,
+                        )
+                        .expect("至多六段")])),
+                    }],
+                }),
+                1 => region_scans.push(RegionScan {
+                    region: region_of(segment, DEVICE_OF_THE_UNIT_AREA),
+                    allocations: Vec::new(),
+                }),
+                2 => region_scans.push(RegionScan {
+                    region: region_of(segment, ANOTHER_DEVICE),
+                    allocations: Vec::new(),
+                }),
+                3 => segments_refused.note_refusal(
+                    region_of(segment, DEVICE_OF_THE_UNIT_AREA),

+                _ => {}

+        RandomChoiceInput {
+            unit_area,
+            allocation_records,
+            cluster_segments,

+            pinned_slots,
+            region_scans,
+            segments_refused,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn choosing_over_the_live_slots_counted_per_segment_picks_the_segment_the_inline_scoring_picked(
+    ) {
+        let mut random = DeterministicRandomSource {
+            state: RANDOM_CHOICE_SEED,
+        };
+        let mut answers_seen: BTreeSet<String> = BTreeSet::new();
+        for input_number in 0..RANDOM_CHOICE_INPUTS {
+            let input = random_choice_input(&mut random);
+            let before_the_split =
+                choose_region_with_the_live_slots_counted_inline_as_before_the_split(

+                    input.unit_area,

+                    input.live_intent_region,
+                    &input.pinned_slots,
+                    &input.region_scans,

+                live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records(
+                    &input.allocation_records,
+                    input.unit_area,

+                .into_iter()
+                .map(LiveSlotsOfAClusterSegment::Counted)
+                .collect();
+            let over_the_live_slots = choose_region_over_the_live_slots(
+                &live_slots_per_segment,
+                input.unit_area,
+                &input.cluster_segments,
+                input.live_intent_region,
+                &input.pinned_slots,
+                &input.region_scans,
+                &input.segments_refused,
+                RegionChoiceCriterion::Greedy,
+            );
+            let through_choose_region = choose_region(
+                &input.allocation_records,
+                input.unit_area,
+                &input.cluster_segments,
+                input.live_intent_region,
+                &input.pinned_slots,
+                &input.region_scans,
+                &input.segments_refused,
+                RegionChoiceCriterion::Greedy,
+            );
+            assert_eq!(
+                over_the_live_slots, before_the_split,
+                "第 {input_number} 份输入：先数每段活槽数、再吃它选段，与拆开之前内联着数的选出的相同"
+            );
+            assert_eq!(
+                through_choose_region, before_the_split,
+                "第 {input_number} 份输入：拆开之后的 choose_region 与拆开之前的选出的相同"
+            );
+            answers_seen.insert(format!("{before_the_split:?}").chars().take(12).collect());
+        }
+        assert_eq!(
+            answers_seen.len(),
+            3,
+            "随机输入走到了选中、先扫、一段都没资格三种答案：{answers_seen:?}"
+        );
+    }
+
+    /// GPU 路径上一段的活槽数这一轮不确定（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 8 条）：它这一批不进候选，选的是其余各段里活槽最少的；
+    /// 同样的输入把它记成数出来的，它活槽最少、选的就是它。
+    #[test]
+    fn a_segment_whose_live_slots_are_uncertain_this_round_is_left_out_of_the_candidates() {
+        let unit_area = UnitAreaOfOneDevice {
+            device: DEVICE_OF_THE_UNIT_AREA,
+            start: UnitAreaStart::of_the_default_journal_ring(),
+            slots: 3 * CLUSTER_SEGMENT_SLOTS,
+        };
+        let region_scans: Vec<RegionScan> = (0..3)
+            .map(|segment_index| RegionScan {
+                region: region_of_the_segment(segment_index),
+                allocations: vec![ScannedAllocation {
+                    placement: Placement {
+                        slot: SlotNumber(segment_start_slot(segment_index)),
+                        span: 1,
+                    },
+                    class: AllocationInRegion::Movable(movable_unit(vec![u8::try_from(
+                        segment_index,
+                    )
+                    .expect("三段")])),
+                }],
+            })
+            .collect();
+        let choose_over = |live_slots_per_segment: &[LiveSlotsOfAClusterSegment]| {
+            choose_region_over_the_live_slots(
+                live_slots_per_segment,
+                unit_area,
+                &BTreeSet::new(),
+                None,

+            )

+        assert_eq!(

+                LiveSlotsOfAClusterSegment::Counted(5),
+            ]),

+        );
+        assert_eq!(

+                LiveSlotsOfAClusterSegment::Counted(9),
+                LiveSlotsOfAClusterSegment::UncertainThisRound,

+enum CompactionComputeOfTheBatch<'gpu> {

+    /// 各段的条目数记进 `gpu_work`。
+    OnTheGpu {
+        gpu_compute: &'gpu mut (dyn BackgroundGpuCompute + Send),
+        gpu_work: &'gpu mut GpuWorkOfTheBatch,
+    },

+enum CompactionBatchNotCompleted {
+    Refused(RelocationBatchRefused),
+    ComputeFailed(BackgroundComputeError),
+}
+
+impl From<RelocationBatchRefused> for CompactionBatchNotCompleted {
+    fn from(refused: RelocationBatchRefused) -> Self {
+        CompactionBatchNotCompleted::Refused(refused)

+fn live_slots_per_cluster_segment_computing_on(

+            gpu_work,

+                        GpuEntryDecision::UncertainThisRound => {

+                        }
+                    })
+                    .collect(),
+            ))

+fn compaction_publish_planned_with_the_records_uncertain_this_round(
+    scan: Option<(&RegionScan, &[Placement])>,
+    batch_units: CompactionBatchUnits,
+    rewritten_anyway: &BTreeSet<Vec<u8>>,
+    allocation_records_of_the_version: &[AllocationRecord],
+    region: CompactionRegion,

+    CompactionIntentStep,
+    CompactionPublishKind,
+)> {
+    match scan {
+        Some((scan, records_uncertain)) if !records_uncertain.is_empty() => {
+            match plan_batch_skipping_the_units_this_publish_rewrites_anyway(
+                scan,

+                        carry_the_intent_unless_the_region_is_emptied,
+                        CompactionPublishKind::Batch,
+                    ))

+                PlannedBatch::RegionEmptied
+                | PlannedBatch::NothingMovableButTheRegionIsNotEmpty => None,

+            Some(scan),
+            batch_units,
+            rewritten_anyway,
+            allocation_records_of_the_version,
+            region,
+        )),
+        None => Some(compaction_publish_planned_for_the_region_scan(
+            None,
+            batch_units,
+            rewritten_anyway,
+            allocation_records_of_the_version,
+            region,
+        )),
+    }

+/// 跨 R 边界的整次拒、钉住、隔离、跨度不是单元形状、读盘都在 CPU 上做，次序与读的单元同 CPU 那一条（按槽升序、钉住与隔离的不读）；

+    allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+    mapping_index: &CentralMappingIdentityIndex<'_>,
+    pinned_slots: &BTreeSet<SlotNumber>,
+    quarantined_slots: &BTreeSet<SlotNumber>,
+    mut read_unit_bytes: ReadUnitBytes,
+    gpu_compute: &mut dyn BackgroundGpuCompute,
+    gpu_work: &mut GpuWorkOfTheBatch,
+) -> Result<RegionScanWithTheRecordsUncertainThisRound, BackgroundComputeError>
+where
+    ReadUnitBytes: FnMut(DeviceIdentity, SlotNumber, usize) -> Option<Vec<u8>>,
+{
+    count_on_this_thread(|counted| counted.regions_scanned += 1);

+        Vec::with_capacity(records_in_region.len());

+        let (class, bytes_read) = if pinned_slots.range(covered_slots.clone()).next().is_some() {

+            (Some(AllocationInRegion::Quarantined), None)

+                None => (
+                    Some(AllocationInRegion::Inconsistent(

+                                span_slots: record.span_slots,
+                            },

+                    )),
+                    None,
+                ),
+                Some(unit_bytes) => (

+        bytes_read_of_each_record.push(bytes_read.flatten());
+    }

+    let positions_classified_on_the_gpu: Vec<usize> = (0..records_in_region.len())
```

```diff
+            + 4 * outcome_bytes;
+        assert_eq!(

+            let segment_bound_buffer =

+            let record_buffer =
+                self.buffer_with_contents(&record_bytes, wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE);
+            let sorted_position_buffer =

+                            (2, &record_buffer),

+                            (4, &searching_outcomes),

+        let walking = decoded_live_slot_outcomes(&walking_bytes)

+        let searching = decoded_live_slot_outcomes(&searching_bytes)
+            .map_err(GpuFailureCause::KernelLeftAnUnrecognizedVerdictWord)?;
+        Ok(walking.into_iter().zip(searching).collect())
+    }

+            segments,
+            both_kernel_live_slots,
+            uncertainty,
         )
     }
 }
 
+/// 卡清单（核心层挂载与切换照它校验设置，D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 4 条）：参与的卡与各自的显存总量，按参与的次序。
+/// 开包时没点名就是本机全部独显（按总线地址排），点了名就是点名的那几张：挂载与切换点了开包时没开的卡，照「点名的卡不存在」拒。
+impl GpuInventory for BackgroundGpu {
+    fn devices_with_total_memory(&self) -> Vec<(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)> {
+        self.gpus_in_use
+            .iter()
+            .map(|gpu_in_use| {
+                (
+                    gpu_in_use.participating.discrete_gpu.identifier.clone(),
+                    gpu_in_use.participating.discrete_gpu.total_memory,
+                )
+            })
+            .collect()
+    }
+}
+
 /// 这条线程到此刻用掉的 CPU 时间（`CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID`）：线程睡着、等 GPU 时不走。
 ///
 /// # Panics
diff --git a/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/background_gpu_compute.rs b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/background_gpu_compute.rs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..10f618e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/background_gpu_compute.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,444 @@
+//! 产品 GPU 包对核心层 `singlefs_core::background_compute::BackgroundGpuCompute`（连同超 trait `GpuInventory`）的实现
+//! （D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1、2、4、8 条）：三段各一个方法，接到本包三段已有的两份核上——甲 `checksum_kernels`、
+//! 乙 `region_record_kernels`、丙 `live_slot_kernels`——两份核的结果逐条比对、同一条目连续 2 轮不确定的交 CPU 参照判
+//! （`two_kernel_reconciliation`）。连续不确定的计数三段各一份，只住在这份实现里：重挂换一份实现就清零。
+//! 出错照第 4 条：这一批的判定一条都不交、计数不动，映射成核心层的两种之一（[`core_failure_of_the_checksum_batch`]、
+//! [`core_failure_of_the_region_record_batch`]、[`core_failure_of_the_live_slot_batch`]），不换 CPU 接着算。
+//! 等 GPU 超过上限（用户 2026-10-26 定「设超时，超时算出错」）是 GPU 出错的一种，映射成 `GpuFailed`。
+//!
+//! 两份核各算一次的那一层抽成 [`BothKernelsOfTheThreeSegments`]：产品是 `background_gpu::BackgroundGpu`（参与的卡上两份 WGSL 核）；
+//! 测试里换上在 CPU 上算的替身，比对、计数、映射这几样不起卡就钉得住。
+//! 挂载那一刻的入口 [`open_background_gpu_compute`]：开卡（卡清单、显存上限、等 GPU 的上限，校验同核心层 `admit_background_compute_settings`），
+//! 交回核心层挂载与切换收的把手。
+
+use singlefs_core::allocator::AllocationRecord;
+use singlefs_core::background_compute::{
+    BackgroundGpuCompute, BackgroundGpuComputeFailed, BackgroundGpuComputeHandle,
+    ClusterSegmentEntryKey, GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuEntryDecision, GpuInventory, GpuMemoryInBytes,
+    RegionRecordEntryKey, RegionRecordToClassifyOnTheGpu, UnitChecksumOutcome,
+    UnitChecksumToVerifyOnTheGpu,
+};
+use singlefs_core::compaction_plan::UnitAreaOfOneDevice;
+use singlefs_core::logged_operations::CompactionRegion;
+use singlefs_core::region_scan::{AllocationInRegion, CentralMappingEntry};
+
+use crate::adapter_inventory::BackgroundGpuSelection;
+use crate::background_gpu::{
+    open_background_gpu, BackgroundGpu, BackgroundGpuOpenRefused, ChecksumBatchFailed,
+    LiveSlotBatchFailed, RegionRecordBatchFailed,
+};
+use crate::checksum_kernels::{
+    reconciled_unit_checksums, ChecksumKernelOutcome, UnitChecksumToVerify,
+};
+use crate::live_slot_kernels::reconciled_live_slots_of_the_segments;
+use crate::region_record_kernels::{
+    reconciled_region_record_classifications, RegionRecordToClassify,
+};
+use crate::two_kernel_reconciliation::{ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts, EntryDecision};
+
+/// 三段各两份核算一次、交回每条两份的结果（不比对、不动计数）的那一层，连同本机的卡清单。产品是 [`BackgroundGpu`]；测试换上在 CPU 上算的替身。
+/// 三个方法的约定同 [`BackgroundGpu`] 上对应的那三个：交回的条数与交进去的相同、按交进去的次序；出错时一条都不交。
+pub trait BothKernelsOfTheThreeSegments: GpuInventory {
+    /// 甲：每个单元两份核各算一次整单元 CRC-32C 与期望值比（查表那一份在前）。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`ChecksumBatchFailed`] 的两种。
+    fn unit_checksums_by_both_kernels(
+        &mut self,
+        units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, RegionRecordEntryKey>],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(ChecksumKernelOutcome, ChecksumKernelOutcome)>, ChecksumBatchFailed>;
+
+    /// 乙：`region` 里每条记录两份核各分一次类（逐条走映射那一份在前）。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`RegionRecordBatchFailed`] 的四种。
+    fn region_record_classes_by_both_kernels(
+        &mut self,
+        region: CompactionRegion,
+        records: &[RegionRecordToClassify<'_, RegionRecordEntryKey>],
+        mapping_entries: &[CentralMappingEntry],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(AllocationInRegion, AllocationInRegion)>, RegionRecordBatchFailed>;
+
+    /// 丙：`unit_area` 那块盘上每个整段两份核各数一次活槽数（逐条走遍记录那一份在前）。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`LiveSlotBatchFailed`] 的三种。
+    fn live_slots_by_both_kernels(
+        &mut self,
+        allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+        unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+        segments: &[ClusterSegmentEntryKey],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(u64, u64)>, LiveSlotBatchFailed>;
+}
+
+impl BothKernelsOfTheThreeSegments for BackgroundGpu {
+    fn unit_checksums_by_both_kernels(
+        &mut self,
+        units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, RegionRecordEntryKey>],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(ChecksumKernelOutcome, ChecksumKernelOutcome)>, ChecksumBatchFailed> {
+        self.both_kernel_outcomes_of_the_batch(units)
+    }
+
+    fn region_record_classes_by_both_kernels(
+        &mut self,
+        region: CompactionRegion,
+        records: &[RegionRecordToClassify<'_, RegionRecordEntryKey>],
+        mapping_entries: &[CentralMappingEntry],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(AllocationInRegion, AllocationInRegion)>, RegionRecordBatchFailed> {
+        self.both_kernel_classifications_of_the_region_records(region, records, mapping_entries)
+    }
+
+    fn live_slots_by_both_kernels(
+        &mut self,
+        allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+        unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+        segments: &[ClusterSegmentEntryKey],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(u64, u64)>, LiveSlotBatchFailed> {
+        self.both_kernel_live_slots_of_the_cluster_segments(allocation_records, unit_area, segments)
+    }
+}
+
+/// 核心层要的那一份实现：两份核那一层，加三段各一份连续不确定的计数（第 8 条，N = 2，只在内存里）。
+pub struct BackgroundGpuComputeThroughBothKernels<Kernels> {
+    kernels: Kernels,
+    unit_checksum_uncertainty: ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<RegionRecordEntryKey>,
+    region_record_uncertainty: ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<RegionRecordEntryKey>,
+    live_slot_uncertainty: ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<ClusterSegmentEntryKey>,
+}
+
+/// 产品那一份：参与的卡上的两份核。
+pub type BackgroundGpuComputeOnTheParticipatingGpus =
+    BackgroundGpuComputeThroughBothKernels<BackgroundGpu>;
+
+impl<Kernels> BackgroundGpuComputeThroughBothKernels<Kernels> {
+    /// 挂载那一刻：三段都还没有一个条目不确定过。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn with_no_entry_uncertain(kernels: Kernels) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            kernels,
+            unit_checksum_uncertainty: ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain(),
+            region_record_uncertainty: ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain(),
+            live_slot_uncertainty: ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain(),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// 挂载那一刻开后台 GPU、交回核心层挂载与切换收的把手（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13「挂载时由调用方把它的实现递进去」）。
+/// `selection` 与挂载递给核心层的那一组设置要是同一组卡、上限与等 GPU 的上限（`BackgroundGpuSelection::of_the_settings` 照那一组取）：
+/// 本包开卡时照它校验一次（同核心层 `admit_background_compute_settings`），核心层挂载时照这份实现答的卡清单（参与的卡）再校验一次。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// [`BackgroundGpuOpenRefused`] 的四种：设置被拒（GPU 不在、点名的卡不存在、上限个数不对、上限超过显存总量……）、独显交不成清单、
+/// 枚举适配器超过等 GPU 的上限、一张参与的卡用不上。
+pub fn open_background_gpu_compute(
+    selection: &BackgroundGpuSelection,
+) -> Result<BackgroundGpuComputeHandle, BackgroundGpuOpenRefused> {
+    let background_gpu = open_background_gpu(selection)?;
+    Ok(BackgroundGpuComputeHandle::of_an_implementation(
+        BackgroundGpuComputeOnTheParticipatingGpus::with_no_entry_uncertain(background_gpu),
+    ))
+}
+
+/// 本包一条的判定换成核心层的：三种一一对应，结局照 `outcome_for_the_core` 换。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn core_decision_of_the_entry<KernelOutcome, CoreOutcome>(
+    decision: EntryDecision<KernelOutcome>,
+    outcome_for_the_core: impl Fn(KernelOutcome) -> CoreOutcome,
+) -> GpuEntryDecision<CoreOutcome> {
+    match decision {
+        EntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(outcome) => {
+            GpuEntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(outcome_for_the_core(outcome))
+        }
+        EntryDecision::UncertainThisRound => GpuEntryDecision::UncertainThisRound,
+        EntryDecision::JudgedByTheCpuReference(outcome) => {
+            GpuEntryDecision::JudgedByTheCpuReference(outcome_for_the_core(outcome))
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// 甲段一批交不成，报给核心层是哪一种：GPU 出错（含等 GPU 超过上限、前一次超时的提交没等到做完）是 `GpuFailed`；
+/// 单个单元装不进一段（第一版不支持，一张卡都没交活）是 `InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu`。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn core_failure_of_the_checksum_batch(
+    failed: &ChecksumBatchFailed,
+) -> BackgroundGpuComputeFailed {
+    match failed {
+        ChecksumBatchFailed::GpuFailed { .. } => BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::GpuFailed,
+        ChecksumBatchFailed::UnitLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu { .. } => {
+            BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// 乙段一批交不成，报给核心层是哪一种：GPU 出错是 `GpuFailed`；映射 key 比核装得下的长、映射装不进一个绑定、单条记录装不进一段
+/// （第一版不支持，一张卡都没交活）是 `InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu`。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn core_failure_of_the_region_record_batch(
+    failed: &RegionRecordBatchFailed,
+) -> BackgroundGpuComputeFailed {
+    match failed {
+        RegionRecordBatchFailed::GpuFailed { .. } => BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::GpuFailed,
+        RegionRecordBatchFailed::MappingKeyLongerThanTheKernelsHold(..)
+        | RegionRecordBatchFailed::MappingTablesLargerThanABindingOnTheGpu { .. }
+        | RegionRecordBatchFailed::RecordLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu { .. } => {
+            BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// 丙段一批交不成，报给核心层是哪一种：GPU 出错是 `GpuFailed`；记录表装不进一个绑定、单个段连同记录表装不进一段
+/// （第一版不支持，一张卡都没交活）是 `InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu`。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn core_failure_of_the_live_slot_batch(
+    failed: &LiveSlotBatchFailed,
+) -> BackgroundGpuComputeFailed {
+    match failed {
+        LiveSlotBatchFailed::GpuFailed { .. } => BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::GpuFailed,
+        LiveSlotBatchFailed::RecordTablesLargerThanABindingOnTheGpu { .. }
+        | LiveSlotBatchFailed::SegmentLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu { .. } => {
+            BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn unit_checksum_outcome_for_the_core(outcome: ChecksumKernelOutcome) -> UnitChecksumOutcome {
+    UnitChecksumOutcome {
+        computed_crc32c: outcome.computed_crc32c,
+        matches_the_expected_crc32c: outcome.matches_the_expected_crc32c,
+    }
+}
+
+impl<Kernels: GpuInventory> GpuInventory for BackgroundGpuComputeThroughBothKernels<Kernels> {
+    fn devices_with_total_memory(&self) -> Vec<(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)> {
+        self.kernels.devices_with_total_memory()
+    }
+}
+
+impl<Kernels: BothKernelsOfTheThreeSegments> BackgroundGpuCompute
+    for BackgroundGpuComputeThroughBothKernels<Kernels>
+{
+    fn verify_unit_checksums(
+        &mut self,
+        units: &[UnitChecksumToVerifyOnTheGpu<'_>],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<GpuEntryDecision<UnitChecksumOutcome>>, BackgroundGpuComputeFailed> {
+        let units: Vec<UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, RegionRecordEntryKey>> = units
+            .iter()
+            .map(|unit| UnitChecksumToVerify {
+                entry_key: unit.entry_key,
+                unit_bytes: unit.unit_bytes,
+                expected_crc32c: unit.expected_crc32c,
+            })
+            .collect();
+        let both_kernel_outcomes = self.kernels.unit_checksums_by_both_kernels(&units);
+        let reconciled = reconciled_unit_checksums(
+            &units,
+            both_kernel_outcomes,
+            &mut self.unit_checksum_uncertainty,
+        )
+        .map_err(|failed| core_failure_of_the_checksum_batch(&failed))?;
+        Ok(reconciled
+            .decisions
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|decision| {
+                core_decision_of_the_entry(decision, unit_checksum_outcome_for_the_core)
+            })
+            .collect())
+    }
+
+    fn classify_region_records(
+        &mut self,
+        region: CompactionRegion,
+        records: &[RegionRecordToClassifyOnTheGpu<'_>],
+        mapping_entries: &[CentralMappingEntry],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<GpuEntryDecision<AllocationInRegion>>, BackgroundGpuComputeFailed> {
+        let records: Vec<RegionRecordToClassify<'_, RegionRecordEntryKey>> = records
+            .iter()
+            .map(|to_classify| RegionRecordToClassify {
+                entry_key: to_classify.entry_key,
+                record: to_classify.record,
+                unit_bytes: to_classify.unit_bytes,
+            })
+            .collect();
+        let both_kernel_classifications =
+            self.kernels
+                .region_record_classes_by_both_kernels(region, &records, mapping_entries);
+        let reconciled = reconciled_region_record_classifications(
+            region,
+            &records,
+            mapping_entries,
+            both_kernel_classifications,
+            &mut self.region_record_uncertainty,
+        )
+        .map_err(|failed| core_failure_of_the_region_record_batch(&failed))?;
+        Ok(reconciled
+            .decisions
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|decision| core_decision_of_the_entry(decision, |class| class))
+            .collect())
+    }
+
+    fn count_live_slots_per_cluster_segment(
+        &mut self,
+        allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+        unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+        segments: &[ClusterSegmentEntryKey],
+    ) -> Result<Vec<GpuEntryDecision<u64>>, BackgroundGpuComputeFailed> {
+        let both_kernel_live_slots =
+            self.kernels
+                .live_slots_by_both_kernels(allocation_records, unit_area, segments);
+        let reconciled = reconciled_live_slots_of_the_segments(
+            allocation_records,
+            unit_area,
+            segments,
+            both_kernel_live_slots,
+            &mut self.live_slot_uncertainty,
+        )
+        .map_err(|failed| core_failure_of_the_live_slot_batch(&failed))?;
+        Ok(reconciled
+            .decisions
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|decision| core_decision_of_the_entry(decision, |live_slots| live_slots))
+            .collect())
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    use std::time::Duration;
+
+    use crate::background_gpu::GpuFailureCause;
+    use crate::checksum_kernels::UnrecognizedVerdictWord;
+    use crate::region_record_kernels::MappingKeyLongerThanTheKernelsHold;
+
+    fn card() -> GpuDeviceIdentifier {
+        GpuDeviceIdentifier::of_opaque_bytes(b"0000:01:00.0".to_vec())
+    }
+
+    /// 本包报得出的每一种 GPU 出错，连同两种超时（这一次交的段等超过上限、前一次超时的那次提交又没等到做完）。
+    fn every_gpu_failure_cause() -> Vec<GpuFailureCause> {
+        let wait_limit = Duration::from_secs(10);
+        vec![
+            GpuFailureCause::DeviceOrPipelineDidNotStart {
+                reason: "假的：起不了设备".to_string(),
+            },
+            GpuFailureCause::UncapturedErrorOrDeviceLost {
+                reason: "假的：设备丢了".to_string(),
+            },
+            GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheSubmissionFailed {
+                reason: "假的：等不成".to_string(),
+            },
+            GpuFailureCause::WaitForTheGpuExceededTheLimit { wait_limit },
+            GpuFailureCause::EarlierTimedOutSubmissionNotCompleteWithinTheWaitLimit { wait_limit },
+            GpuFailureCause::ReadbackMappingFailed {
+                reason: "假的：映射不成".to_string(),
+            },
+            GpuFailureCause::KernelLeftAnUnrecognizedVerdictWord(UnrecognizedVerdictWord {
+                entry_position: 0,
+                verdict_word: 7,
+            }),
+        ]
+    }
+
+    /// 第 4 条：GPU 出错与等 GPU 超过上限（用户 2026-10-26 定「超时算出错」）三段都报成核心层的 `GpuFailed`。
+    #[test]
+    fn every_gpu_failure_and_both_timeouts_are_reported_to_the_core_as_gpu_failed() {
+        for cause in every_gpu_failure_cause() {
+            assert_eq!(
+                core_failure_of_the_checksum_batch(&ChecksumBatchFailed::GpuFailed {
+                    device: card(),
+                    cause: cause.clone(),
+                }),
+                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::GpuFailed,
+                "甲段：{cause:?}"
+            );
+            assert_eq!(
+                core_failure_of_the_region_record_batch(&RegionRecordBatchFailed::GpuFailed {
+                    device: card(),
+                    cause: cause.clone(),
+                }),
+                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::GpuFailed,
+                "乙段：{cause:?}"
+            );
+            assert_eq!(
+                core_failure_of_the_live_slot_batch(&LiveSlotBatchFailed::GpuFailed {
+                    device: card(),
+                    cause: cause.clone(),
+                }),
+                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::GpuFailed,
+                "丙段：{cause:?}"
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// GPU 那一侧第一版不支持的输入（一张卡都没交活）三段都报成核心层的 `InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu`。
+    #[test]
+    fn inputs_the_first_version_does_not_support_on_the_gpu_are_reported_as_input_not_supported() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            core_failure_of_the_checksum_batch(
+                &ChecksumBatchFailed::UnitLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                    device: card(),
+                    entry_position: 3,
+                    unit_bytes: 1 << 20,
+                }
+            ),
+            BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu
+        );
+        for failed in [
+            RegionRecordBatchFailed::MappingKeyLongerThanTheKernelsHold(
+                MappingKeyLongerThanTheKernelsHold {
+                    entry_position: 0,
+                    key_bytes: 29,
+                },
+            ),
+            RegionRecordBatchFailed::MappingTablesLargerThanABindingOnTheGpu {
+                device: card(),
+                largest_buffer_bytes: 1 << 32,
+            },
+            RegionRecordBatchFailed::RecordLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                device: card(),
+                entry_position: 1,
+                unit_bytes: 32 << 10,
+            },
+        ] {
+            assert_eq!(
+                core_failure_of_the_region_record_batch(&failed),
+                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu,
+                "乙段：{failed:?}"
+            );
+        }
+        for failed in [
+            LiveSlotBatchFailed::RecordTablesLargerThanABindingOnTheGpu {
+                device: card(),
+                largest_buffer_bytes: 1 << 32,
+            },
+            LiveSlotBatchFailed::SegmentLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                device: card(),
+                entry_position: 2,
+            },
+        ] {
+            assert_eq!(
+                core_failure_of_the_live_slot_batch(&failed),
+                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu,
+                "丙段：{failed:?}"
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn each_entry_decision_maps_to_the_core_decision_of_the_same_kind() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            core_decision_of_the_entry(EntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(5_u32), u64::from),
+            GpuEntryDecision::ConfirmedByBothKernels(5_u64)
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            core_decision_of_the_entry(EntryDecision::<u32>::UncertainThisRound, u64::from),
+            GpuEntryDecision::<u64>::UncertainThisRound
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            core_decision_of_the_entry(EntryDecision::JudgedByTheCpuReference(9_u32), u64::from),
+            GpuEntryDecision::JudgedByTheCpuReference(9_u64)
+        );
+    }
+}
diff --git a/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernels.rs b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernels.rs
index a408a94..6ddc328 100644
--- a/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernels.rs
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/checksum_kernels.rs
@@ -9,6 +9,9 @@
 //!   开算之前整块填 [`OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD`]：核没写到的那一条读回来判定字不是 0 也不是 1，按 GPU 出错交回。
 
 use crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::ChunkFootprint;
+use crate::two_kernel_reconciliation::{
+    ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts, ReconciledBatch, TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry,
+};
 
 /// 按字节查表的那一份核（`crc32c_by_byte_remainder_table`）。
 pub const TABLE_DRIVEN_KERNEL_SOURCE: &str = include_str!("checksum_kernel_table_driven.wgsl");
@@ -190,6 +193,41 @@ pub fn cpu_reference_outcome(unit_bytes: &[u8], expected_crc32c: u32) -> Checksu
     }
 }
 
+/// 扫描里的校验和核对一批的比对（第 8 条）：两份核的结果交进来（按 `units` 的次序，查表那一份在前），逐条比、更新计数；
+/// 连续不确定到 N 轮的条目交 CPU 参照（[`cpu_reference_outcome`]）现判。这一批出错就原样交回出错、计数不动、CPU 参照不调。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// `both_kernel_outcomes` 是 `Err` 时交回它。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 两份核交回的条数与 `units` 不等；同一个条目键在一批里出现两次。
+pub fn reconciled_unit_checksums<EntryKey: Eq + std::hash::Hash + Clone, BatchFailure>(
+    units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, EntryKey>],
+    both_kernel_outcomes: Result<Vec<(ChecksumKernelOutcome, ChecksumKernelOutcome)>, BatchFailure>,
+    uncertainty: &mut ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<EntryKey>,
+) -> Result<ReconciledBatch<ChecksumKernelOutcome>, BatchFailure> {
+    let both_kernel_outcomes = both_kernel_outcomes.map(|outcomes| {
+        assert_eq!(outcomes.len(), units.len(), "两份核每条各交一个结果");
+        units
+            .iter()
+            .zip(outcomes)
+            .map(
+                |(unit, (table_driven, bitwise))| TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry {
+                    entry_key: unit.entry_key.clone(),
+                    outcome_by_one_kernel: table_driven,
+                    outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: bitwise,
+                },
+            )
+            .collect()
+    });
+    uncertainty.reconcile_unless_the_batch_failed(both_kernel_outcomes, |entry_position| {
+        cpu_reference_outcome(
+            units[entry_position].unit_bytes,
+            units[entry_position].expected_crc32c,
+        )
+    })
+}
+

 //!   校验和核对那一段的打包与回读解码（[`checksum_kernels`]）、区域扫描里单元头解析与映射反查那一段的打包、回读解码与 CPU 参照

-//! - 起 GPU 的外壳（[`background_gpu`]）：枚举 wgpu 适配器、在参与的卡上起设备、量一次提交的主机 CPU 时间、交一批校验和核对或一批区域扫描的记录。

 pub mod adapter_inventory;
 pub mod background_gpu;
+pub mod background_gpu_compute;
 pub mod checksum_kernels;
```
