```diff
diff --git a/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernel_searching_sorted_records.wgsl b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernel_searching_sorted_records.wgsl
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0ba7033
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernel_searching_sorted_records.wgsl
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+// 选段打分里每个聚簇段的活槽数，两份独立核里在按（盘、槽号）排好的记录序号上二分、逐槽数的那一份（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 8 条：两份核不共用核函数）。
+// 每个段一个调用：分配记录的跨度是两字节无符号数，起点比这一段的头一个槽早 65535 槽以上的记录罩不到这一段；在排好的序号上二分出单元区那块盘上
+// 起点不早于「这一段的头一个槽减 65535」的第一条、与起点不早于「这一段之后的第一个槽」的第一条，两者之间的每条未释放记录从它的头一个槽起
+// 逐槽往后走、落进这一段的槽各数一次（几条记录罩住同一个槽各算一次，同核心层 compaction_plan::live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records）。
+// 64 位的数在这里按（高 32 位、低 32 位）两个 u32 存，比较、加一、减法都在这里自己写。
+// 另一份（live_slot_kernel_walking_every_record.wgsl）逐条走遍记录、按区间相交算长度；两份只共用缓冲布局，布局由 src/live_slot_kernels.rs 定。
+
+struct SearchingParameters {
+    segment_count: u32,
+    record_count: u32,
+    unit_area_device: u32,
+    unused_word: u32,
+}
+
+struct BoundsOfTheSegment {
+    start_slot_low: u32,
+    start_slot_high: u32,
+    end_slot_low: u32,
+    end_slot_high: u32,
+}
+
+struct AllocationRecordToSearch {
+    device: u32,
+    slot_low: u32,
+    slot_high: u32,
+    span: u32,
+    released: u32,
+}
+
+struct CountOfTheSearch {
+    count_low: u32,
+    count_high: u32,
+    written_word: u32,
+}
+
+@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> searching_parameters: SearchingParameters;
+@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> bounds_of_the_segments: array<BoundsOfTheSegment>;
+@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> allocation_records_to_search: array<AllocationRecordToSearch>;
+@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read> record_positions_by_device_and_slot: array<u32>;
+@group(0) @binding(4) var<storage, read_write> counts_of_the_search: array<CountOfTheSearch>;
+
+// 分配记录的跨度最多这么多个槽（两字节无符号数的最大值）。
+const LONGEST_SPAN_OF_AN_ALLOCATION_RECORD: u32 = 65535u;
+// 没释放的记录那一个字（src/live_slot_kernels.rs 打包时写 0，释放了写 1）。
+const RELEASED_FLAG_CLEAR: u32 = 0u;
+const COUNT_WRITTEN: u32 = 1u;
+
+struct WideNumber {
+    high: u32,
+    low: u32,
+}
+
+fn wide_is_less(left: WideNumber, right: WideNumber) -> bool {
+    if (left.high != right.high) {
+        return left.high < right.high;
+    }
+    return left.low < right.low;
+}
+
+fn wide_plus_one(number: WideNumber) -> WideNumber {
+    if (number.low == 0xFFFFFFFFu) {
+        return WideNumber(number.high + 1u, 0u);
+    }
+    return WideNumber(number.high, number.low + 1u);
+}
+
+// 减去一个 32 位数，比 0 小就停在 0。
+fn wide_minus_or_zero(number: WideNumber, amount: u32) -> WideNumber {
+    if (number.low >= amount) {
+        return WideNumber(number.high, number.low - amount);
+    }
+    if (number.high == 0u) {
+        return WideNumber(0u, 0u);
+    }
+    // 借一位：低 32 位回绕
+    return WideNumber(number.high - 1u, number.low - amount);
+}
+
+// 排在第 sorted_number 位的记录是不是排在（device, slot）之前：按（盘、槽号）比。
+fn sorted_record_comes_before(sorted_number: u32, device: u32, slot: WideNumber) -> bool {
+    let record = allocation_records_to_search[record_positions_by_device_and_slot[sorted_number]];
+    if (record.device != device) {
+        return record.device < device;
+    }
+    return wide_is_less(WideNumber(record.slot_high, record.slot_low), slot);
+}
+
+// 排好的序号里第一条不排在（device, slot）之前的位置；都排在前面时交回记录数。
+fn first_sorted_number_from(device: u32, slot: WideNumber) -> u32 {
+    var below = 0u;
+    var above = searching_parameters.record_count;
+    while (below < above) {
+        let middle = below + (above - below) / 2u;
+        if (sorted_record_comes_before(middle, device, slot)) {
+            below = middle + 1u;
+        } else {
+            above = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return below;
+}
+
+@compute @workgroup_size(64)
+fn count_live_slots_searching_the_sorted_records(@builtin(global_invocation_id) invocation: vec3<u32>) {
+    let segment_position = invocation.x;
+    if (segment_position >= searching_parameters.segment_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+    let bounds = bounds_of_the_segments[segment_position];
+    let start_of_the_segment = WideNumber(bounds.start_slot_high, bounds.start_slot_low);
+    let end_of_the_segment = WideNumber(bounds.end_slot_high, bounds.end_slot_low);
+    let device = searching_parameters.unit_area_device;
+    let earliest_start_reaching_the_segment = wide_minus_or_zero(start_of_the_segment, LONGEST_SPAN_OF_AN_ALLOCATION_RECORD);
+    let past_the_candidates = first_sorted_number_from(device, end_of_the_segment);
+    var count = WideNumber(0u, 0u);
+    for (var sorted_number = first_sorted_number_from(device, earliest_start_reaching_the_segment); sorted_number < past_the_candidates; sorted_number = sorted_number + 1u) {
+        let record = allocation_records_to_search[record_positions_by_device_and_slot[sorted_number]];
+        if (record.released != RELEASED_FLAG_CLEAR) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        var slot = WideNumber(record.slot_high, record.slot_low);
+        for (var step = 0u; step < record.span; step = step + 1u) {
+            if (!wide_is_less(slot, start_of_the_segment) && wide_is_less(slot, end_of_the_segment)) {
+                count = wide_plus_one(count);
+            }
+            slot = wide_plus_one(slot);
+        }
+    }
+    counts_of_the_search[segment_position] = CountOfTheSearch(count.low, count.high, COUNT_WRITTEN);
+}
diff --git a/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernel_walking_every_record.wgsl b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernel_walking_every_record.wgsl
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0c92daf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernel_walking_every_record.wgsl
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+// 选段打分里每个聚簇段的活槽数，两份独立核里逐条走遍分配记录、按区间相交算长度的那一份（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 8 条：两份核不共用核函数）。
+// 每个段一个调用：从头到尾走一遍这一段的分配记录表，只看单元区那块盘上、未释放的记录，按「记录罩住的槽区间与这一段的槽区间相交多长」一次算出
+// 它在这一段里罩住几个槽，加起来（几条记录罩住同一个槽各算一次，同核心层 compaction_plan::live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records）。
+// 槽号是 64 位：两个 u32 拼成 vec2（x 是低 32 位、y 是高 32 位），比较与加法在这里自己写；活槽数也按 64 位累加。
+// 另一份（live_slot_kernel_searching_sorted_records.wgsl）在按（盘、槽号）排好的序号上二分出可能落进这一段的记录、逐槽数；
+// 两份只共用缓冲布局，布局由 src/live_slot_kernels.rs 定。
+
+struct WalkingChunkParameters {
+    number_of_segments: u32,
+    number_of_records: u32,
+    device_of_the_unit_area: u32,
+    word_left_unused: u32,
+}
+
+struct SegmentToWalk {
+    first_slot_low: u32,
+    first_slot_high: u32,
+    slot_past_the_segment_low: u32,
+    slot_past_the_segment_high: u32,
+}
+
+struct RecordToWalk {
+    device_of_the_record: u32,
+    first_slot_low: u32,
+    first_slot_high: u32,
+    span_in_slots: u32,
+    released_word: u32,
+}
+
+struct LiveSlotsOfTheWalk {
+    live_slots_low: u32,
+    live_slots_high: u32,
+    verdict_word: u32,
+}
+
+@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> walking_parameters: WalkingChunkParameters;
+@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> segments_to_walk: array<SegmentToWalk>;
+@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> records_to_walk: array<RecordToWalk>;
+@group(0) @binding(4) var<storage, read_write> live_slots_of_the_walk: array<LiveSlotsOfTheWalk>;
+
+// 记录释放了的那一个字（src/live_slot_kernels.rs 打包时写 1，没释放写 0）。
+const RELEASED_WORD_OF_A_RELEASED_RECORD: u32 = 1u;
+// 判定字：这一段数完了。
+const VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED: u32 = 1u;
+
+fn slot_is_before(left: vec2<u32>, right: vec2<u32>) -> bool {
+    return left.y < right.y || (left.y == right.y && left.x < right.x);
+}
+
+fn later_of_the_slots(left: vec2<u32>, right: vec2<u32>) -> vec2<u32> {
+    if (slot_is_before(left, right)) {
+        return right;
+    }
+    return left;
+}
+
+fn earlier_of_the_slots(left: vec2<u32>, right: vec2<u32>) -> vec2<u32> {
+    if (slot_is_before(left, right)) {
+        return left;
+    }
+    return right;
+}
+
+fn slot_past_the_span(first_slot: vec2<u32>, span_in_slots: u32) -> vec2<u32> {
+    let low_word = first_slot.x + span_in_slots;
+    let carry = select(0u, 1u, low_word < first_slot.x);
+    return vec2<u32>(low_word, first_slot.y + carry);
+}
+
+@compute @workgroup_size(64)
+fn count_live_slots_walking_every_record(@builtin(global_invocation_id) invocation: vec3<u32>) {
+    let segment_number = invocation.x;
+    if (segment_number >= walking_parameters.number_of_segments) {
+        return;
+    }
+    let segment = segments_to_walk[segment_number];
+    let segment_first_slot = vec2<u32>(segment.first_slot_low, segment.first_slot_high);
+    let slot_past_the_segment = vec2<u32>(segment.slot_past_the_segment_low, segment.slot_past_the_segment_high);
+    var live_slots_low = 0u;
+    var live_slots_high = 0u;
+    for (var record_number = 0u; record_number < walking_parameters.number_of_records; record_number = record_number + 1u) {
+        let record = records_to_walk[record_number];
+        if (record.device_of_the_record != walking_parameters.device_of_the_unit_area) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        if (record.released_word == RELEASED_WORD_OF_A_RELEASED_RECORD) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        let record_first_slot = vec2<u32>(record.first_slot_low, record.first_slot_high);
+        let slot_past_the_record = slot_past_the_span(record_first_slot, record.span_in_slots);
+        let first_slot_of_both = later_of_the_slots(record_first_slot, segment_first_slot);
+        let slot_past_both = earlier_of_the_slots(slot_past_the_record, slot_past_the_segment);
+        if (slot_is_before(first_slot_of_both, slot_past_both)) {
+            // 相交的那一截在这一段之内，比 2^32 短：低 32 位相减就是它的槽数
+            let slots_in_both = slot_past_both.x - first_slot_of_both.x;
+            let sum_low = live_slots_low + slots_in_both;
+            live_slots_high = live_slots_high + select(0u, 1u, sum_low < live_slots_low);
+            live_slots_low = sum_low;
+        }
+    }
+    live_slots_of_the_walk[segment_number] = LiveSlotsOfTheWalk(live_slots_low, live_slots_high, VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED);
+}
diff --git a/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernels.rs b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernels.rs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..eaec9b0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/live_slot_kernels.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,578 @@
+//! 选段打分（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1 条点名的三段里的「丙」）：两份独立写的 WGSL 核（第 8 条，不共用核函数）对同一批聚簇段
+//! 各数一次活槽数，逐段交回。这里是两份核共用的缓冲布局、打包、回读解码、CPU 参照与比对，都是纯函数；起 GPU 的在 `background_gpu`。
+//!
+//! 放上 GPU 的是核心层 `singlefs_core::compaction_plan::live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records` 那一步：单元区那块盘上每个整段的活槽数
+//! （未释放记录罩住、落在这一段里的槽数；几条记录罩住同一个槽各算一次；落在单元区之前与末尾凑不满一段的槽不算）。
+//! 判的全在核里：哪条记录在这块盘上、释放了没有、罩住这一段的哪几个槽。CPU 只按次序打包，另按（盘、槽号）排一份序号给二分查的那一份核。
+//! CPU 参照（[`cpu_reference_live_slots`]）就是核心层那个函数；整段的上下界取核心层的 `CompactionRegion`（一个整段就是一个整理区域的形状）。
+//!
+//! 缓冲布局（两份核按同一个绑定号读写，各有各的输出缓冲；逐条走的那一份只绑 0、1、2、4，二分查的那一份五个都绑）：
+//! - 绑定 0，uniform：这一段的段数、记录数、单元区那块盘的盘号、一个不用的字（缓冲占 [`LIVE_SLOT_PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES`]）。
+//! - 绑定 1，只读存储：每个段一项，[`SEGMENT_BOUND_WORDS`] 个 `u32`：头一个槽的低 32 位与高 32 位、这一段之后第一个槽的低 32 位与高 32 位。
+//! - 绑定 2，只读存储：这一批的分配记录每条一项，[`ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS`] 个 `u32`：盘、槽号低 32 位、高 32 位、跨度、释放了没有（1 是释放了），
+//!   按交进来的次序；哪块盘的都交，核自己筛。
+//! - 绑定 3，只读存储：记录在表里的序号，按（盘、槽号、序号）升序。
+//! - 绑定 4，读写存储：每个段一项结果，[`LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_WORDS`] 个 `u32`：活槽数的低 32 位、高 32 位、判定字（1 是数完了）。
+//!   开算之前整块填 [`LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD`]：核没写到的那一段读回来判定字认不得，按 GPU 出错交回。
+//!
+//! 记录一条都没有时绑定 2、3 照样各放一项全 0 的（wgpu 不许长度为 0 的绑定），条数照参数里的数。
+//! 整份记录表每段都交一份（同区域扫描那一段的整份映射）：一批按段切，记录表不切。
+
+use singlefs_core::address::SlotNumber;
+use singlefs_core::allocator::AllocationRecord;
+use singlefs_core::background_compute::ClusterSegmentEntryKey;
+use singlefs_core::compaction_plan::{
+    cluster_segment_entry_keys_of_the_unit_area, live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records,
+    UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+};
+use singlefs_core::logged_operations::CompactionRegion;
+
+use crate::checksum_kernels::UnrecognizedVerdictWord;
+use crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::ChunkFootprint;
+use crate::two_kernel_reconciliation::{
+    ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts, ReconciledBatch, TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry,
+};
+
+/// 逐条走遍记录、按区间相交算长度的那一份核。
+pub const WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_SOURCE: &str =
+    include_str!("live_slot_kernel_walking_every_record.wgsl");
+pub const WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT: &str = "count_live_slots_walking_every_record";
+/// 在按（盘、槽号）排好的序号上二分、逐槽数的那一份核。
+pub const SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_SOURCE: &str =
+    include_str!("live_slot_kernel_searching_sorted_records.wgsl");
+pub const SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT: &str =
+    "count_live_slots_searching_the_sorted_records";
+
+/// 两份核的工作组都是 64 个调用（两份 WGSL 里的 `@workgroup_size(64)`），每个段一个调用。
+pub const LIVE_SLOT_INVOCATIONS_PER_WORKGROUP: u32 = 64;
+/// 参数缓冲：四个 `u32`。
+pub const LIVE_SLOT_PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES: u64 = 16;
+pub const SEGMENT_BOUND_WORDS: usize = 4;
+pub const SEGMENT_BOUND_BYTES: u64 = 16;
+pub const ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS: usize = 5;
+pub const LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_WORDS: usize = 3;
+pub const LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_BYTES: u64 = 12;
+/// 结果缓冲开算之前的填充字：判定字只会被核写成 [`VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED`]。
+pub const LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;
+/// 判定字：这一段数完了（两份 WGSL 里各写一份同值的常量）。
+const VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED: u32 = 1;
+/// 释放了没有那一个字（两份 WGSL 里各写一份同值的常量）。
+const RELEASED_WORD_OF_A_RELEASED_RECORD: u32 = 1;
+const RELEASED_WORD_OF_A_LIVE_RECORD: u32 = 0;
+/// 两份核各一个结果缓冲与一个回读暂存缓冲。
+const LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_AND_READBACK_BUFFERS: u64 = 4;
+
+fn low_and_high_words_of_the_slot(slot: SlotNumber) -> [u32; 2] {
+    [
+        u32::try_from(slot.0 & u64::from(u32::MAX)).expect("取了低 32 位"),
+        u32::try_from(slot.0 >> 32).expect("盘上槽号是 6 字节，高 32 位装得进 u32"),
+    ]
+}
+
+/// 交给两份核的分配记录：记录表与按（盘、槽号）排的序号（见本模块文件头的布局）。一批建一次，同一批的各段共用。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels {
+    /// 记录表的字；没有记录时是一项全 0 的。
+    pub record_words: Vec<u32>,
+    /// 按（盘、槽号、序号）排的序号；没有记录时是一个 0。
+    pub record_positions_by_device_and_slot: Vec<u32>,
+    pub record_count: u32,
+}
+
+impl AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels {
+    /// 走一遍记录建两样。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 记录数装不进 `u32`：一批的分配记录远少于此（一块 64 TiB 的盘满打满算 2^32 个 16 KiB 槽）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_the_allocation_records(allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord]) -> Self {
+        let mut record_words =
+            Vec::with_capacity(allocation_records.len() * ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS);
+        for record in allocation_records {
+            let [slot_low, slot_high] = low_and_high_words_of_the_slot(record.slot);
+            let released_word = if record.is_released {
+                RELEASED_WORD_OF_A_RELEASED_RECORD
+            } else {
+                RELEASED_WORD_OF_A_LIVE_RECORD
+            };
+            record_words.extend_from_slice(&[
+                record.device.0,
+                slot_low,
+                slot_high,
+                u32::from(record.span_slots),
+                released_word,
+            ]);
+        }
+        let record_count =
+            u32::try_from(allocation_records.len()).expect("一批的分配记录数装得进 u32");
+        let mut record_positions_by_device_and_slot: Vec<u32> = (0..record_count).collect();
+        record_positions_by_device_and_slot.sort_by_key(|position| {
+            let record = &allocation_records[usize::try_from(*position).expect("u32 装得进 usize")];
+            (record.device.0, record.slot.0, *position)
+        });
+        if record_words.is_empty() {
+            record_words.resize(ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS, 0);
+            record_positions_by_device_and_slot.push(0);
+        }
+        Self {
+            record_words,
+            record_positions_by_device_and_slot,
+            record_count,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 两个缓冲在卡上合占的字节数。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn bytes_on_the_gpu(&self) -> u64 {
+        let words = self.record_words.len() + self.record_positions_by_device_and_slot.len();
+        4 * u64::try_from(words).expect("装得进 u64")
+    }
+
+    /// 两个缓冲里大的那一个的字节数：它也要装得进这张卡的绑定上限。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn largest_buffer_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
+        let words = self
+            .record_words
+            .len()
+            .max(self.record_positions_by_device_and_slot.len());
+        4 * u64::try_from(words).expect("装得进 u64")
+    }
+}
+
+/// 选段打分一段在卡上占的：参数缓冲与整份记录表（两个缓冲，每段都交一份）；每个段一项上下界（当这一段的「输入」算）、
+/// 两份核各一项结果与一项回读暂存。按条排的最大缓冲（输入之外）是结果那一个。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn live_slot_chunk_footprint(
+    record_tables: &AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels,
+) -> ChunkFootprint {
+    ChunkFootprint {
+        bytes_per_chunk_besides_the_entries: LIVE_SLOT_PARAMETER_BUFFER_BYTES
+            + record_tables.bytes_on_the_gpu(),
+        bytes_per_entry_besides_its_input: LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_AND_READBACK_BUFFERS
+            * LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_BYTES,
+        bytes_per_entry_in_the_largest_entry_buffer: LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_BYTES,
+    }
+}
+
+/// 每个段的上下界：头一个槽与这一段之后第一个槽，取核心层一个整段的整理区域的形状。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 某个条目键的起点不是聚簇段的起点：条目键由核心层按单元区的整段给（`cluster_segment_entry_keys_of_the_unit_area`），单元区起点落在段边界上。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn segment_bound_words(segments: &[ClusterSegmentEntryKey]) -> Vec<u32> {
+    segments
+        .iter()
+        .flat_map(|segment| {
+            let region =
+                CompactionRegion::of_one_cluster_segment(segment.device, segment.start_slot)
+                    .expect("条目键由核心层按单元区的整段给：起点落在聚簇段边界上");
+            let [start_low, start_high] = low_and_high_words_of_the_slot(region.start_slot());
+            let [end_low, end_high] = low_and_high_words_of_the_slot(region.end_slot());
+            [start_low, start_high, end_low, end_high]
+        })
+        .collect()
+}
+
+/// 参数缓冲的字节。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn live_slot_parameter_bytes(
+    segment_count: u32,
+    record_tables: &AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels,
+    unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+) -> Vec<u8> {
+    [
+        segment_count,
+        record_tables.record_count,
+        unit_area.device.0,
+        0,
+    ]
+    .iter()
+    .flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes())
+    .collect()
+}
+
+/// 结果缓冲开算之前的内容：每个字都是填充字。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn live_slot_outcome_buffer_before_the_kernel_writes(segment_count: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
+    std::iter::repeat_n(
+        LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD.to_le_bytes(),
+        segment_count * LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_WORDS,
+    )
+    .flatten()
+    .collect()
+}
+
+/// 把读回的结果字节解成每个段一个活槽数。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 某一段的判定字不是 [`VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED`]（核没写到它，还是填充字，或写坏了）。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 字节数不是每段 [`LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_BYTES`] 的整数倍：回读缓冲按段数建，长度对不上是外壳的 bug。
+pub fn decoded_live_slot_outcomes(
+    readback_bytes: &[u8],
+) -> Result<Vec<u64>, UnrecognizedVerdictWord> {
+    let (outcome_records, leftover_bytes) =
+        readback_bytes.as_chunks::<{ 4 * LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_WORDS }>();
+    assert!(
+        leftover_bytes.is_empty(),
+        "回读的字节数是每段 12 字节的整数倍"
+    );
+    outcome_records
+        .iter()
+        .enumerate()
+        .map(|(entry_position, outcome_record)| {
+            let (word_bytes, _no_leftover) = outcome_record.as_chunks::<4>();
+            let [live_slots_low, live_slots_high, verdict_word] =
+                std::array::from_fn(|word_position| u32::from_le_bytes(word_bytes[word_position]));
+            if verdict_word != VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED {
+                return Err(UnrecognizedVerdictWord {
+                    entry_position,
+                    verdict_word,
+                });
+            }
+            Ok(u64::from(live_slots_low) | (u64::from(live_slots_high) << 32))
+        })
+        .collect()
+}
+
+/// CPU 那一份实现（连续不确定的段交它判；对拍也拿它当参照）：核心层的 `live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records`，
+/// 按段起点从小到大一个整段一个。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn cpu_reference_live_slots(
+    allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+    unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+) -> Vec<u64> {
+    live_slots_per_cluster_segment_by_the_records(allocation_records, unit_area)
+}
+
+/// 选段打分一批的比对（第 8 条）：两份核数出的活槽数交进来，逐段比、更新计数；连续不确定到 N 轮的段交 CPU 参照现判
+/// （整块单元区的 CPU 参照只在头一次要它时数一遍）。这一批出错就原样交回出错、计数不动、CPU 参照不调。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// `both_kernel_live_slots` 是 `Err` 时交回它。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// `segments` 不是 `unit_area` 的整段按起点升序一个不漏（核心层 `BackgroundGpuCompute::count_live_slots_per_cluster_segment` 的约定）；
+/// 两份核交回的段数与 `segments` 不等。
+pub fn reconciled_live_slots_of_the_segments<BatchFailure>(
+    allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+    unit_area: UnitAreaOfOneDevice,
+    segments: &[ClusterSegmentEntryKey],
+    both_kernel_live_slots: Result<Vec<(u64, u64)>, BatchFailure>,
+    uncertainty: &mut ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<ClusterSegmentEntryKey>,
+) -> Result<ReconciledBatch<u64>, BatchFailure> {
+    assert_eq!(
+        segments,
+        cluster_segment_entry_keys_of_the_unit_area(unit_area).as_slice(),
+        "丙段交进来的是单元区的整段、按起点升序、一段一个"
+    );
+    let both_kernel_outcomes = both_kernel_live_slots.map(|live_slots| {
+        assert_eq!(live_slots.len(), segments.len(), "两份核每段各交一个数");
+        segments
+            .iter()
+            .zip(live_slots)
+            .map(
+                |(segment, (walking, searching))| TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry {
+                    entry_key: *segment,
+                    outcome_by_one_kernel: walking,
+                    outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: searching,
+                },
+            )
+            .collect()
+    });
+    let mut cpu_reference: Option<Vec<u64>> = None;
+    uncertainty.reconcile_unless_the_batch_failed(both_kernel_outcomes, |entry_position| {
+        cpu_reference.get_or_insert_with(|| cpu_reference_live_slots(allocation_records, unit_area))
+            [entry_position]
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    use singlefs_core::address::{CheckpointTxg, DeviceIdentity};
+    use singlefs_core::allocator::{AllocationRecordQuarantineMark, UnitAreaStart};
+
+    const UNIT_AREA_DEVICE: DeviceIdentity = DeviceIdentity(0);
+    const OTHER_DEVICE: DeviceIdentity = DeviceIdentity(1);
+
+    fn record(
+        device: DeviceIdentity,
+        slot: u64,
+        span_slots: u16,
+        is_released: bool,
+    ) -> AllocationRecord {
+        AllocationRecord {
+            device,
+            slot: SlotNumber(slot),
+            span_slots,
+            generation: CheckpointTxg(3),
+            is_released,
+            quarantine_mark: AllocationRecordQuarantineMark::NotQuarantined,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 默认环长下的单元区，三个整段加末尾 10 个槽。
+    fn unit_area_of_three_segments() -> UnitAreaOfOneDevice {
+        let segment_slots = CompactionRegion::of_one_cluster_segment(
+            UNIT_AREA_DEVICE,
+            UnitAreaStart::of_the_default_journal_ring().slot(),
+        )
+        .expect("单元区起点落在段边界上")
+        .slot_count();
+        UnitAreaOfOneDevice {
+            device: UNIT_AREA_DEVICE,
+            start: UnitAreaStart::of_the_default_journal_ring(),
+            slots: 3 * segment_slots + 10,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn allocation_records_are_listed_in_order_with_their_released_word_and_sorted_by_device_and_slot(
+    ) {
+        let wide_slot = (5_u64 << 32) | 9;
+        let tables = AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels::of_the_allocation_records(&[
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, 900, 2, false),
+            record(OTHER_DEVICE, 100, 1, false),
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, wide_slot, 3, true),
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, 100, 1, false),
+        ]);
+        assert_eq!(
+            tables.record_words,
+            vec![
+                0, 900, 0, 2, 0, //
+                1, 100, 0, 1, 0, //
+                0, 9, 5, 3, 1, //
+                0, 100, 0, 1, 0,
+            ],
+            "盘、槽号低 32 位、高 32 位、跨度、释放了没有，按交进来的次序"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            tables.record_positions_by_device_and_slot,
+            vec![3, 0, 2, 1],
+            "按（盘、槽号）升序：盘 0 的槽 100、900、2^34 多，再盘 1"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(tables.record_count, 4);
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn records_at_the_same_device_and_slot_are_sorted_by_their_position() {
+        let tables = AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels::of_the_allocation_records(&[
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, 70, 1, false),
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, 70, 2, true),
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, 60, 1, false),
+        ]);
+        assert_eq!(
+            tables.record_positions_by_device_and_slot,
+            vec![2, 0, 1],
+            "同盘同槽的按在表里的序号"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn an_empty_record_table_still_has_one_item_in_both_buffers() {
+        let tables = AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels::of_the_allocation_records(&[]);
+        assert_eq!(tables.record_words, vec![0; ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS]);
+        assert_eq!(tables.record_positions_by_device_and_slot, vec![0]);
+        assert_eq!(tables.record_count, 0);
+        assert_eq!(
+            tables.bytes_on_the_gpu(),
+            4 * u64::try_from(ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS + 1).expect("小数")
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn segment_bounds_are_the_first_slot_and_the_slot_past_each_cluster_segment() {
+        let high_start = SlotNumber((1_u64 << 32) + 64);
+        let words = segment_bound_words(&[
+            ClusterSegmentEntryKey {
+                device: UNIT_AREA_DEVICE,
+                start_slot: SlotNumber(128),
+            },
+            ClusterSegmentEntryKey {
+                device: UNIT_AREA_DEVICE,
+                start_slot: high_start,
+            },
+        ]);
+        assert_eq!(
+            words,
+            vec![128, 0, 192, 0, 64, 1, 128, 1],
+            "头一个槽与之后第一个槽各按低 32 位、高 32 位"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn parameters_carry_the_segment_count_the_record_count_and_the_device_of_the_unit_area() {
+        let tables = AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels::of_the_allocation_records(&[record(
+            OTHER_DEVICE,
+            1,
+            1,
+            false,
+        )]);
+        let unit_area = UnitAreaOfOneDevice {
+            device: DeviceIdentity(7),
+            start: unit_area_of_three_segments().start,
+            slots: unit_area_of_three_segments().slots,
+        };
+        assert_eq!(
+            live_slot_parameter_bytes(3, &tables, unit_area),
+            [3_u32, 1, 7, 0]
+                .iter()
+                .flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes())
+                .collect::<Vec<u8>>()
+        );
+    }
+
+    fn outcome_bytes(outcome_words: [u32; LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_WORDS]) -> Vec<u8> {
+        outcome_words
+            .iter()
+            .flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes())
+            .collect()
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn readback_records_decode_into_sixty_four_bit_live_slot_counts() {
+        let mut readback = outcome_bytes([64, 0, VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED]);
+        readback.extend(outcome_bytes([5, 2, VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED]));
+        assert_eq!(
+            decoded_live_slot_outcomes(&readback),
+            Ok(vec![64, (2_u64 << 32) | 5]),
+            "低 32 位、高 32 位拼成一个数"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn an_outcome_the_kernels_never_wrote_is_an_unrecognized_verdict_word() {
+        let mut readback = outcome_bytes([1, 0, VERDICT_WORD_COUNTED]);
+        readback.extend(live_slot_outcome_buffer_before_the_kernel_writes(1));
+        assert_eq!(
+            decoded_live_slot_outcomes(&readback),
+            Err(UnrecognizedVerdictWord {
+                entry_position: 1,
+                verdict_word: LIVE_SLOT_OUTCOME_NOT_WRITTEN_FILL_WORD
+            }),
+            "位置 1 的那一段还是填充字：核没写到它"
+        );
+    }
+
+    /// 第 8 条：两份核对中间那一段数得不一样，这一轮不确定、不问 CPU；下一轮又不一样，交 CPU 参照现判，按核心层数的那个数。
+    #[test]
+    fn a_segment_counted_differently_by_the_two_kernels_is_uncertain_once_and_judged_by_the_cpu_reference_the_next_round(
+    ) {
+        let unit_area = unit_area_of_three_segments();
+        let segments = cluster_segment_entry_keys_of_the_unit_area(unit_area);
+        let middle_segment_start = segments[1].start_slot.0;
+        let records = vec![
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, middle_segment_start, 2, false),
+            record(UNIT_AREA_DEVICE, middle_segment_start + 5, 1, false),
+        ];
+        let reference = cpu_reference_live_slots(&records, unit_area);
+        assert_eq!(reference, vec![0, 3, 0], "核心层数的：中间那一段 3 个活槽");
+        let mut uncertainty = ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain();
+        let disagreeing_on_the_middle_segment = || Ok::<_, ()>(vec![(0, 0), (3, 4), (0, 0)]);
+        let first_round = reconciled_live_slots_of_the_segments(
+            &records,
+            unit_area,
+            &segments,
+            disagreeing_on_the_middle_segment(),
+            &mut uncertainty,
+        )
+        .expect("这一批没出错");
+        assert_eq!(
+            (
+                first_round.confirmed_entries,
+                first_round.uncertain_entries,
+                first_round.entries_judged_by_the_cpu_reference
+            ),
+            (2, 1, 0),
+            "头一轮：不确定一段"
+        );
+        let second_round = reconciled_live_slots_of_the_segments(
+            &records,
+            unit_area,
+            &segments,
+            disagreeing_on_the_middle_segment(),
+            &mut uncertainty,
+        )
+        .expect("这一批没出错");
+        assert_eq!(
+            second_round.decisions[1],
+            crate::two_kernel_reconciliation::EntryDecision::JudgedByTheCpuReference(3),
+            "连续第 2 轮不确定：按核心层数的 3 处理"
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    #[should_panic(expected = "丙段交进来的是单元区的整段")]
+    fn segments_other_than_every_full_segment_of_the_unit_area_panic() {
+        let unit_area = unit_area_of_three_segments();
+        let mut segments = cluster_segment_entry_keys_of_the_unit_area(unit_area);
+        segments.pop();
+        let _reconciled = reconciled_live_slots_of_the_segments(
+            &[],
+            unit_area,
+            &segments,
+            Ok::<_, ()>(vec![(0, 0), (0, 0)]),
+            &mut ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts::with_no_entry_uncertain(),
+        );
+    }
+
+    /// 两份核过得了 wgpu 自带的着色器校验（naga 的 WGSL 前端与校验器，起管线时 wgpu 走的同一步），入口点在、是计算着色器。不要 GPU。
+    #[test]
+    fn both_live_slot_kernels_pass_the_shader_validator() {
+        for (kernel_source, entry_point) in [
+            (
+                WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_SOURCE,
+                WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT,
+            ),
+            (
+                SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_SOURCE,
+                SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT,
+            ),
+        ] {
+            let module =
+                wgpu::naga::front::wgsl::parse_str(kernel_source).unwrap_or_else(|error| {
+                    panic!(
+                        "{entry_point} 那一份解析不成：{}",
+                        error.emit_to_string(kernel_source)
+                    )
+                });
+            wgpu::naga::valid::Validator::new(
+                wgpu::naga::valid::ValidationFlags::all(),
+                wgpu::naga::valid::Capabilities::empty(),
+            )
+            .validate(&module)
+            .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
+                panic!(
+                    "{entry_point} 那一份过不了校验：{}",
+                    error.emit_to_string(kernel_source)
+                )
+            });
+            assert!(
+                module.entry_points.iter().any(|module_entry_point| {
+                    module_entry_point.name == entry_point
+                        && module_entry_point.stage == wgpu::naga::ShaderStage::Compute
+                }),
+                "{entry_point} 是这一份里的计算入口"
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn the_two_kernels_are_separate_sources_with_their_own_entry_points() {
+        assert!(WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_SOURCE
+            .contains(&format!("fn {WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT}(")));
+        assert!(SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_SOURCE.contains(&format!(
+            "fn {SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT}("
+        )));
+        assert!(
+            !SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_SOURCE
+                .contains(WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT)
+                && !WALKING_EVERY_RECORD_KERNEL_SOURCE
+                    .contains(SEARCHING_SORTED_RECORDS_KERNEL_ENTRY_POINT),
+            "两份核不互相引用"
+        );
+    }
+}

@@ -44,6 +44,9 @@ use singlefs_core::unit::{
 
 use crate::checksum_kernels::UnrecognizedVerdictWord;
 use crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::{input_buffer_bytes, ChunkFootprint};
+use crate::two_kernel_reconciliation::{
+    ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts, ReconciledBatch, TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry,
+};
 
 /// 按条目表的次序逐条看映射、按字节查表算校验和的那一份核。
 pub const WALKING_KERNEL_SOURCE: &str =
@@ -555,6 +558,60 @@ pub fn cpu_reference_classification(
     allocation.class
 }
 
+/// 区域扫描里一批记录的比对（第 8 条）：两份核的分类交进来（按 `records` 的次序，逐条走映射那一份在前），逐条比、更新计数；
+/// 连续不确定到 N 轮的记录交 CPU 参照（[`cpu_reference_classification`]）现判，按身份的索引只在头一次要它时建。
+/// 这一批出错就原样交回出错、计数不动、CPU 参照不调。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// `both_kernel_classifications` 是 `Err` 时交回它。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 两份核交回的条数与 `records` 不等；同一个条目键在一批里出现两次；交 CPU 判的那一条不是区域扫描会去读的那一种。
+pub fn reconciled_region_record_classifications<
+    EntryKey: Eq + std::hash::Hash + Clone,
+    BatchFailure,
+>(
+    region: CompactionRegion,
+    records: &[RegionRecordToClassify<'_, EntryKey>],
+    mapping_entries: &[CentralMappingEntry],
+    both_kernel_classifications: Result<
+        Vec<(AllocationInRegion, AllocationInRegion)>,
+        BatchFailure,
+    >,
+    uncertainty: &mut ConsecutiveUncertaintyCounts<EntryKey>,
+) -> Result<ReconciledBatch<AllocationInRegion>, BatchFailure> {
+    let both_kernel_classifications = both_kernel_classifications.map(|classifications| {
+        assert_eq!(
+            classifications.len(),
+            records.len(),
+            "两份核每条各交一个分类"
+        );
+        records
+            .iter()
+            .zip(classifications)
+            .map(
+                |(record, (walking, searching))| TwoKernelOutcomesOfAnEntry {
+                    entry_key: record.entry_key.clone(),
+                    outcome_by_one_kernel: walking,
+                    outcome_by_the_independently_written_kernel: searching,
+                },
+            )
+            .collect()
+    });
+    let mut mapping_index: Option<CentralMappingIdentityIndex<'_>> = None;
+    uncertainty.reconcile_unless_the_batch_failed(both_kernel_classifications, |entry_position| {
+        let index = mapping_index.get_or_insert_with(|| {
+            CentralMappingIdentityIndex::of_the_mapping_entries(mapping_entries)
+        });
+        cpu_reference_classification(
+            region,
+            records[entry_position].record,
+            index,
+            records[entry_position].unit_bytes,
+        )
+    })
+}
```

```diff
 /// 按实例表判仍然有效、带文件的根一条都没有（候选集空），所以这里不收 `PoolVersion`。
+/// 调用方手里有会话这一侧的整理状态（挂着的会话）时走 [`roll_back_by_a_forward_publish_in_the_session`]：它另清会话上的上一条完成的意图。
 ///
 /// # Errors

     }

+/// 会话内回滚：挂着的会话上做一次 [`roll_back_by_a_forward_publish`]，连同会话这一侧的整理状态（`compaction`）一起交进来。
+/// 回退做成（新根持久、交回 `Ok`）时清掉会话上跨趟留着的上一条完成的意图（[`CompactionOfThisMount::last_completed_intent`]），
+/// 下一趟整理从空起、照常签新意图：D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 6 条「签下一条意图那一判跨趟留着」留到回滚为止，
+/// 用户 2026-10-26 定「回滚时清掉」（`records/2026-10-19-里程碑四GPU垃圾回收开工.md`「写段冒出的新发现」那一行）。
+/// 回退被拒、落盘途中失败都没做成，那一条照旧留着。盘上的未完成意图（现行那一版 logged_ops 里那条）不归这里：它随现行那一版跨回退留着、接着推。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 同 [`roll_back_by_a_forward_publish`]。
+pub fn roll_back_by_a_forward_publish_in_the_session<Device: BlockDevice>(
+    parameters: &MakeFilesystemParameters,
+    devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+    allocator: &mut PoolAllocator,
+    current: &mut TransactionOutput,
+    compaction: &mut CompactionOfThisMount,
+    target: RollbackTarget,
+) -> Result<RolledBack, RollbackError> {
+    let rolled_back =
+        roll_back_by_a_forward_publish(parameters, devices, allocator, current, target)?;
+    compaction.last_completed_intent = None;
+    Ok(rolled_back)
+}
```

```diff
+#[must_use]
+pub fn core_failure_of_the_gpu(

+                reason: reason.clone(),

+        GpuFailureCause::UncapturedErrorOrDeviceLost { reason } => {

+                reason: reason.clone(),

+        GpuFailureCause::ReadbackMappingFailed { reason } => {
+            failed_on_the_device(GpuFailureOnTheDevice::ReadbackMappingFailed {
+                reason: reason.clone(),
+            })

+            ),
         ] {
             assert_eq!(
                 core_failure_of_the_region_record_batch(&failed),
-                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu,
+                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu(expected),
                 "乙段：{failed:?}"
             );
         }
-        for failed in [
-            LiveSlotBatchFailed::RecordTablesLargerThanABindingOnTheGpu {
-                device: card(),
-                largest_buffer_bytes: 1 << 32,
-            },
-            LiveSlotBatchFailed::SegmentLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
-                device: card(),
-                entry_position: 2,
-            },
+        for (failed, expected) in [
+            (
+                LiveSlotBatchFailed::RecordTablesLargerThanABindingOnTheGpu {
+                    device: card(),
+                    largest_buffer_bytes: 1 << 32,
+                },
+                InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu::TablesLargerThanABindingOnTheDevice {
+                    device: card(),
+                    largest_buffer_bytes: 1 << 32,
+                },
+            ),
+            (
+                LiveSlotBatchFailed::SegmentLargerThanAChunkOnTheGpu {
+                    device: card(),
+                    entry_position: 2,
+                },

+                    device: card(),
+                    entry_position: 2,
+                    input_bytes: SEGMENT_BOUND_BYTES,

         ] {
             assert_eq!(
                 core_failure_of_the_live_slot_batch(&failed),
-                BackgroundGpuComputeFailed::InputNotSupportedOnTheGpu,

             );
         }
diff --git a/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/gpus_of_this_host.rs b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/gpus_of_this_host.rs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3ec631b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/singlefs-background-gpu/src/gpus_of_this_host.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,459 @@
+//! 挂载那一刻开着的本机全部独显里，此刻照哪一组设置用哪几张、每张怎么切、等多久（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 1–3 条；
+//! `records/2026-10-19-里程碑四GPU垃圾回收开工.md` 第 43 批交回那一行的定法：挂载那一刻开全部独显并量代价，设置决定哪几张参与，切换不重开）。
+//! 纯逻辑，不碰 GPU：外壳（`crate::background_gpu`）每张卡一份 [`GpuBudgetUnderTheSettings`]，参与的卡由 [`ParticipatingGpusOnThisHost`] 定；
+//! 核心层交来一组新设置（`BackgroundGpuCompute::use_the_settings_from_the_next_batch`，只在两批之间）就换这两样，从下一批起照它分活、切段、等。
+//!
+//! 换设置不清账：一张卡上等超过上限、还在 GPU 上跑的那次提交照旧记着，下一批在这张卡上交活之前先在新的等的上限之内等它做完，
+//! 再按新的显存上限扣掉还占着的切（第 3 条）；连续不确定的计数不在这里，换设置不碰它（第 8 条）。
+
+use std::ops::Range;
+use std::time::Duration;
+
+use singlefs_core::background_compute::{
+    AdmittedGpuSettings, GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes,
+};
+
+use crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::{
+    ChunkBoundsOfAGpu, ChunkFootprint, ChunksNotCutOnTheGpu, GpuMemoryAccount,
+};
+use crate::waiting_for_the_gpu::{CompletionCheck, GpuWaitDeadline, MonotonicClock};
+use crate::work_split_by_measured_cost::{
+    entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost, entry_ranges_per_gpu, HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission,
+};
+
+/// 一张卡此刻照的设置管的那几样：显存上限（记在账上）、等 GPU 的上限，连同与设置无关的绑定上限与派发上限、本包在它上面的账。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct GpuBudgetUnderTheSettings<Submission> {
+    largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: u64,
+    largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: u64,
+    memory_account: GpuMemoryAccount<Submission>,
+    wait_limit: Duration,
+}
+
+impl<Submission> GpuBudgetUnderTheSettings<Submission> {
+    /// 开卡那一刻：一个字节都没占，照开卡时给的上限。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn with_nothing_held(
+        largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: u64,
+        largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: u64,
+        memory_limit: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+        wait_limit: Duration,
+    ) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            largest_storage_binding_in_bytes,
+            largest_entry_count_per_dispatch,
+            memory_account: GpuMemoryAccount::with_nothing_held(memory_limit),
+            wait_limit,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 换上一组新设置给这张卡的显存上限与等的上限（两批之间调）。账照旧记着。
+    pub fn use_the_settings_from_the_next_batch(
+        &mut self,
+        memory_limit: Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+        wait_limit: Duration,
+    ) {
+        self.memory_account
+            .use_the_memory_limit_from_the_next_batch(memory_limit);
+        self.wait_limit = wait_limit;
+    }
+
+    /// 切这张卡的段用的界：显存上限取此刻设置给的（还没扣已占的）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn chunk_bounds(&self) -> ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+        ChunkBoundsOfAGpu {
+            memory_limit: self.memory_account.memory_limit(),
+            largest_storage_binding_in_bytes: self.largest_storage_binding_in_bytes,
+            largest_entry_count_per_dispatch: self.largest_entry_count_per_dispatch,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn wait_limit(&self) -> Duration {
+        self.wait_limit
+    }
+
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn memory_account(&self) -> &GpuMemoryAccount<Submission> {
+        &self.memory_account
+    }
+
+    pub fn memory_account_mut(&mut self) -> &mut GpuMemoryAccount<Submission> {
+        &mut self.memory_account
+    }
+
+    /// 这张卡分到的几条（每条的输入字节数）切段，交这几段之前调：前一次等超过上限、还在跑的那次提交先在此刻设置给的等的上限之内等它做完、
+    /// 放掉它的账，再按此刻设置给的显存上限扣掉还占着的切（`GpuMemoryAccount::chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed`）。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// 同 `GpuMemoryAccount::chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed`。
+    pub fn chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed(
+        &mut self,
+        clock: &impl MonotonicClock,
+        check_once_waiting_at_most: impl FnMut(&Submission, Duration) -> CompletionCheck<()>,
+        entry_input_lengths_in_bytes: &[u64],
+        footprint: ChunkFootprint,
+    ) -> Result<Vec<Range<usize>>, ChunksNotCutOnTheGpu> {
+        let deadline = GpuWaitDeadline::starting_now(self.wait_limit, clock);
+        let bounds = self.chunk_bounds();
+        self.memory_account
+            .chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed(
+                &deadline,
+                clock,
+                check_once_waiting_at_most,
+                entry_input_lengths_in_bytes,
+                footprint,
+                bounds,
+            )
+    }
+}
+
+/// 此刻参与的卡：在本机全部独显（按总线地址排的那一份）里的位置，按参与的次序（设置点名的次序，没点名是卡清单的次序）。至少一张、不重。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ParticipatingGpusOnThisHost {
+    positions_on_this_host: Vec<usize>,
+}
+
+impl ParticipatingGpusOnThisHost {
+    /// 核心层交来的那一组里参与的卡，在 `identifiers_on_this_host`（本机全部独显，按总线地址排）里找到各自的位置。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 有一张参与的卡不在本机的独显里：核心层照这份实现答的卡清单（就是本机全部独显）校验过这一组。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_the_settings(
+        settings: &AdmittedGpuSettings,
+        identifiers_on_this_host: &[GpuDeviceIdentifier],
+    ) -> Self {
+        let positions_on_this_host: Vec<usize> = settings
+            .participating_devices()
+            .iter()
+            .map(|participating| {
+                identifiers_on_this_host
+                    .iter()
+                    .position(|on_this_host| *on_this_host == participating.device)
+                    .expect("核心层照本机全部独显这份卡清单校验过：参与的卡都在里面")
+            })
+            .collect();
+        assert!(
+            !positions_on_this_host.is_empty(),
+            "核心层校验过的一组至少一张卡"
+        );
+        Self {
+            positions_on_this_host,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 开卡那一刻照开卡那一组定的参与的卡（位置按参与的次序）。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 一张都没有：开卡那一刻一张独显都没有就拒了。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_the_positions(positions_on_this_host: Vec<usize>) -> Self {
+        assert!(
+            !positions_on_this_host.is_empty(),
+            "开卡那一刻至少一张参与的卡"
+        );
+        Self {
+            positions_on_this_host,
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn positions_on_this_host(&self) -> &[usize] {
+        &self.positions_on_this_host
+    }
+
+    /// 一批的条目按挂载时量出的代价分给参与的卡（第 2 条，`work_split_by_measured_cost`）：每张参与的卡一段相连的条目，按参与的次序，
+    /// 交回（它在本机里的位置，分到的那几条）。不参与的卡一条都不分。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn entry_ranges_by_measured_cost(
+        &self,
+        measured_costs_on_this_host: &[HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission],
+        entry_count: usize,
+    ) -> Vec<(usize, Range<usize>)> {
+        let measured_costs: Vec<HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission> = self
+            .positions_on_this_host
+            .iter()
+            .map(|position| measured_costs_on_this_host[*position])
+            .collect();
+        self.positions_on_this_host
+            .iter()
+            .copied()
+            .zip(entry_ranges_per_gpu(&entries_per_gpu_by_measured_cost(
+                &measured_costs,
+                entry_count,
+            )))
+            .collect()
+    }
+}
+
+/// 本机的这张卡在这一组设置里给的显存上限：参与而没给上限的、不参与的（它分不到活）都交回 `None`。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn memory_limit_of_the_device_under_the_settings(
+    settings: &AdmittedGpuSettings,
+    identifier_on_this_host: &GpuDeviceIdentifier,
+) -> Option<GpuMemoryInBytes> {
+    settings
+        .participating_devices()
+        .iter()
+        .find(|participating| participating.device == *identifier_on_this_host)
+        .and_then(|participating| participating.memory_limit)
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+    use std::cell::Cell;
+
+    use singlefs_core::background_compute::{
+        admit_gpu_settings_against_the_inventory, BackgroundComputeBackend,
+        BackgroundComputeSettings, GpuInventory,
+    };
+
+    use crate::background_gpu::GpuFailureCause;
+    use crate::memory_limit_and_chunks::SubmissionOfTheChunk;
+
+    const GIBIBYTE: u64 = 1 << 30;
+
+    /// 本机三张独显，按总线地址排：代价各不相同。
+    struct ThreeCardsOnThisHost;
+
+    fn card(name: &str) -> GpuDeviceIdentifier {
+        GpuDeviceIdentifier::of_opaque_bytes(name.as_bytes().to_vec())
+    }
+
+    impl GpuInventory for ThreeCardsOnThisHost {
+        fn devices_with_total_memory(&self) -> Vec<(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)> {
+            vec![
+                (card("0000:01:00.0"), GpuMemoryInBytes(32 * GIBIBYTE)),
+                (card("0000:41:00.0"), GpuMemoryInBytes(16 * GIBIBYTE)),
+                (card("0000:81:00.0"), GpuMemoryInBytes(16 * GIBIBYTE)),
+            ]
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn identifiers_on_this_host() -> Vec<GpuDeviceIdentifier> {
+        ThreeCardsOnThisHost
+            .devices_with_total_memory()
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|(identifier, _total_memory)| identifier)
+            .collect()
+    }
+
+    /// 三张卡挂载时量出的代价：头一张最便宜。
+    fn measured_costs_on_this_host() -> Vec<HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission> {
+        vec![
+            HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(1_000),
+            HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(2_000),
+            HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(4_000),
+        ]
+    }
+
+    fn admitted(
+        named_devices: Option<Vec<GpuDeviceIdentifier>>,
+        memory_limits: Option<Vec<GpuMemoryInBytes>>,
+        wait_limit: Duration,
+    ) -> AdmittedGpuSettings {
+        admit_gpu_settings_against_the_inventory(
+            &BackgroundComputeSettings {
+                background_compute: BackgroundComputeBackend::Gpu,
+                background_gpu_devices: named_devices,
+                background_gpu_memory_limit: memory_limits,
+                background_gpu_wait_limit: wait_limit,
+            },
+            &ThreeCardsOnThisHost,
+        )
+        .expect("用例给的一组都合法")
+    }
+
+    /// 第 2 条：挂载时三张都参与、按代价分；切换缩成点名的两张（后一张在前）之后，下一批只分给这两张、按点名的次序，第三张一条都不分。
+    #[test]
+    fn after_a_switch_to_fewer_cards_the_next_batch_is_split_only_over_the_named_cards() {
+        let at_the_mount = ParticipatingGpusOnThisHost::of_the_settings(
+            &admitted(None, None, Duration::from_secs(10)),
+            &identifiers_on_this_host(),
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            at_the_mount.entry_ranges_by_measured_cost(&measured_costs_on_this_host(), 7),
+            vec![(0, 0..4), (1, 4..6), (2, 6..7)],
+            "没点名：本机三张都分，份额与代价成反比"
+        );
+        let after_the_switch = ParticipatingGpusOnThisHost::of_the_settings(
+            &admitted(
+                Some(vec![card("0000:81:00.0"), card("0000:01:00.0")]),
+                None,
+                Duration::from_secs(10),
+            ),
+            &identifiers_on_this_host(),
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            after_the_switch.entry_ranges_by_measured_cost(&measured_costs_on_this_host(), 10),
+            vec![(2, 0..2), (0, 2..10)],
+            "点名两张：只分给它们、按点名的次序，代价照挂载时量的；中间那张一条都不分"
+        );
+    }
+
+    /// 第 3 条：显存上限从切换生效的那一批起照新的切；上限改小之后同一批条目切得更碎，记账超过新上限就断言。
+    #[test]
+    fn after_a_switch_to_a_smaller_memory_limit_the_next_batch_is_cut_by_the_smaller_limit() {
+        let footprint = ChunkFootprint {
+            bytes_per_chunk_besides_the_entries: 16,
+            bytes_per_entry_besides_its_input: 40,
+            bytes_per_entry_in_the_largest_entry_buffer: 16,
+        };
+        let lengths = [100_u64; 6];
+        let clock = ClockThatNeverMoves;
+        let mut budget: GpuBudgetUnderTheSettings<u32> =
+            GpuBudgetUnderTheSettings::with_nothing_held(
+                1 << 30,
+                1 << 20,
+                Some(GpuMemoryInBytes(1000)),
+                Duration::from_secs(10),
+            );
+        assert_eq!(
+            budget.chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed(
+                &clock,
+                |_submission, _time_left| panic!("没有还在跑的提交，不该等"),
+                &lengths,
+                footprint,
+            ),
+            Ok(vec![0..6]),
+            "上限 1000 字节：六条一段 856 字节"
+        );
+        budget.use_the_settings_from_the_next_batch(
+            Some(GpuMemoryInBytes(300)),
+            Duration::from_secs(10),
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            budget.chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed(
+                &clock,
+                |_submission, _time_left| panic!("没有还在跑的提交，不该等"),
+                &lengths,
+                footprint,
+            ),
+            Ok(vec![0..2, 2..4, 4..6]),
+            "切换成 300 字节之后：两条一段 296 字节"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            budget.chunk_bounds().memory_limit,
+            Some(GpuMemoryInBytes(300)),
+            "切段的界照新上限"
+        );
+        let held_past_the_smaller_limit =
+            std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
+                budget.memory_account_mut().hold(301);
+            }));
+        assert!(
+            held_past_the_smaller_limit.is_err(),
+            "记账照新上限断言：301 字节超过 300"
+        );
+    }
+
+    /// 等的上限从切换生效的那一批起照新的：这张卡上前一次等超时的提交，下一批交活之前在新的上限之内等它。
+    /// 上限从 2 秒改成 8 秒：那次提交 5 秒后做完，照新的等得到它、放掉账再切；照旧的 2 秒就报前一次超时的提交没做完（带的是 2 秒）。
+    #[test]
+    fn after_a_switch_of_the_wait_limit_the_next_batch_waits_by_the_new_limit() {
+        let footprint = ChunkFootprint {
+            bytes_per_chunk_besides_the_entries: 16,
+            bytes_per_entry_besides_its_input: 40,
+            bytes_per_entry_in_the_largest_entry_buffer: 16,
+        };
+        let with_the_old_limit = budget_with_a_timed_out_submission_completing_after(
+            Duration::from_secs(2),
+            Duration::from_secs(5),
+        );
+        let (mut budget, clock) = with_the_old_limit;
+        assert_eq!(
+            budget.chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed(
+                &clock,
+                |_submission, time_left| clock.wait_for_the_submission(time_left),
+                &[100],
+                footprint,
+            ),
+            Err(ChunksNotCutOnTheGpu::EarlierSubmissionStillRunning(
+                GpuFailureCause::EarlierTimedOutSubmissionNotCompleteWithinTheWaitLimit {
+                    wait_limit: Duration::from_secs(2)
+                }
+            )),
+            "照旧的 2 秒：等不到"
+        );
+        let (mut budget, clock) = budget_with_a_timed_out_submission_completing_after(
+            Duration::from_secs(2),
+            Duration::from_secs(5),
+        );
+        budget.use_the_settings_from_the_next_batch(None, Duration::from_secs(8));
+        assert_eq!(budget.wait_limit(), Duration::from_secs(8));
+        assert_eq!(
+            budget.chunks_cut_once_the_submission_running_past_its_wait_completed(
+                &clock,
+                |_submission, time_left| clock.wait_for_the_submission(time_left),
+                &[100],
+                footprint,
+            ),
+            Ok(vec![0..1]),
+            "切换成 8 秒：等到它做完、放了账，照常切"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(budget.memory_account().bytes_held(), 0, "那次提交的账放了");
+    }
+
+    /// 钟从不走：只给不等的用例用。
+    struct ClockThatNeverMoves;
+
+    impl MonotonicClock for ClockThatNeverMoves {
+        fn time_since_the_origin(&self) -> Duration {
+            Duration::ZERO
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 假钟连同一次提交：钟只在等那次提交时走，每看一次至多走交给它的那么久，走到 `completes_at` 那一刻它做完。
+    struct ClockWithASubmissionCompletingAt {
+        now: Cell<Duration>,
+        completes_at: Duration,
+    }
+
+    impl MonotonicClock for ClockWithASubmissionCompletingAt {
+        fn time_since_the_origin(&self) -> Duration {
+            self.now.get()
+        }
+    }
+
+    impl ClockWithASubmissionCompletingAt {
+        fn wait_for_the_submission(&self, time_left: Duration) -> CompletionCheck<()> {
+            let waited_this_check = Duration::from_secs(1)
+                .min(time_left)
+                .max(Duration::from_nanos(1));
+            self.now.set(self.now.get() + waited_this_check);
+            if self.now.get() >= self.completes_at {
+                CompletionCheck::Completed(())
+            } else {
+                CompletionCheck::NotYetComplete
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 一张卡，等的上限 `wait_limit`，账上记着一段 200 字节、等超时还在跑的提交；钟在 0，那次提交在 `completes_after` 做完。
+    fn budget_with_a_timed_out_submission_completing_after(
+        wait_limit: Duration,
+        completes_after: Duration,
+    ) -> (
+        GpuBudgetUnderTheSettings<u32>,
+        ClockWithASubmissionCompletingAt,
+    ) {
+        let mut budget =
+            GpuBudgetUnderTheSettings::with_nothing_held(1 << 30, 1 << 20, None, wait_limit);
+        budget.memory_account_mut().hold(200);
+        budget
+            .memory_account_mut()
+            .settle_the_chunk_after_its_submission(
+                200,
+                SubmissionOfTheChunk::MayStillBeRunningOnTheGpu(7),
+            );
+        (
+            budget,
+            ClockWithASubmissionCompletingAt {
+                now: Cell::new(Duration::ZERO),
+                completes_at: completes_after,
+            },
+        )
+    }
```

```diff
+/// 本机的一张独显挂载那一刻没开成（起不了设备、编不了管线、量代价那几次提交出错或超时）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct DiscreteGpuNotOpenedAtTheMount {
+    pub discrete_gpu: DiscreteGpuOnThisHost,
+    pub cause: GpuFailureCause,
+}
+
+/// 挂载那一刻开卡之后的本机独显：开成的那几张与没开成而跳过的那几张，各按总线地址排。
+/// 卡清单（核心层 `GpuInventory`）照它答：本机全部独显连同没开成的（两样合起来按总线地址排，没给 `background_gpu_devices` 时上限按这个次序
+/// 一张一个，第 3 条），与其中没开成的那几张、原因照挂着时这张卡出错的报法（`core_failure_of_the_gpu`）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct DiscreteGpusAfterTheOpening {
+    pub opened: Vec<DiscreteGpuOnThisHost>,
+    pub not_opened: Vec<DiscreteGpuNotOpenedAtTheMount>,
+}
+
+impl GpuInventory for DiscreteGpusAfterTheOpening {
+    fn devices_with_total_memory(&self) -> Vec<(GpuDeviceIdentifier, GpuMemoryInBytes)> {
+        let mut every_discrete_gpu: Vec<&DiscreteGpuOnThisHost> = self
+            .opened
+            .iter()
+            .chain(
+                self.not_opened
+                    .iter()
+                    .map(|not_opened| &not_opened.discrete_gpu),
+            )
+            .collect();
+        every_discrete_gpu.sort_by(|left, right| left.pci_bus_address.cmp(&right.pci_bus_address));
+        every_discrete_gpu
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(|discrete_gpu| (discrete_gpu.identifier.clone(), discrete_gpu.total_memory))
+            .collect()
+    }
+
+    fn devices_not_opened_at_the_mount(&self) -> Vec<GpuDeviceNotOpenedAtTheMount> {
+        self.not_opened
+            .iter()
+            .map(|not_opened| GpuDeviceNotOpenedAtTheMount {
+                device: not_opened.discrete_gpu.identifier.clone(),
+                failure_at_the_mount: core_failure_of_the_gpu(
+                    &not_opened.discrete_gpu.identifier,
+                    &not_opened.cause,
+                ),
+            })
+            .collect()
+    }
+}
+
+/// 挂载那一刻开卡的结局：开成的每张卡开出来的东西（与 `discrete_gpus.opened` 一一对应、同序）、开卡之后的本机独显、开卡那一组参与的卡
+/// （在开成的那几张里的位置）。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct GpusOpenedAtTheMount<Opened> {
+    pub opened: Vec<Opened>,
+    pub discrete_gpus: DiscreteGpusAfterTheOpening,
+    pub participating: ParticipatingGpusOnThisHost,
+}
+
+/// 挂载那一刻在本机每一张独显上开卡（按 `discrete_gpus` 的次序，即总线地址的次序）：`open_the_gpu` 是外壳起设备、编管线、量代价那一步，
+/// 交给它这张卡与开卡那一组给它的显存上限；测试里交造出来的结局。一张卡没开成挡不挡挂载（D26（后台整理与放置回收） 已定项 13 第 2、4 条，
+/// `records/2026-10-19-里程碑四GPU垃圾回收开工.md` 第 45 批交回那一行的定法）：它参与（`participating` 里有它——给了 `background_gpu_devices` 时是点名的卡，
+/// 没给时本机全部独显都参与）就拒绝挂载、报出它与原因，后面的卡不再开；不参与（给了列表而没点它）就跳过，不进参与的卡，记进
+/// [`DiscreteGpusAfterTheOpening::not_opened`] 报出来，挂载照常。
+/// `participating` 是开卡那一组照同一份 `discrete_gpus` 校验过、取出来的参与的卡（`adapter_inventory::participating_gpus_admitted_by_the_mount_checks`）。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// [`BackgroundGpuOpenRefused::GpuUnusable`]：一张参与的卡没开成。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// `participating` 里有一张不在 `discrete_gpus` 里：它取自同一份清单。
+pub fn gpus_opened_at_the_mount<Opened>(
+    discrete_gpus: Vec<DiscreteGpuOnThisHost>,
+    participating: &[ParticipatingGpu],
+    mut open_the_gpu: impl FnMut(
+        &DiscreteGpuOnThisHost,
+        Option<GpuMemoryInBytes>,
+    ) -> Result<Opened, GpuFailureCause>,
+) -> Result<GpusOpenedAtTheMount<Opened>, BackgroundGpuOpenRefused> {
+    let mut opened = Vec::with_capacity(discrete_gpus.len());
+    let mut opened_discrete_gpus: Vec<DiscreteGpuOnThisHost> =
+        Vec::with_capacity(discrete_gpus.len());
+    let mut not_opened = Vec::new();
+    for discrete_gpu in discrete_gpus {
+        let participating_gpu = participating.iter().find(|participating_gpu| {
+            participating_gpu.discrete_gpu.identifier == discrete_gpu.identifier
+        });
+        let memory_limit_at_the_opening =
+            participating_gpu.and_then(|participating_gpu| participating_gpu.memory_limit);
+        match open_the_gpu(&discrete_gpu, memory_limit_at_the_opening) {
+            Ok(opened_gpu) => {
+                opened.push(opened_gpu);
+                opened_discrete_gpus.push(discrete_gpu);
+            }
+            Err(cause) => match participating_gpu {
+                Some(_participating) => {
+                    return Err(BackgroundGpuOpenRefused::GpuUnusable {
+                        device: discrete_gpu.identifier,
+                        cause,
+                    });
+                }
+                None => not_opened.push(DiscreteGpuNotOpenedAtTheMount {
+                    discrete_gpu,
+                    cause,
+                }),
+            },
+        }
+    }
+    let participating_positions: Vec<usize> = participating
+        .iter()
+        .map(|participating_gpu| {
+            opened_discrete_gpus
+                .iter()
+                .position(|opened_gpu| {
+                    opened_gpu.identifier == participating_gpu.discrete_gpu.identifier
+                })
+                .expect("参与的卡取自同一份独显清单；没开成的那一张在上面就拒了挂载")
+        })
+        .collect();
+    Ok(GpusOpenedAtTheMount {
+        opened,
+        discrete_gpus: DiscreteGpusAfterTheOpening {
+            opened: opened_discrete_gpus,
+            not_opened,
+        },
+        participating: ParticipatingGpusOnThisHost::of_the_positions(participating_positions),
+    })
+}
```

```diff
+    #[cfg(feature = "lookup-work-counters")]
+    IDENTITY_INDEX_BUILDS_AND_REGION_SCANS_ON_THIS_THREAD.with(|counted| {
+        let mut so_far = counted.get();
+        update(&mut so_far);
```

```diff
+            "三张卡都开了，点名的那张记账正好到上限"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            opening_that_holds_the_cost_probe(cost_probe_bytes - 1).map(|opening| opening.opened),
+            Err(
+                BackgroundGpuOpenRefused::CostProbeLargerThanTheMemoryLimit {
+                    device: card("0000:01:00.0"),
+                    memory_limit: GpuMemoryInBytes(cost_probe_bytes - 1),
+                    cost_probe_bytes,
+                }
+            ),
+            "少一个字节：切的时候就拒，不走到记账那一步"
+        );
+    }
+
+    /// 第 3 条「任何时刻都不许比它多」：一张参与的卡的显存上限（500 字节）装不下外壳量代价交的那一段（4096 字节的单元、12 字节的描述、
+    /// 两份核各 8 字节的结果与回读暂存、16 字节的参数），开卡交回拒绝挂载、报出那张卡、上限与那一段的字节数，不在记账那一步 panic。
+    #[test]
+    fn a_memory_limit_smaller_than_the_cost_probe_refuses_the_mount_instead_of_panicking() {
+        assert_eq!(
+            COST_PROBE_CHUNK.bytes_held(),
+            4096 + 12 + 4 * 8 + 16,
+            "外壳量代价那一段合占 4156 字节"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            opening_that_holds_the_cost_probe(500).map(|opening| opening.opened),
+            Err(
+                BackgroundGpuOpenRefused::CostProbeLargerThanTheMemoryLimit {
+                    device: card("0000:01:00.0"),
+                    memory_limit: GpuMemoryInBytes(500),
+                    cost_probe_bytes: 4096 + 12 + 4 * 8 + 16,
+                }
+            ),
+            "上限 500 字节装不下量代价那一段：拒绝挂载"
+        );
+    }
 }
```

```diff
+/// 丢后台 GPU（卸载、丢掉核心层收的把手、测试里展开）：不等还在 GPU 上跑的提交（用户 2026-10-28 定「卸载时同样不等、泄漏设备」）——
+/// 还记着一次等超过上限、没做完的提交的卡整张泄漏（设备、队列、管线都不析构：wgpu-core 30.0.1 的 `Queue` 析构调 `wait_for_idle`，
+/// 即 Vulkan 的 `vkQueueWaitIdle`，不带上限），别的卡照常丢（`gpus_of_this_host::gpus_dropped_leaking_those_still_running`）。
+impl Drop for BackgroundGpu {
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        let gpus_on_this_host = std::mem::take(&mut self.gpus_on_this_host);
+        let _gpus_leaked =
+            gpus_dropped_leaking_those_still_running(gpus_on_this_host, |gpu_in_use| {
+                gpu_in_use
+                    .budget
+                    .memory_account()
+                    .has_a_submission_running_past_its_wait()
+            });
+    }
+}

+/// CRC-32C（Castagnoli）反射多项式。两种合法各用它，不读核心层的实现。
+const CASTAGNOLI_REFLECTED_POLYNOMIAL: u32 = 0x82F6_3B78;
+
+/// 一个 32×32 的 GF(2) 矩阵（每个字是一列）乘一个寄存器值：寄存器为 1 的那几位对应的列异或起来。
+fn zero_operator_applied(zero_operator: &[u32; 32], register: u32) -> u32 {
+    let mut product = 0;
+    let mut remaining_bits = register;
+    let mut column = 0;
+    while remaining_bits != 0 {
+        if remaining_bits & 1 == 1 {
+            product ^= zero_operator[column];
+        }
+        remaining_bits >>= 1;
+        column += 1;
+    }
+    product
+}
+
+/// 算子自乘一次：喂 k 个零位的算子变成喂 2k 个零位的算子。
+fn zero_operator_squared(zero_operator: &[u32; 32]) -> [u32; 32] {
+    std::array::from_fn(|column| zero_operator_applied(zero_operator, zero_operator[column]))
+}
+
+/// 前一片的 CRC-32C 与后一片的 CRC-32C 合成两片首尾相接的 CRC-32C（查表那一份核的各片用它合）：把前一片的值当寄存器，
+/// 喂后一片那么多个零字节（喂零的算子按二进制自乘得到，不真喂），再异或后一片的值。CRC-32C 的初值与末了的异或在这一式里互相抵掉。
+///
+/// 循环：`second_length_in_bytes` 每轮右移两位，至多 32 轮；跨轮带两个算子与前一片的寄存器。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn crc32c_of_two_pieces_by_the_zero_operator_matrices(
+    crc32c_of_the_first_piece: u32,
+    crc32c_of_the_second_piece: u32,
+    second_length_in_bytes: u64,
+) -> u32 {
+    if second_length_in_bytes == 0 {
+        return crc32c_of_the_first_piece;
+    }
+    let mut operator_of_one_zero_bit = [0_u32; 32];
+    operator_of_one_zero_bit[0] = CASTAGNOLI_REFLECTED_POLYNOMIAL;
+    for (column, operator_column) in operator_of_one_zero_bit.iter_mut().enumerate().skip(1) {
+        *operator_column = 1 << (column - 1);
+    }
+    let operator_of_two_zero_bits = zero_operator_squared(&operator_of_one_zero_bit);
+    let mut operator_of_an_odd_power = zero_operator_squared(&operator_of_two_zero_bits);
+    let mut register = crc32c_of_the_first_piece;
+    let mut zero_bytes_left = second_length_in_bytes;
+    loop {
+        let operator_of_an_even_power = zero_operator_squared(&operator_of_an_odd_power);
+        if zero_bytes_left & 1 == 1 {
+            register = zero_operator_applied(&operator_of_an_even_power, register);
+        }
+        zero_bytes_left >>= 1;
+        if zero_bytes_left == 0 {
+            break;
+        }
+        operator_of_an_odd_power = zero_operator_squared(&operator_of_an_even_power);
+        if zero_bytes_left & 1 == 1 {
+            register = zero_operator_applied(&operator_of_an_odd_power, register);
+        }
+        zero_bytes_left >>= 1;
+        if zero_bytes_left == 0 {
+            break;
+        }

+}

+/// 反射表示下两个多项式相乘再模 CRC-32C 多项式：最高位是 x 的 0 次方，最低位是 x 的 31 次方。
+///
+/// 循环：`multiplier` 从最高位往下看，至多 32 轮；跨轮带乘积与被乘数乘过的那几个 x。
+fn product_modulo_the_polynomial(multiplier: u32, multiplicand: u32) -> u32 {
+    let mut product = 0;
+    let mut shifted_multiplicand = multiplicand;
+    for bit_from_the_top in 0..32 {
+        if multiplier & (1 << (31 - bit_from_the_top)) != 0 {
+            product ^= shifted_multiplicand;
+        }
+        shifted_multiplicand = if shifted_multiplicand & 1 == 1 {
+            (shifted_multiplicand >> 1) ^ CASTAGNOLI_REFLECTED_POLYNOMIAL

+/// x 的（8 × `zero_bytes`）次方模 CRC-32C 多项式，反射表示：从 x 的 8 次方起按二进制自乘。
+///
+/// 循环：`zero_bytes` 每轮右移一位，至多 64 轮。
+fn power_of_x_for_zero_bytes(zero_bytes: u64) -> u32 {
+    const X_TO_THE_POWER_ZERO: u32 = 1 << 31;
+    const X_TO_THE_POWER_EIGHT: u32 = 1 << (31 - 8);
+    let mut power = X_TO_THE_POWER_ZERO;
+    let mut square = X_TO_THE_POWER_EIGHT;
+    let mut zero_bytes_left = zero_bytes;
+    while zero_bytes_left != 0 {
+        if zero_bytes_left & 1 == 1 {
+            power = product_modulo_the_polynomial(square, power);

+        square = product_modulo_the_polynomial(square, square);
+        zero_bytes_left >>= 1;

+/// （8 × 后一片字节数）次方、模多项式，再异或后一片的值。与 [`crc32c_of_two_pieces_by_the_zero_operator_matrices`] 各写各的。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn crc32c_of_two_pieces_by_multiplying_a_power_of_x(
+    crc32c_of_the_first_piece: u32,
+    crc32c_of_the_second_piece: u32,

+/// # Panics
+/// 一片罩出它那一个单元的字节：片由同一批单元的字节数切出。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn units_of_the_pieces<'unit, EntryKey>(
+    units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'unit, EntryKey>],
+    pieces: &[PieceOfAnEntry],
+) -> Vec<UnitChecksumToVerify<'unit, ()>> {

+/// （`both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk`，交回每片两份的结果，查表那一份在前），再按单元接回：整条一片的照核交回的；切成几片的，
+/// 查表那一份的各片按 [`crc32c_of_two_pieces_by_the_zero_operator_matrices`]、逐位移那一份的各片按
+/// [`crc32c_of_two_pieces_by_multiplying_a_power_of_x`] 依次合成整单元的值，各自与期望值比。交回每个单元两份的结果，按 `units` 的次序。

+/// # Errors
+/// 某一段交不成：照原样交回，后面的段不交。

+/// # Panics
+/// 片没有按单元的次序、单元里的字节次序一片不漏地罩住每个单元；一段交回的结果数与它的片数不等。
+pub fn checksum_outcomes_of_the_units_cut_into_pieces<EntryKey, SubmissionFailure>(
+    units: &[UnitChecksumToVerify<'_, EntryKey>],
+    chunks_of_pieces: &[Vec<PieceOfAnEntry>],
+    mut both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk: impl FnMut(

+    ) -> Result<

+        PieceOfAnEntry,
+        (ChecksumKernelOutcome, ChecksumKernelOutcome),
+    )> = Vec::new();
+    for pieces in chunks_of_pieces {
+        let outcomes = both_kernel_outcomes_of_a_chunk(&units_of_the_pieces(units, pieces))?;
+        assert_eq!(outcomes.len(), pieces.len(), "两份核每片各交一个结果");
+        piece_outcomes.extend(pieces.iter().cloned().zip(outcomes));
+    }
+    let mut unit_outcomes = Vec::with_capacity(units.len());
+    let mut next_piece = 0;
+    for (entry_position, unit) in units.iter().enumerate() {
+        let unit_length = u64::try_from(unit.unit_bytes.len()).expect("装得进 u64");
+        let first_piece = next_piece;
+        let mut covered_up_to = 0;
+        while next_piece < piece_outcomes.len()
+            && piece_outcomes[next_piece].0.entry_position == entry_position
+        {
+            assert_eq!(
+                piece_outcomes[next_piece].0.input_bytes.start, covered_up_to,
+                "一个单元的片按字节的次序首尾相接"
+            );
+            covered_up_to = piece_outcomes[next_piece].0.input_bytes.end;
+            next_piece += 1;
+        }
+        assert!(
+            next_piece > first_piece && covered_up_to == unit_length,
+            "每个单元的片一片不漏地罩住它的字节"
+        );
+        let pieces_of_the_unit = &piece_outcomes[first_piece..next_piece];
+        if let [(_whole_unit, outcomes_of_the_whole_unit)] = pieces_of_the_unit {
+            unit_outcomes.push(*outcomes_of_the_whole_unit);
+            continue;
+        }
+        let mut table_driven_crc32c = pieces_of_the_unit[0].1 .0.computed_crc32c;
+        let mut bitwise_crc32c = pieces_of_the_unit[0].1 .1.computed_crc32c;
+        for (piece, (table_driven, bitwise)) in &pieces_of_the_unit[1..] {
+            table_driven_crc32c = crc32c_of_two_pieces_by_the_zero_operator_matrices(
+                table_driven_crc32c,
+                table_driven.computed_crc32c,
+                piece.input_byte_count(),
+            );
+            bitwise_crc32c = crc32c_of_two_pieces_by_multiplying_a_power_of_x(
+                bitwise_crc32c,
+                bitwise.computed_crc32c,
+                piece.input_byte_count(),
+            );
+        }
+        unit_outcomes.push((
+            ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+                computed_crc32c: table_driven_crc32c,
+                matches_the_expected_crc32c: table_driven_crc32c == unit.expected_crc32c,
+            },
+            ChecksumKernelOutcome {
+                computed_crc32c: bitwise_crc32c,
+                matches_the_expected_crc32c: bitwise_crc32c == unit.expected_crc32c,
+            },
+        ));
+    }
+    assert_eq!(
+        next_piece,
+        piece_outcomes.len(),
+        "每一片都属于这一批的某个单元"
+    );
+    Ok(unit_outcomes)
+}

+/// 量代价（第 2 条：一次提交的主机 CPU 时间）按几片交时，这张卡的代价取各片之和：先把各段空跑一遍（管线刚编好时驱动的懒初始化不算进去），
+/// 再量 `measurements` 轮，每一轮把各段各交一次、`cpu_time_of_submitting` 量出的时间加起来，取各轮之和的中位数。
+///
+/// 两层循环：外层 `measurements` 轮、内层每轮 `chunks` 段，都有界；跨轮只带量出的那几个和。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 任何一次交出错照原样交回（这张卡没量成）。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// `chunks` 为空或 `measurements` 为 0：量代价那一段至少一段，至少量一轮。
+pub fn measured_cost_summed_over_the_pieces<Chunk, Failure>(
+    chunks: &[Chunk],
+    measurements: usize,
+    mut cpu_time_of_submitting: impl FnMut(&Chunk) -> Result<Duration, Failure>,
+) -> Result<HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission, Failure> {
+    assert!(!chunks.is_empty(), "量代价那一段至少切出一段");
+    assert!(measurements > 0, "至少量一轮");
+    for chunk in chunks {
+        cpu_time_of_submitting(chunk)?;
+    }
+    let mut sums_in_nanoseconds = Vec::with_capacity(measurements);
+    for _measurement in 0..measurements {
+        let mut sum_of_this_round = Duration::ZERO;
+        for chunk in chunks {
+            sum_of_this_round += cpu_time_of_submitting(chunk)?;
+        }
+        sums_in_nanoseconds.push(
+            u64::try_from(sum_of_this_round.as_nanos())
+                .expect("一轮各段的 CPU 时间之和装得进 u64 纳秒"),
+        );
+    }
+    sums_in_nanoseconds.sort_unstable();
+    Ok(HostCpuNanosecondsPerSubmission(
+        sums_in_nanoseconds[measurements / 2],
+    ))
+}

+    }

 pub fn live_slot_chunk_footprint(

-            + record_tables.bytes_on_the_gpu(),

+/// `record_count` 条记录的记录表交给核时两个缓冲合占的字节数与大的那一个的字节数（按 [`AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels`] 的建法：
+/// 没有记录时各放一项）。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn record_table_bytes_of(record_count: u64) -> (u64, u64) {
+    let record_words = ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS_AS_U64 * record_count.max(1);
+    let sorted_position_words = record_count.max(1);
+    (
+        4 * (record_words + sorted_position_words),
+        4 * record_words.max(sorted_position_words),
+    )
+}
+
+const ALLOCATION_RECORD_WORDS_AS_U64: u64 = 5;
+
+/// 选段打分一段里最小的一片在卡上合占的字节数：一个段连同只有一条记录的记录表。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn bytes_of_the_smallest_live_slot_piece() -> u64 {
+    live_slot_chunk_footprint_of_record_table_bytes(record_table_bytes_of(1).0)
+        .bytes_held_by_a_chunk(SEGMENT_BOUND_BYTES, 1)
+}
+
+/// 记录表的一片（按记录的次序相连的几条）与这张卡上这一片之下段切成的几段（按这张卡分到的段里的位置）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct RecordSliceWithItsChunks {
+    pub records: Range<usize>,
+    pub segment_chunks: Vec<Range<usize>>,
+}
+
+/// 一张卡上选段打分这一批分到它的 `segment_count` 个段怎么切（交之前算完）：整份记录表（`record_count` 条）连同段装得下就是一片整份记录表、
+/// 段照常切；装不下就把记录表按记录的次序切成相连的几片，每片取连同一个段单独成一段装得下、两个缓冲装得进绑定上限的最多条数，
+/// 每片照它的大小切段。没有段交回空。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 连只有一条记录的那一片连同一个段都装不下（[`SmallestPieceLargerThanTheRoom`]，`entry_position` 是 0）。
+pub fn live_slot_plan_on_a_gpu(
+    record_count: usize,
+    segment_count: usize,
+    room: ChunkBoundsOfAGpu,
+) -> Result<Vec<RecordSliceWithItsChunks>, SmallestPieceLargerThanTheRoom> {
+    if segment_count == 0 {
+        return Ok(Vec::new());
+    }
+    let record_count_wide = u64::try_from(record_count).expect("装得进 u64");
+    let fits = |records_in_the_slice: u64| -> bool {
+        let (table_bytes, largest_table_bytes) = record_table_bytes_of(records_in_the_slice);
+        largest_table_bytes <= room.largest_storage_binding_in_bytes
+            && chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(
+                &[SEGMENT_BOUND_BYTES],
+                live_slot_chunk_footprint_of_record_table_bytes(table_bytes),
+                room,
+            )
+            .is_ok()
+    };
+    let records_per_slice = if fits(record_count_wide) {
+        record_count_wide.max(1)
+    } else {
+        // 记录表每多一条，两个缓冲合占多 24 字节、大的那一个多 20 字节：按显存上限与绑定上限各自的余量现算最多几条，再核一遍。
+        let (table_bytes_of_one_record, largest_table_bytes_of_one_record) =
+            record_table_bytes_of(1);
+        let one_segment_without_the_table = live_slot_chunk_footprint_of_record_table_bytes(0)
+            .bytes_held_by_a_chunk(SEGMENT_BOUND_BYTES, 1);
+        let records_under_the_memory_limit = room.memory_limit.map_or(u64::MAX, |memory_limit| {
+            memory_limit.0.saturating_sub(one_segment_without_the_table) / table_bytes_of_one_record
+        });
+        let records_under_the_binding =
+            room.largest_storage_binding_in_bytes / largest_table_bytes_of_one_record;
+        let records_per_slice = records_under_the_memory_limit.min(records_under_the_binding);
+        if records_per_slice == 0 || !fits(records_per_slice) {
+            return Err(SmallestPieceLargerThanTheRoom {
+                entry_position: 0,
+                smallest_piece_bytes: bytes_of_the_smallest_live_slot_piece(),
+            });
+        }
+        records_per_slice
+    };
+    let records_per_slice =
+        usize::try_from(records_per_slice).expect("一片的条数不超过记录数，装得进 usize");
+    let segment_bound_lengths = vec![SEGMENT_BOUND_BYTES; segment_count];
+    let mut slices = Vec::new();
+    let mut slice_start = 0;
+    loop {
+        let slice_end = record_count.min(slice_start + records_per_slice);
+        let (table_bytes, _largest_table_bytes) =
+            record_table_bytes_of(u64::try_from(slice_end - slice_start).expect("装得进 u64"));
+        let segment_chunks = chunks_that_fit_on_the_gpu(
+            &segment_bound_lengths,
+            live_slot_chunk_footprint_of_record_table_bytes(table_bytes),
+            room,
+        )
+        .expect("一个段连同这一片记录表单独成一段装得下：片的条数按它取");
+        slices.push(RecordSliceWithItsChunks {
+            records: slice_start..slice_end,
+            segment_chunks,
+        });
+        slice_start = slice_end;
+        if slice_start >= record_count {
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(slices)
+}
+
+/// 一张卡上这一批分到它的段照 [`live_slot_plan_on_a_gpu`] 切好的几片记录表、几段逐段交两份核（`both_kernel_live_slots_of_a_chunk`，
+/// 交它这一段的段、这一片的记录与这一片的两张表，交回这一段每段两份的活槽数，逐条走遍记录那一份在前），各片数出的逐段相加，两份各加各的。
+/// 交回每段两份的活槽数，按 `segments` 的次序。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 某一段交不成：照原样交回，后面的段不交。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 一片之下的几段没有一段不漏地罩住 `segments`；一段交回的段数与它的段数不等；相加超出 `u64`（活槽数不超过记录数乘 65535）。
+pub fn live_slots_summed_over_the_record_slices<SubmissionFailure>(
+    allocation_records: &[AllocationRecord],
+    segments: &[ClusterSegmentEntryKey],
+    slices: &[RecordSliceWithItsChunks],
+    mut both_kernel_live_slots_of_a_chunk: impl FnMut(
+        &[ClusterSegmentEntryKey],
+        &[AllocationRecord],
+        &AllocationRecordTablesForTheKernels,
+    ) -> Result<Vec<(u64, u64)>, SubmissionFailure>,
```
